jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **About the job** Otavo.ai is a global hiring platform focused on mid\-to\-senior recruitment. We are hiring an AI Architect for one of our clients Apply only thru: https://www.otavo.ai/jobs/cmu9yfiim09jt01t3cosasw3d **About the Company:** A B2B software provider in industrial AI and manufacturing optimization is hiring an AI Architect to work directly with large US\-based OEMs and manufacturing enterprises. The role focuses on identifying and deploying AI opportunities across business functions, spanning manufacturing and supply chain. This is a hands\-on position with significant ownership and impact, reporting to senior stakeholders and business leaders. **Location**: Peoria, Illinois, United States **Compensation**: Base USD 200k\+ **Work mode**: Full\-time, On\-site **US work visa is a must** About the Role We are looking for a Principal AI Architect to own the end\-to\-end architecture of our enterprise AI platform and to set the technical standard for how AI is designed, built, deployed, and governed across the company. This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership role for someone who understands AI application architecture at a fundamental level and has repeatedly taken enterprise AI systems from concept to secure, robust, well\-governed production at scale. You will be the trusted technical authority partnering with engineering, data, security, risk, and business leaders to ensure every AI solution is architecturally sound, scalable, compliant with Responsible AI principles, and aligned with where the industry is heading. You will operate fluently across the full AI spectrum — classical machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and modern LLM / agentic systems — and translate that breadth into reference architectures, guardrails, and production systems that teams across the enterprise build on. The distance between identifying a customer problem and shipping a production solution is measured in weeks, and you'll own that entire journey, from the plant floor to the deployed system. This role is based in Chicago and is on\-site 5 days work from office. Travel: Regular travel to customer sites, accross the US. Expect 50–60%. On non\-travel weeks, you're in the Chicago office five days. You'll spend time in factories, warehouses, engineering offices, planning meetings, and supply chain reviews, understanding how work actually gets done before deciding how software should improve it. What You'll Do Architecture \& Technical Leadership \- Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the enterprise AI platform: orchestration layers, LLM integration patterns, RAG and vector pipelines, agent frameworks, feature stores, model\-serving infrastructure, API mesh, and reusable shared services. \- Define architectural standards, reference designs, patterns, and guardrails that govern how engineering teams build and integrate AI workloads. \- Translate business and product requirements into concrete architecture decisions — selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking frameworks, and assembling reusable components. \- Serve as the design authority in architecture reviews, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. Design, Build \& Deploy (Hands\-On) \- Design and build production AI systems spanning classical ML, deep learning, computer vision, and generative/LLM workloads. \- Architect agentic AI systems — multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, memory systems, and planning/reasoning patterns — using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel. \- Work hands\-on with foundation models: prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), fine\-tuning/adaptation, evaluation, and custom model integration. \- Evaluate and integrate core AI infrastructure: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration layers, and observability/evaluation tooling. Production, MLOps \& LLMOps \- Establish and mature the full model lifecycle: CI/CD for models and prompts, automated testing, environment strategy, deployment, rollback, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining. \- Build observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost\-management practices for LLM\- and ML\-based systems running in production. \- Ensure systems meet enterprise SLAs for latency, availability, and cost at scale. Security, Robustness \& Governance \- Embed security by design: data protection, secrets management, access control, tenant isolation, and defense against prompt injection, data exfiltration, model, and supply\-chain risks. \- Operationalize Responsible AI and governance — safety, risk management, transparency, explainability, human\-in\-the\-loop design, bias monitoring, and regulatory alignment (e.g., GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA, EU AI Act, and applicable industry regulations). \- Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture and data\-governance standards. Influence \& Enablement \- Advise CIO/CTO and senior business leaders on AI strategy, build\-vs\-buy decisions, and platform investment. \- Mentor senior engineers and architects; raise the AI engineering bar across the organization. \- Track the evolving AI landscape and steer the enterprise toward durable, forward\-looking choices. What You Bring (Required) \- 10\+ years in software engineering / enterprise architecture, with 5\+ years architecting and deploying production AI/ML systems at enterprise scale. (Exceptional candidates with less tenure but clearly stronger depth will be considered.) \- Demonstrated depth across the AI stack: \- Machine Learning \& Deep Learning — model development, training, evaluation, and productionization. \- Computer Vision — detection, classification, segmentation, and deployment (including edge/real\-time where relevant). \- LLMs / Generative AI — architecting and operationalizing LLM\-driven applications; RAG, agents, fine\-tuning, prompt/context engineering, function calling, and evaluation. \- AI Ops (MLOps/LLMOps) — CI/CD, observability, drift/retraining, reliability, and cost management in production. \- Proven track record designing enterprise\-grade AI solutions on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including enterprise integration and API design. \- Deep, demonstrable experience delivering AI systems that are secure, robust, and well\-governed — not just prototypes. \- Strong grasp of Responsible AI, model risk, and regulatory/compliance considerations. \- Fluency in Python and the modern AI/ML ecosystem (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph/Semantic Kernel, vector databases, containers/Kubernetes). \- Excellent communication — able to operate from executive strategy down to hands\-on implementation. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Preferred / Top\-Candidate Signals \- Master's or PhD in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrated depth. \- Experience with agentic/multi\-agent architectures in production. \- Background in a regulated or safety\-critical / industrial enterprise environment. \- Contributions to open source, patents, publications, or recognized thought leadership in AI. \- Experience defining enterprise AI reference architectures adopted across multiple teams. Why This Role \- End\-to\-end ownership of the enterprise AI platform — you set the standard, not just implement it. \- Full\-spectrum scope — classical ML, DL, CV, and modern LLM/agentic systems in one mandate. \- Real production impact at enterprise scale, with security and governance treated as first\-class. \- Uncapped for the right person — compensation is not a barrier for a truly competitive candidate. Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * Do you have 10\+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise architecture, with at least 5 years architecting and deploying production AI/ML systems at enterprise scale? Yes/No * Which major cloud platform(s) have you designed enterprise\-grade AI solutions on? * Do you have a valid US work Visa? * Why do you think you are a good fit for this role? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate Director, Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high\-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3\) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non\-profit health centers across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy and political arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non\-profit membership organization tax\-exempt under section 501(c)(4\). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund seek a dynamic and effective Associate Director, Information Security Engineer. This job reports directly to the Dir, Security Operations in the Information Security division of PPFA. The Office of Information Security provides the strategy and implementation of the information security program that safeguards the data entrusted to Planned Parenthood by its patients, supporters, donors, and staff. ### **Purpose:** The Security Engineer manages Information Technology security protections with the goal of protecting PPFA from and reducing the impact of security incidents and system compromises for the organization. This position provides security monitoring, event investigation and analysis, and countermeasure proposals on a 24x7 basis along with providing support and guidance to Tier I Analysts, will provide technical assistance for Tier II \& III incidents as assigned, and is responsible to directly interface with the InfoSec Operations Team, Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) and IT Managed Service Provider (MSP) as it relates to security event architecture, collection, management, reporting, and alerting within PPFA’s SIEM Platforms. ### **Engagement:** The Security Engineer will engage with InfoSecOps, InfoSec, ITOps/MSP, the MSSP, ATS and staff within both PPFA and Affiliates. ### **Delivery:** The Security Engineer will deliver by identifying, implementing, and maintaining Information Security toolsets, primarily focused on SIEM, to protect the organization; interfacing with IT Ops to ensure proper security event logging setup; and, where applicable, supporting the Information Security SIEM management needs of PPFA and Affiliates. Act as a Subject Matter Expert for PPFA’s SIEM (currently Splunk) and be able to configure, manage, operate, and administer the platform from a managed SIEM perspective. * SIEM Security Monitoring – Provide security monitoring and threat/risk analysis in a 24/7 environment. * SIEM Event Filtering – Monitor \& ensure established processes for event identification are followed, and, where required, make recommendations for new or refined event filtering, ensuring all updates are completed. * SIEM Event Investigation \& Assignment – Monitor \& ensure established processes are followed for collecting relevant data and performing the necessary levels of analysis on that data. Ensure events are assigned appropriately. * Tier II Event Escalations \- Follow an established process for handling Tier II escalations, identifying the source of the escalation (MSSP, MSP, Affiliate, or other) and the appropriate triage and documentation processes. * Creating and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Information Security Ops group, and providing recommendations on security process improvements * Support and engage on complex security tool\-specific tasks with the assistance and guidance of management, vendor \& MSSP resources * Assist in Vulnerability Assessments setup, scanning, analysis, and remediations, working with IT Ops staff and corporate vendors as needed in correcting errors and alerts as found with the IT infrastructure systems. * Assist in IR incidents as assigned by management * All other duties as assigned ### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):** * Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of industry experience * Passion for working on newer technologies and exploring the security domain. * Independent decision\-making capabilities, especially in identifying analysis tracks for escalated events, analysis assignments, and escalation decisions ranging from a base Tier I event to Incident Response\-level remediations. * Experience in compliance requirements and industry standards like PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, CSF, MITRE ATT\&CK, ITIL, COBIT, Sarbanes\-Oxley, and SANS 20\. * UNIX, AIX \& Solaris, Linux, Windows Server Operating Systems * Network/System Intrusion Detection or Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) * Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) * Vulnerability scanner/Penetration testing systems * Wireless Networking * Switches/Routers, Firewalls (basic configuration) * TCP/IP networking, VPN, VLAN, NAT, and security concepts * Software \& Hardware Asset Management * Security threat and attack countermeasures * Experience conducting forensic analytical studies and investigations * Flexibility and ability to adapt to quickly changing priorities and ambiguous situations * A deep commitment to Planned Parenthood’s mission of promoting Sexual and Reproductive Health $125,000 \- $130,000 a year **Travel:**(0\-10% travel as needed) Planned Parenthood's cultural ethos, "In This Together", reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture that fosters belonging, promotes learning throughout the employee lifecycle, and recognizes individual contributions to our mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America participates in the E\-Verify program. Planned Parenthood Federation of America is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a non\-discriminatory work environment, and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Planned Parenthood is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

jobs.title: Associate Structural Engineer
jobs.description: Kidwell Scott Engineering (KSE) is a small structural engineering firm focusing primarily on building design. Our projects typically consist of restaurants, banks, retail spaces, offices, schools, custom single\-family residences, apartments, townhomes, and amenity buildings, but sometimes also includes retaining walls, miscellaneous steel design, light industrial crane design, and design of fiber reinforced polymer utility buildings. Building projects in our office are traditionally a variety of wood, steel, concrete, and masonry; single\- and multi\-story; and wind and seismic controlled. These projects are also a mix of new construction, tenant improvement buildouts, and renovations/additions. **KSE is looking for an associate structural engineer to join our growing team. The roles and responsibilities of this position are as follows:** · Perform design calculations using RISA, ENERCALC, and other analysis software, and sometimes hand calculations, to meet the requirements of the IBC, ASCE 7, material codes, and any other project requirements or constraints · Use REVIT to model structural elements of a project and produce construction drawings · Track and review project submittals and RFIs · Perform site visits during construction · Assist engineers and senior engineers with any other project needs **The ideal candidate shall have the following qualifications:** · Bachelors of Science from an ABET accredited university · Masters of Science preferred · Passed Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Exam (E.I or E.I.T credentials) · No experience required; up to 3 years of experience is applicable for position Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Banking
jobs.description: At Nexapoint Technologies, we build software that helps businesses connect their systems and automate everyday operations. Our platform, Veltriona Flow, brings internal approvals, employee onboarding, access requests, and business integrations into one place. We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to develop the services, APIs, and integrations that power these workflows. **About the role** This is a mid\-level engineering position with ownership of clearly scoped features, from discussing requirements through development, testing, and release. You’ll work closely with engineers, Product, and Design to build reliable services and make complex business processes easier to manage. Senior engineers will support you with architectural decisions and unfamiliar technical challenges. **What you’ll do** * Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI. * Develop integrations with external SaaS products through APIs and webhooks. * Implement workflow execution, approval rules, notifications, and background jobs. * Design PostgreSQL schemas, write migrations, and improve query performance. * Make integrations resilient through retries, failure handling, and safeguards against duplicate processing. * Implement authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer data. * Write automated tests, review code, and contribute to reliable releases. * Monitor production services, investigate issues, and address their underlying causes. * Collaborate with frontend engineers on API contracts and feature delivery. * Document technical decisions and communicate progress and delivery risks. **What you’ll bring** * Approximately three or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience delivering production applications. * Practical backend development experience with Python or a comparable language. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating third\-party services. * Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data modeling. * Familiarity with asynchronous processing, background jobs, and common API failure scenarios. * An understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security. * Experience using Git, writing automated tests, and participating in code reviews. * The ability to investigate problems across application services, databases, and external systems. * Clear written and spoken English and effective remote collaboration skills. * Experience taking a defined feature from requirements through production release. A computer science degree is welcome but not required. We value practical skills and thoughtful engineering decisions. **Nice to have** Experience with FastAPI or Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, OAuth 2\.0, single sign\-on, multi\-tenant SaaS applications, or webhook delivery. Familiarity with application monitoring, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code is also helpful. You don’t need experience with every tool in our stack to apply. **Our technology stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. Our frontend uses React and TypeScript. **Compensation and working arrangements** * **Base salary: $125,000–$155,000 USD annually**, before taxes, paid twice monthly. * **Annual bonus target: 8% of base salary**, dependent on company and individual performance and not guaranteed. * Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employment. * Remote work within approved U.S. employment locations. * A 40\-hour workweek, Monday through Friday. * Flexible start and finish times, with availability from **12:00–4:00 p.m. Eastern Time** for collaboration. * A business\-hours support rotation, approximately one week every six weeks, with reduced feature work during that period. * No overnight on\-call rotation or scheduled evening or weekend work. * Up to two company\-paid U.S. team gatherings annually. Your offer will reflect your relevant experience, technical skills, and demonstrated feature ownership. Compensation is reviewed annually. Benefits are separate from cash compensation; equity is not included in the standard package. **Benefits** * Medical coverage from day one, with 90% of employee premiums and 60% of eligible dependent premiums covered. * Fully company\-paid employee dental and vision premiums. * A 401(k) plan after 90 days, with an immediately vested employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay contributed. * 20 vacation days annually, plus 10 paid sick days, 11 company holidays, and two floating holidays. * 12 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment. * Company\-paid basic life and disability insurance. * A company\-provided laptop and peripherals, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * $75 monthly internet reimbursement. * Up to $1,500 annually for professional development and three paid learning days. * An employee assistance program and $50 monthly reimbursement toward eligible wellness expenses. * Structured, paid onboarding with an assigned engineering buddy. **How we work** We work in two\-week development cycles, keep meetings focused, and document decisions to support asynchronous collaboration. Engineers participate in product discussions and help shape implementation plans. You’ll have room to work independently, with teammates available for pairing, design discussions, and troubleshooting. We value realistic commitments, maintainable software, and respect for personal time. **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Learn the platform, set up your environment, and ship a small backend improvement with support. * **By 60 days:** Deliver a scoped API or integration feature, including tests, documentation, and production monitoring. * **By 90 days:** Independently lead a medium\-sized backend feature and contribute an improvement to service reliability or integration performance. **Interview process** * A 25\-minute introductory conversation. * A 45\-minute interview with the Engineering Manager. * A 75\-minute practical technical session focused on an API or integration scenario. * A 45\-minute team conversation covering collaboration and technical design. No unpaid take\-home project is required. We aim to complete the process within two to three weeks. **How to apply** Submit your resume in English. Links to LinkedIn, GitHub, or relevant work are welcome but optional. A cover letter is not required. Candidates must reside in an approved U.S. employment location and be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Veltriona Technologies welcomes applicants from different backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Delivery Lead
jobs.description: ### Our Mission Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise, starting with life sciences. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that lets regulated organizations deploy AI securely, at scale, and with confidence. We're creating the backend systems that power real\-world AI workflows across drug discovery, clinical development, and commercial operations. Our platform turns complex, regulated environments into intelligent, adaptive systems where autonomous AI agents operate in harmony with existing infrastructure. ### About the Role As a Customer Delivery Lead, you own our most strategic enterprise deployments end to end — from initial scoping through production go\-live and customer self\-sufficiency. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you'll work with leading pharma, biotech, investment banking, and energy enterprises deploying Salt into demanding SaaS, VPC, and on\-prem environments. This is a senior, judgment\-heavy role. You define what we're building, negotiate what we're not, direct the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts, and hold the line when a customer pushes to expand scope mid\-engagement. You'll keep engagement detail current in our existing AI\-first project management flow (Slack Notion Linear), where engineers groom their own tickets — so your time goes to scoping and direction, not ticket administration. ### The Role (What You'll Be Doing) * Scope engagements down to one or two named workflows with fixed timelines, and drive customer stakeholders to converge on them quickly. * Define the engagement exit before work begins: what customer self\-sufficiency looks like, written down and agreed. * Own SOW terms and the deal scope boundary — including the authority to decline out\-of\-scope asks from senior customer stakeholders. * Run post\-engagement debriefs and drive field learning back into product and platform priorities. * Provide and leadership, prioritization, and technical direction to the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts. * Lead executive communication with customer sponsors throughout the engagement lifecycle. * Stay engaged after go\-live on the technical outcome — adoption depth and scoping the next workflow. Sales owns the account relationship and review cadence. * Partner with Sales on expansion: they lead the pursuit, you control what can be committed on scope, timeline, and capacity. * Own the SOW Approval Gate on new and expansion business — no contract or SOW goes to a customer without your sign\-off on scope, timeline, and capacity. * Build reusable delivery patterns — templates, integration components, and reference architectures that make each subsequent engagement faster. * Work with the account's Executive Advisor to bring domain expertise into scoping and validate outputs where correctness depends on it. ### Requirements \- Core Skills (Must Have) * 5\+ years owning complex enterprise technical deployments end to end — as a forward deployed engineer, technical program manager, solutions architect, or delivery lead at a technical consultancy or enterprise software company. * Technical fluency: enough depth in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns to scope work credibly and direct engineers without needing translation. Engineering or technical background required. * Scope discipline: demonstrated ability to hold a line against pressure from senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know when holding is right. * Written communication and document hygiene: scopes, exit criteria, and decisions live in writing, not in your head. * Executive presence: credible in the room with VP\- and C\-level customer sponsors at large enterprises. * Comfort with ambiguity: our customers often don't know their highest\-value use case when we arrive, and finding it is part of the job. ### Preferred/Bonus Skills (Nice To Have) * Experience with on\-premise, VPC, or air\-gapped deployments in regulated industries — pharma, life sciences, financial services, or government. * Familiarity with GxP, HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar compliance and validation frameworks. * Background at a company running a forward deployed engineering model. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML workflows, model deployment, or agent orchestration. * Track record turning one\-off engagements into repeatable delivery motions. ### What Makes You A Great Fit * You measure success by whether the customer is actually using what you built — not whether it shipped. * You'd rather say no early than deliver a bloated engagement late. * You're energized by walking into a messy enterprise environment and finding the one workflow that matters most. * You're comfortable being the most senior person in the room on delivery, and the person accountable when it goes sideways. * You want to build the function, not just work in it — this is the first Customer Delivery Lead at Salt, and the patterns you set become how we operate. * You're excited to apply your skills to AI in life sciences and support teams doing high\-impact scientific work. ### Perks And Benefits * Competitive salary based on location and experience. * Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, mental health. * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones. **Based in Southern California, Salt AI is pioneering the future of life sciences with advanced AI. Founded in 2024 by Aber Whitcomb and Jim Benedetto—veterans of MySpace, Jam City, Gravity, and Core Scientific—our leadership team brings over 15 years of collaboration. We’re not just building products, but transforming what’s possible in research and discovery. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to an inclusive team. If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI in life sciences, we'd love to connect with you.**

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** This role is in based in Houston, TX. Candidates currently located in the Houston, TX are are encouraged to apply. We're looking for a Data Engineer to design and maintain the data architecture that powers our business systems and analytics — and possess a working knowledge of AI\-powered applications as they become part of that landscape. You'll own how data is modeled, moved, and governed across the organization, and make sure that foundation is solid enough for both traditional reporting and modern AI\-driven tools to build on. This role sits at the center of a lot of cross\-functional work: you'll partner with application teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to make sure data is structured consistently, documented clearly, and trustworthy wherever it's used. **Responsibilities** Data architecture \& schema design * Design canonical, well\-documented data models for core business entities (customers, projects, products, contracts, finance, etc.) that multiple systems and teams can rely on as a single source of truth. * Evaluate and evolve schemas as the business and its systems grow — balancing new requirements against long\-term maintainability. * Establish and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices. Pipelines \& integration * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that move data reliably from source systems (ERP, CRM, operational databases, vendor feeds, files) into a cloud data warehouse. * Monitor data quality and pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data issues at the source rather than downstream. * Integrate new data sources — including third\-party platforms and vendor APIs — into the existing architecture without duplicating effort or creating conflicting versions of the same data. Data governance * Define and maintain data classification standards (e.g., what counts as sensitive financial, contractual, or customer data) and ensure those standards are applied consistently across systems. * Support access control and audit requirements by ensuring data lineage and usage are traceable. * Maintain a data dictionary and related documentation so other teams can find and trust the data they need. AI\-aware data engineering * Design data structures and access patterns with an understanding of how they'll be consumed — including by AI/LLM\-powered applications that rely on well\-scoped, accurate context rather than raw database access. * Apply minimum\-necessary\-data principles when structuring data that will be surfaced through AI features, in partnership with application and security teams. * Stay current enough on how retrieval\-augmented generation and LLM context assembly work to make informed schema and access decisions — this is a working\-knowledge requirement, not a machine learning role. Collaboration * Work with engineering, product, and business teams to translate reporting and application needs into sound data models. * Act as a technical resource and point of contact for data\-related questions across multiple concurrent projects. **Technical Skills** **Required** * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or data architecture, including hands\-on schema/data model design in a production environment. * Strong SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and MSFT SQL Server preferred) * Experience SQL query language * Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. * Solid understanding of data governance fundamentals: classification, access control, and documentation practices. * Working knowledge of how modern AI/LLM applications consume data — context windows, retrieval\-augmented generation, and the basics of why minimizing and scoping data matters for these systems. * Strong communication skills; comfortable being the person other teams come to for data questions. Preferred * Experience in a distribution, industrial supply, or ERP\-adjacent environment. * Familiarity with integrating third\-party SaaS platforms via API. * Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions) and cloud application environments (e.g., AWS). * Experience consolidating multiple existing data models into a shared standard. Nice to have * Exposure to BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) and how they consume the underlying data model. * Working knowledge of Python **Company Statement:** PSS Industrial provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Lead

Leads complex data platform initiatives, sets engineering direction, and drives the maturity of data infrastructure across the organization. The IT Data Engineering Lead is a recognized subject\-matter expert who operates with minimal supervision and is the primary point of accountability for an area of IT data engineering work. Decisions impact function\-wide results. This job proactively addresses undefined problems, makes recommendations that influence functional strategy, and synthesizes input across multiple stakeholder groups. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design and delivery of enterprise data platform initiatives, setting architectural direction and owning technical quality from design through production. * Define engineering standards, data modeling practices, and platform governance frameworks for data engineering. * Serve as the primary technical authority for data platform design decisions, advising IT leadership and data architects. * Drive data platform modernization and cloud adoption efforts, developing strategic recommendations for senior leadership. * Own vendor and tool relationships for core data engineering platforms, managing roadmap alignment and escalations. * Identify data architecture gaps, technical debt, and improvement opportunities, developing actionable recommendations. * Mentor senior data engineers and build technical capability across the data engineering team. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $113,346\.00 to $178,968\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: Data Strategist
jobs.description: Method is a global design and engineering consultancy founded in 1999\. We believe that innovation should be meaningful, beautiful and human. We craft practical, powerful digital experiences that improve lives and transform businesses. Our teams \[based in New York, Charlotte, Atlanta, London, Bengaluru, Tokyo, and remote] work with a wide range of organizations in many industries, including Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Automotive, Aviation, and Professional Services. Method is part of GlobalLogic, a digital product engineering company. GlobalLogic integrates experience design and complex engineering to help our clients imagine what's possible and accelerate their transition into tomorrow's digital businesses. GlobalLogic is a Hitachi Group Company. We are seeking a Data Strategist to join our dynamic Data \& AI team. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, data, and emerging AI/ML capabilities to identify and shape high\-value opportunities for organizational transformation. We are looking for a candidate who combines the problem\-framing, stakeholder leadership, and strategic thinking of a business strategist with enough technical fluency in data systems, machine learning, and software architecture to evaluate how technology can support business objectives. You should be able to assess the capabilities and limitations of existing systems, evaluate proposed technical approaches, and identify the dependencies, risks, and organizational changes required to turn an AI or data initiative into a viable product or business capability. This person will work across business, product, technology, data, and design teams to translate ambiguous business opportunities into actionable transformation strategies and technically credible roadmaps. Travel for team and client meetings is required, typically up to 15%. **We're building our talent community for future opportunities on this team. While we aren't hiring for an immediate opening today, we anticipate future needs and would love to connect with talented people who may be a great fit when the right opportunity arises.** #### **Responsibilities** * Work with multidisciplinary teams through complex projects, planning, conducting and interpreting business strategy activities to inform the direction of the product. Methods will include any/all of the business strategy tools, adapted for the client and context. * Identify opportunities where data, ML, and AI can create meaningful business value and use business objectives and customer needs to refine those opportunities and use cases with measurable outcomes. * Evaluate the current\-state data and technology landscape supporting proposed business initiatives, including how data is captured, stored, governed, and consumed across enterprise systems. * Maintain expertise across ML and AI paradigms, from traditional models to generative and agentic systems to determine feasibility and fit for proposed AI/ML solutions * Develop data, AI, and technology transformation strategies that connect near\-term initiatives to longer\-term organizational capabilities. * Create current\-state and future\-state capability maps, dependency maps, and transformation roadmaps. Define and create experiments, prototypes, and proof\-of\-concepts that can reduce uncertainty before significant investment. * Communicate technical concepts and architectural tradeoffs to non\-technical executives and business stakeholders and business objectives, constraints, and outcomes to technical teams. #### **Qualifications** * Experience in business strategy, digital transformation, product strategy, technology strategy, or a related discipline. * Experience in evaluating AI applications, identifying risks, and uncovering opportunities for enhancement. * Strong understanding of how modern data systems support business processes and analytical or AI capabilities. * Working knowledge of machine learning concepts and the ML development lifecycle. * Ability to prototype and create working proof\-of\-concept demonstrations with working code and systems integration. * Ability to evaluate technical proposals and experience working directly with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams, and business leaders. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into actionable strategies. * Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. An ability to communicate effectively across executive, business, and technical audiences. * Ability to operate in a fast moving environment and comfort with ambiguity and uncertainty #### **Technical Fluency** The Data Strategist is a part of the Data and AI team and you may be asked to create functional prototypes in Python, JavaScript, but this role requires more technical fluency than deep production implementation expertise. You should be comfortable with learning and discussing client requirements around: * Data storage paradigms like relational databases, data warehouses, and data lakes * Data models and schemas at the conceptual, logical, and physical levels * Data pipelines, batched versus streaming data, and ingestion architectures like ETL and ELT * Cloud data platforms and platforms for business intelligence and analytics * Machine learning workflows, including training, evaluation, and deployment * Generative AI, AI agents, and tool\-using systems * Data security, privacy, and governance **Why Method?** We look for individuals who are smart, kind and brave. Curious people with a natural ability to think on their feet, learn fast, and develop points\-of\-view for a constantly changing world find Method an exciting place to work. Our employees are excited to collaborate with dispersed and diverse teams that bring together the best in thinking and making. We champion the ability to listen, and believe that critique and dissonance lead to better outcomes. We believe everyone has the capacity to lead and look for proactive individuals who can take and give direction, lead by example, enjoy the making as much as they do the thinking, especially at senior and leadership levels. We believe in work/life balance. Seriously. We offer a ton of competitive perks, including: * Continuing education opportunities * Flexible PTO and work\-from\-home policies * Pension * Health and dental benefits * Company lunches, company outings, along with a lot of snacks * Health and wellness programs * Other location specific perks (just ask!) #### **Next Steps** If Method sounds like the place for you, please submit an application. Also, let us know if you have a presence online with a portfolio, GitHub, Dribbble or other platform. * *For information on how we process your personal data please see* *Privacy**.* * *If you are a California resident, more details on how we process your personal information can be found in the CCPA Recruitment Privacy Notice (**https://www.globallogic.com/privacy/ccpa\-recruitment\-privacy\-notice/**)"* *Colorado Applicants (Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act Disclosure): The starting salary range for this role to be performed in Colorado is estimated to be between* *$165,000* *to* *$205,000* *annually. This salary range is specific to Colorado residents only, and provided as a general estimate. The amount offered may be higher or lower. Method takes many factors into making an offer, including candidate qualifications, work experience, operational needs, travel and onsite requirements, internal peer equity, prevailing wage, responsibilities, and other market and business considerations.* *New York City Applicants (New York City Local Law 32; Pay Transparency Law): The starting salary range for this role to be performed in New York City is from* *$185,000* *to* *$225,000**. This salary range is specific to New York City residents only, and provided as a general, good faith estimate. The amount offered may be higher or lower. Method takes many factors into making an offer, including candidate qualifications, work experience, operational needs, travel and onsite requirements, internal peer equity, prevailing wage, responsibilities, and other market and business considerations.*

This role ensures that desktop systems and network environments are operating efficiently and that clients receive prompt and effective technical assistance. The position also includes troubleshooting, software configuration, and hardware support to ensure a seamless work environment. **Responsibilities:** * Fulfill incident and service requests as assigned, following standard help desk procedures. * Document all interactions with business clients, including requests, statuses, and resolutions of incidents. * Perform planned maintenance, moves, adds, and changes as needed. * Maintain and support standard software and desktop OS configurations, including troubleshooting, loading and configuring software images, supported applications, and drivers. * Research business client questions using available resources to identify solutions. * Create and maintain accurate documentation for software, hardware, and troubleshooting procedures. * jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a skilled DevSecOps Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing our software infrastructure, ensuring security integration throughout the development lifecycle, and supporting operational excellence. Your expertise will help us deliver reliable, secure, and scalable software solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional eager to contribute to secure software development practices while supporting team growth through training and collaboration. Pay: From $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Entry Level Water/Wastewater Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** About this opportunity Laberge Group, a 60\+ year fixture in New York State municipal engineering, is now part of Artheon and the Trilon Group. We're looking for an Associate Engineer to start a career in municipal water and wastewater engineering, working alongside licensed engineers on real infrastructure projects for Capital District municipalities. This role includes a seat in Blueprint, Artheon's early career development program for engineers with 0\-4 years of experience. Over six months you'll get structured mentorship, exposure to project delivery, and a clear path toward EIT certification and PE licensure. About Artheon Artheon is a trusted engineering and consulting firm offering services that rival large organizations while maintaining the personalized client relationships of a boutique firm. With expertise spanning civil/site engineering, environmental permitting, transportation infrastructure, construction management, and advanced surveying technologies, we are committed to delivering high\-quality, timely solutions to local, state, and federal clients. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Assist project engineers with calculations, drawings, and technical documentation for water and wastewater projects * Support field data collection, surveying, and site investigations under supervision * Learn municipal engineering fundamentals, including NYSDOH, DEC, and EFC regulatory processes * Take on increasing project responsibility as skills and experience develop * Participate in firm\-supported preparation for the FE exam and EIT certification ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** * B.S. in Civil or Environmental Engineering (recent graduate or graduating within the next several months) * No PE or EIT required. Active pursuit of EIT certification within the first year is expected * Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D or similar design software preferred * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Willingness to learn municipal water and wastewater engineering fundamentals ### **Benefits** The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. Artheon offers a competitive compensation package including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, educational assistance program and paid time off/parental leave. ### **About Artheon** Deliver transformative infrastructure solutions that strengthen communities, drive sustainable growth, and accelerate our people’s careers—to provide value added services for our clients by combining local knowledge with national expertise.

jobs.description: **NOW HIRING: Estimator II \-** *Commercial Construction — Design/Build* LOCATION: Charlotte NC EXPERIENCE: 3\+ Years Commercial PM MARKETS: Mission Critical, Financial, Health, Energy \& More McFarland Construction is a full\-service commercial construction firm specializing in general contracting, design/build, and construction management services. We deliver high\-quality projects across a wide range of markets, including Financial Services, Health Sciences, Energy, Mission Critical, and the Public Sector. Founded in 2010, McFarland has grown to become the largest African American\-owned general contractor in the Carolinas. Headquartered in Charlotte, NC, with regional offices in Raleigh, NC and Indianapolis, IN, we continue to expand our footprint and impact throughout the Southeast and Midwest. **We're proud to be ranked \#18 Largest General Contractor in Charlotte, \#4 Fastest\-Growing Private Company in the region, and among the Top General Contractors in U.S., Southeast, and Midwest** *If you're looking for your next career move and want to be part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking, and fast\-growing company, McFarland Construction is the place for you. Join us and help shape the future of construction.* **Position Summary** To lead and/or support pre\-construction in detailed take\-off, trade partner recruiting/solicitation, and development of budget/bidding deliverables to procure new business with existing and emerging client opportunities. * The successful candidate will support and represent the company with a high degree of accuracy and expertise related to estimating during the preconstruction phase of design\-build projects and pricing for new opportunities. * Interface with Pre\-Construction Manager, Marketing Coordinator, Safety Specialists, Operations Team, Clients, Design \& Trade Partners, as well as other Industry Representatives. * Ensure that technical specs and designs requirements are properly accounted for, feasible, and consistent with industry standards. **Key Responsibilities include:** * Provide a detailed and carefully thought\-out preliminary cost estimate, based on client provided documents and interviews. * Responsible for conceptual, schematic, design development estimates, GMPs, lump sum bidding, and public bid package assembly. * Perform conceptual estimating, given limited information via a narrative and SD or space plan level drawings. * Ability to create strategic bid lists to maximize competitive participation on bid day. * Candidate must be knowledgeable in the majority of the following: site construction \& utilities systems, building foundation and structural systems, structural and miscellaneous metals, casework, door assemblies, specialties, interior finishes, exterior building wall systems, mechanical, electrical, fire protection, and fire alarm systems and the costs of these systems. * Ability to successfully create bid packages/strategize to meet diverse trade partner goals. * Ability to provide support in a design build or design\-assist\-build project from SDs to CDs, meeting the client’s budget. * Ability to create and manage a value engineering log with quick cost studies when necessary. * Ability to write public bid packages/scopes of work. * Ability to be aggressive on providing custom solutions as they present themselves related to cost, lead times, material substitutions to name a few. * Ability to critically think when pressed with finding trade partner coverage on bid day, including confident \& accurate internal budgeting to create a plug. * Work with the Operations team on project schedule, logistics, safety, constructability reviews, general conditions, and general requirements. * Ability to provide high level overview of a project schedule and feasibility. * Collaborate with safety representatives to ensure proper risk mitigation, techniques, and considerations are incorporated in the Pre\-Construction plans/budgets. * Ability to generate and manage RFI logs. * Write, assumptions, clarifications, and proposal letters. * Must be passionate, flexible, and adaptable with collaborating both internally and externally with operations team, design teams, and joint venture partners. * Support estimating, scheduling, and purchasing functions as they relate to the Pre\-Construction phase of the project. * Participate in project meetings with owner, architect, and engineers. Review and provide feedback on all project budget aspects. * Review all drawings and specifications, to accurately report any issues and/or inconsistencies to architects’ attention. * Resolves cost discrepancies by collecting and analyzing data. * Maintains quality service. * Maintain continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and ongoing requests. * Keep up to date of professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing networks, and participating in professional societies. * Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects concurrently to meet deadlines. * Periodic travel to attend pre\-bid meetings, site evaluations, and offsite meetings. * Ability to multitask with items outside of estimating. * Ability to listen and communicate with various people \& roles within their respective companies. * Ability and passion for working in a team environment. **Education \& Additional Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or business school. * Minimum of 3 years of commercial construction estimating or related experience with a mechanical, electrical, or plumbing contractor, preferred. * Minimum of 3 years commercial preconstruction experience with a General Contractor preferred but not required. * Must be able to read plans, specs, and generate estimates. * Demonstrated ability to thoroughly understand drawings and specifications, general contract and subcontract documents, materials, means and methods. * Experience with estimating ground up and interior renovations projects with a general contractor. * LEED experience preferred. * Advance expertise in Microsoft Office, On\-screen Takeoff, and Bluebeam software knowledge. * Experience with online bidding platforms, such as: Total Bid and/or Power Advocate is preferred. * Must be able to manage tight deadlines and the responsibility of accurately forecasting the budget for a project. * Must be passionate about working on a collaborative team. * Must be self\-motivated with a strong work ethic. * Strong and concise speaker/presenter * Strong verbal and written communication skills required. * Strong math and analytical skills. * Strong and creative problem\-solving skills. **We're looking for someone who requires minimal training and can step in to immediately run projects with confidence.** **Why McFarland Construction** At McFarland, you are not just managing projects, you are leading them with real ownership, visibility, and impact. We offer a strong, competitive benefits package designed to support you and your family at every stage of life. **Health \& Wellness** * Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage options (PPO \& HSA plans) * Employer HSA contribution: up to $50/month * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for 24/7 confidential support **Financial Security** * Competitive pay * 401(k) Safe Harbor Plan with company match * Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance at no cost * Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability coverage options * Health Savings Account (HSA) with tax advantages * Work\-Life \& Family Support * PTO available after your first pay cycle * Flexible benefit choices for individuals and families after 30 days * Employee referral bonus program * Charitable contribution matching: up to $100 annually **Ready to build your future with us?** Community • Commitment • Collaboration Apply today and join a team that hires people who are Hungry, Humble, and Smart. **Agency \& Third\-Party Recruiter Notice** *McFarland Construction will not be responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Resumes submitted by agencies without a signed recruiting agreement or without a specific requisition authorization shall be deemed the property of McFarland Construction, and the company reserves the right to contact, interview, and hire those candidates without payment of any fees or commissions.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Method Security** ------------------------- Method Security is dedicated to reshaping cybersecurity in an era where AI\-driven threats are growing rapidly. Our mission is to defend critical institutions—such as government, defense, and key commercial sectors—against these sophisticated threats by building cutting\-edge, autonomous defense solutions. We bring together expertise in AI, cybersecurity, and software to create products that seek to finally shift the advantage in security from offense to defense. **Our Team and Values** ----------------------- Joining Method means becoming part of an elite, mission\-driven team that values innovation, transparency, and high standards. We work with purpose, embracing diverse perspectives and experiences while maintaining a high bar for quality. Our team is built around trust, efficiency, and respect. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully. We believe in small, focused teams capable of tackling complex challenges and achieving outsized results. At Method, you’ll have the autonomy to drive projects forward, the support to navigate challenges, and the opportunity to shape the future of cybersecurity. **Role Overview** ----------------- As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Method Security, you will bring world\-class engineering talent directly into the environments where our most critical users operate. You’ll embed with high\-value customer teams, sit alongside them as they encounter real operational pain, and rapidly translate those insights into product. This is a deeply technical role: you will ship code daily \- while navigating mission constraints, earning user trust, and pushing the boundaries of what the Method platform can do. Acting as Method’s engineering tip of the spear, FDEs identify valuable and repeatable workflows in the field, validate them through working prototypes, and channel those insights back into the core platform. Your work directly expands Method’s capabilities and ensures that our most sophisticated users feel understood, empowered, and supported by the product. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Embed with users on\-site to observe workflows firsthand and internalize their operational context. * Rapidly prototype and iterate on new product capabilities based on real user pain and opportunity. * Commit high\-quality code that extends and strengthens the Method platform. * Identify valuable, repeatable workflows and validate them through working software. * Communicate clearly and frequently with the engineering team on hypotheses, tradeoffs, and blockers. * Navigate customer constraints—access controls, environmental restrictions, and security requirements—to build trust and unlock deeper workflows. * Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Security Engineers, and Mission Operations to refine insights and transform prototypes into scalable product abstractions. **Qualifications** ================== * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems. * Ability to rapidly understand new domains, customer workflows, and operational environments. * Demonstrated experience owning projects end\-to\-end—from discovery to deployment. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey insights and technical decisions concisely. * Comfort operating autonomously and making informed decisions in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. **Nice to Haves** ================= * Exposure to distributed systems, backend development, or full\-stack engineering. * Interest in security competitions, CTFs, or related technical pursuits. * Experience navigating secure facilities or constrained deployment environments. * Prior experience in a forward\-deployed, field engineering, or embedded engineering role. Base Salary Range: $140,000\-$190,000

jobs.title: Founding Mid-Training/RL Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Large\-Scale Mid\-Training/RL Infrastructure Engineer** **Location:** Onsite in Palo Alto **Compensation:** Competitive Salary \+ Equity ### **About Peano AI** Peano AI is building the infrastructure and application stack for the next generation of agentic AI systems. We believe token usage will grow exponentially over the coming years, but routing all inference and training through closed model providers will remain too expensive for many users and enterprises. Our thesis is that agentic applications require a vertically integrated stack: high\-throughput, cost\-efficient serving and training infrastructure paired with an application layer designed for long\-running, agentic workloads. Peano AI is building the Agent Cloud, a serving and training infrastructure platform purpose\-built for agentic workloads, long\-context inference, large\-scale open\-source model deployment, and pretraining of our own foundation model. By combining infrastructure and application design, we aim to make open\-source models and custom foundation models significantly more performant, practical, and competitive. ### **About This Role** We are looking for a Large\-Scale Mid\-Training/RL Infrastructure Engineer to help build, optimize, and scale out our in\-house foundation model training stack, with an emphasis on both core pretraining and RL\-enhanced methods. This role is deeply technical and directly impacts Peano AI's core model product. **You will have a rare opportunity to design and run distributed infrastructure at massive scale using thousands of the latest NVIDIA GB300, VR200 GPUs, and next\-generation TPU v7x accelerators.** You'll tackle ambitious optimization and scaling challenges with state\-of\-the\-art compute. You will architect, scale, and tune the distributed and accelerator\-aware training infrastructure for massive language models, including data pipelines, model sharding, checkpointing, rollout and reward\-based RL, and overall system throughput. Experience with large\-scale model pretraining and mid\-training interventions is required. Preferred experience with frameworks such as Megatron, Transformer\-Engine, verl, slime, and related large\-scale training and RL toolkits. Familiarity with training pipeline scaling, mixed\-precision, memory optimization, and deep understanding of both supervised and RL\-based training cycles is essential. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build, optimize, and scale the distributed training infrastructure for Peano AI’s foundation models, leveraging thousands of NVIDIA GB300/VR200 GPUs and TPU v7x accelerators for high throughput and efficiency. * Own and improve throughput, efficiency, scalability, cost, and reliability of end\-to\-end pretraining and RL pipelines. * Architect distributed data loading, sharding, checkpointing, batching, and accelerator utilization for multi\-node LLM training at unmatched scale. * Integrate and optimize RL components: rollout, reward modeling, environment orchestration, and mid\-training signal injections. * Work with and extend frameworks such as Megatron, Transformer\-Engine, verl, slime, and other high\-performance training libraries. * Tune memory usage, mixed\-precision, and runtime performance for massive models and long\-context workloads. * Debug and profile training performance bottlenecks—across model code, distributed compute, networking, and infrastructure. * Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and research teams to ensure our foundation models deliver on performance and functionality. * Translate research prototypes and experimental features into production\-ready, scalable training systems that operate across state\-of\-the\-art compute clusters. ### **Qualifications** * Significant experience with large\-scale deep learning model training and distributed system design, including large GPU/TPU clusters (GB300/VR200, TPU v7x or similar). * Proven track record of pretraining and/or RL\-based fine\-tuning of large models (LLMs or comparable scale). * Deep familiarity and hands\-on experience with frameworks such as Megatron, Transformer\-Engine, verl, slime, or similar large\-scale/foundation\-model toolkits. * Experience with data pipeline design, model/data/optimizer sharding, checkpointing, rollout/reward design, and training operations at scale. * Strong accelerator (NVIDIA GB300/VR200 GPUs, TPU v7x) and memory In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize human\-in\-the\-loop processes to enhance machine learning models and autonomous system performance. experience with 3D modeling for product design is essential. * Strong scripting skills in Python, MATLAB, C\+\+, or similar languages for automation and data analysis tasks. * Knowledge of programmable logic controllers (PLCs), fire protection systems, building code analysis, and construction experience is desirable. * Familiarity with GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing), schematics creation, technical troubleshooting, and laboratory research methods. * Excellent project management skills with the ability to coordinate schedules across multiple teams while maintaining attention to detail. * Effective cross\-functional communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with engineers from diverse disciplines including manufacturing, civil construction, mining or research sectors. * Experience working with data collection tools such as 3D scanners or laboratory instrumentation is a plus.
