jobs.title: Senior Principal, Technology Consulting (m/f/x)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Who We Are** AmaliTech is a global consulting and technology services provider, enabling businesses to scale their digital capabilities, accelerate innovation, and bridge critical tech talent gaps. With a team of over 500 professionals operating across Germany, the US, Ghana, and Rwanda, we blend the strategic insight of tier\-one consulting expertise with the technical excellence of certified software engineers and data scientists to deliver digital solutions at globally competitive rates. Our services \- spanning consulting, AI, data analytics, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, web \& app development, and managed services \- are tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients while ensuring smooth, real\-time collaboration across global teams. As a social business, we reinvest our surplus into initiatives that advance skill\-building and inclusion in the tech space in sub\-Saharan Africa. **What AmaliTech Offers** * **Startup\-level ownership and decision\-making:** This practice is less than a year old, and you are joining early enough to shape it. We move fast, with flat hierarchies, quick decision\-making, and low bureaucracy. * **Unusually high ownership from the start:** From early on, you will own your client account(s), oversee your delivery teams, and have the opportunity to contribute to our business development. * **Accelerated leadership trajectory:** This role is designed for someone ready to make the transition from leading workstreams to leading engagements, from supporting client relationships to owning them, and from contributing to a consulting practice to helping build one. * **Senior mentorship:** Direct mentorship and support from our CEO (Martin Hecker, former Senior Partner at BCG, where he led the Technology Advantage practices across CEMA and the United States) and our COO (Christian Ruckteschler, formerly at BCG and the World Bank Group, and a graduate of Harvard University and the University of Oxford). * **Tech \& AI innovation:** Alongside our partners (including AWS, Microsoft, Anthropic, and others), we use AI both as a client value\-creation lever and within our own delivery model. We care less about AI strategy decks than about applications, workflows, and operating changes that actually get deployed. * **International exposure, focused travel:** With our team and clients spread across Germany, the US, Ghana, and Rwanda (with additional locations in planning), your work will be truly global from day one and include regular travel opportunities. Unlike traditional consulting setups, our travel is focused and periodic – you are not expected to be on\-site with clients on a weekly basis. * **A mission\-driven workplace:** We exist to reposition Africa on the global technology map and to foster tech ecosystems that generate opportunity and prosperity for generations to come. This is not a side narrative but is anchored in our business model and ownership structure. **Job Description** **About The Role** We are building a technology consulting practice focused on private\-equity\-backed companies and technology\-enabled value creation. Founded in 2026 by our CEO and COO – both former BCG consultants – the practice is growing rapidly. You will join at a stage where the operating model, methodologies, team structure, propositions, and client portfolio are still being built, giving you the opportunity to help shape them alongside us. Typical engagements in this practice include: * Identifying and prioritizing tech\-enabled value creation levers for portfolio companies * Building data platforms and AI\-driven analytics capabilities * Delivering KPI dashboards and reporting for senior management and investors * Developing AI\-enabled applications and automation * Overseeing large transformation programs (e.g., ERP migrations) You will combine the strategic outlook of a trusted advisor to senior executives and investors with the hands\-on discipline of owning technical implementation and delivery oversight – a role that shapes a client's digital agenda from the boardroom to the build. Building this practice also means growing it from within, developing ambitious young tech professionals from our locations in Ghana and Rwanda into capable consultants and future leaders of our consulting practice. Every engagement we deliver contributes directly to building globally competitive tech ecosystems and career opportunities in our African locations. **What You'll Own** *You are not expected to have done all of this independently before. We expect you to grow into this level of responsibility quickly, initially with close support from our CEO and COO.* * **Client relationships:** You will quickly grow into primary ownership of selected client relationships, initially working closely alongside our CEO and COO. * **Engagement leadership:** You will run engagements end to end, including scope, timeline, budget, and risk. * **Escalations:** You will manage escalations directly, including situations where a vendor or workstream is underperforming. * **Commercial ownership:** You will help turn successful delivery into lasting client relationships – identifying follow\-on opportunities, shaping proposals and scopes, and protecting engagement economics. * **Practice development:** You will help build the technology consulting practice itself, including developing junior and mid\-level consultants from our Ghana and Rwanda hubs into future members of the practice. * **Technical translation:** You will translate business requirements into scoped, deliverable work for our engineering teams, and translate technical constraints back into terms clients can act on. * **AI\-forward delivery:** You will help clients identify where AI and automation genuinely create value, then ensure our delivery teams build toward it. * **Team leadership:** You will lead cross\-functional delivery teams – including engineers, business analysts, and data specialists – based in our African delivery centres. **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For** The common denominator we are looking for is not a particular employer or technology stack: you have combined structured problem\-solving with real technology delivery and are ready to grow from leading major workstreams into owning engagements and client relationships. * 3\-7 years of relevant experience, although trajectory matters more to us than years served. Typically, you will have built your foundation in: + Technology consulting + Digital transformation + Technology\-enabled delivery + IT program management / ERP transformation + Or adjacent fields * **Demonstrated project management rigour**, including experience running structured PMO processes on complex, multi\-workstream engagements. * **A demonstrated bias for ownership:** comfort taking on ambiguous problems and running toward them rather than waiting for a framework or someone else's sign\-off. * **Genuine appetite for delivery, not only advisory work:** you want to be there at go\-live, not just at the recommendation stage. * **Comfort translating between business and technical stakeholders:** you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to have sat close enough to technical delivery to speak the language credibly. * **Stakeholder management:** evidence that you can independently manage senior client stakeholders, with the judgment and presence to grow into primary ownership of C\-level relationships. * **Evidence of commercial instinct:** you understand that good delivery must also create client value and sustainable engagement economics, and can spot opportunities, manage scope, and contribute to shaping follow\-on work. * **A passion for team development and intercultural teaming:** you are excited to work with international delivery teams and to develop talented colleagues from Ghana and Rwanda into strong consultants and future practice leaders. **Strong plusses (not all required):** * Prior exposure to private equity portfolio companies: value creation planning, 100\-day plans, due diligence, or investor/deal\-team reporting. * Experience on an ERP or major enterprise systems of record implementation * German language fluency, given our client base. * Experience directing distributed or offshore/nearshore delivery teams. * Exposure to applied AI or automation initiatives inside enterprise settings. **Additional Information** **Location \& Travel** * Hybrid, based in Germany or the US. * Regular presence at one of our office locations (Cologne, Germany, or Houston, US) * Occasional travel to client sites. * Occasional travel to your teams in Ghana and Rwanda. **How To Apply** Click on "**I'm interested**" to apply. Documents required for applying: * Current CV * Certifications * References (minimum 2\) **Hiring Process** * Application * Online Interviews * Job offer For any enquiries, reach out via nina.gebauer@amalitech.com or richard.botchway@amalitech.com.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Payments & Fraud Prevention, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you passionate about building machine learning systems that protect one the world's largest cloud platform? The AWS Payments \& Fraud Prevention (P\&FP) Science team is looking for a driven Applied Scientist to help safeguard AWS and its millions of customers from evolving fraud threats. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy end\-to\-end machine learning models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity. You will work with massive, real\-world datasets across the AWS payments, signup and usage ecosystem, develop new detection strategies, and take models from concept to production. You will also apply Generative AI (GenAI) techniques to enhance fraud signal discovery and strengthen our detection capabilities. At AWS, we process billions of transactions every day for hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. Fraud patterns shift constantly and our defenses must stay ahead. If you enjoy owning problems end\-to\-end, shipping models that make real\-time decisions at scale, and making a direct impact on customer trust and financial protection, we invite you to join us and help shape the future of fraud prevention at AWS. Key job responsibilities Design, build, and deploy end\-to\-end machine learning models and rules to detect, prevent, and mitigate fraudulent activities across the AWS payment and usage ecosystem. Source, extract, and analyze large\-scale behavioral, transactional, and historical datasets to uncover fraud patterns and emerging threats. Apply hands\-on expertise in statistical modeling, traditional machine learning, and analytics to identify and isolate issues across the fraud landscape. Explore and apply GenAI techniques, including large language models (LLMs) and synthetic data generation, to enhance fraud detection capabilities. Own the full model lifecycle — from data extraction and feature engineering through evaluation, productionalization, and deployment. Continuously monitor model and rule performance and improve robustness against adversarial behaviors and evolving fraud tactics. Experiment, prototype, and iterate on new detection strategies, algorithms, and evaluation metrics with a focus on rapid time\-to\-production. Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Communicate findings and technical insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. Contribute to the broader fraud prevention strategy, driving innovation and best practices across the organization. A day in the life You will have the opportunity to enhance our existing models and develop new ones that have a direct impact on the business from reducing financial losses to protecting customer accounts in real time. Key job responsibilities * Define technical strategy and lead architecture for Annapurna Labs' machine learning platform, driving decisions that impact multiple product lines * Collaborate with EC2 teams and manufacturing partners to ensure seamless system integration * Own end\-to\-end qualification frameworks and processes, mentoring engineers on implementation best practices * Drive end\-to\-end qualification processes for new software implementations * Craft high\-performance solutions using C/C\+\+ running on Linux A day in the life You'll architect and develop the software and firmware that drives NeuronSwitches\- the high\-performance interconnect fabric for Trainium chips. This is hands\-on systems work\- from initial hardware bring\-up through manufacturing scale\-up. jobs.title: Sr. Startup Solutions Architect, Early Stage Startups
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Come work with the founders building what's next. Some of the most important companies of the next decade are being built right now, in Southern California, by two or three people and an idea. We're looking for someone who wants a front\-row seat to all of them, and the technical chops to help make them real. You'll work across AI/ML, FinTech, ClimateTech, healthcare, consumer, B2B SaaS, and whatever gets invented next, with many of these companies coming straight out of Y Combinator and other top accelerators or freshly backed by leading VC firms. They need a trusted technical voice in their corner from day one, and you get to be it. Picture a small team with a technical founder and maybe a couple of engineers, moving fast with Claude Code, Codex, and whatever tool shipped last week, trying to make every product, architecture, and business decision at once. There's no VP of Engineering to align with, no platform team to hand things off to, and no multi\-quarter roadmap, so for the startups you work with you become the closest thing they have to a fractional CTO or chief architect. That's what makes this an adventure rather than a support role: you and the founders are figuring it out together, and a single good decision can save six months of runway while a bad one can quietly sink the whole thing. The work is bigger than architecture, and it changes week to week. One week you're helping a team understand the architecture their coding agent quietly built for them and untangling the decisions they didn't realize they'd made, the next you're figuring out how to scale after an unexpected viral launch, and the week after that you're working a compliance problem with a FinTech startup that has to move fast but can't cut corners, or talking a founder through a hard pivot and helping them separate what they've already built from where the data says they should actually go. You'll prototype alongside them, experiment with frontier AI, and carry what you learn from hundreds of founders back into AWS so the products we build reflect what the leading edge actually needs. We hire for a specific kind of person, and it starts with founder empathy over enterprise process. You get that every dollar spent on infra is a dollar not spent on talent or growth, that their timeline is measured in months of runway, and that they're emotionally all\-in on this idea, so you earn trust by genuinely caring whether the team survives rather than by showing off enterprise\-grade architecture. That empathy shows up as survival\-first thinking: before you recommend anything, you understand their runway, their burn, their signals of product\-market fit, and their next milestone, whether that's demo day, a fundraise, or a first paying customer. To advise this well you have to see the full stack of the business, letting technical choices, product, business model, runway, and the founder's own risk tolerance all inform your recommendations, because you can't advise on architecture without understanding burn rate. You stay a builder at heart, since you don't stop being an engineer when you join this team; you prototype, write code, and get your hands dirty with new models, Bedrock, agents, and RAG because that's how you stay credible with people who build for a living. And you act as a scout for the future, spotting when a single startup's tool choice becomes a cohort\-wide trend twelve to twenty\-four months before the rest of the market, then carrying that signal back to AWS product and service teams. You don't have to already be a Solutions Architect to do this. Great people on this team have come from founding\-engineer roles, senior software engineering, AI engineering, and traditional SA backgrounds, and if you're an excellent builder who loves customers, we can teach you the AWS you need. Key job responsibilities * Act as a trusted technical advisor to a portfolio of early\-stage founders, designing architectures that are right\-sized for where they are today and built to grow if and when they scale * Get hands\-on: prototype, build reference patterns, and demo working solutions alongside founders rather than handing them a generic playbook * Help founders understand and improve the architectures their coding agents generated, making sense of the decisions and tradeoffs baked into what they've already shipped * Help startups navigate the fast\-moving GenAI landscape, from jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Sponsored Products and Brands - Advertiser Growth and Strategies
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We are looking for an Applied Scientist II to build the AI behind Auto Optimization: agentic systems that automatically optimize advertisers' campaigns on their behalf. Guided by an advertiser's standing instructions, these agents observe how a campaign is performing, reason about what to change, and act on it continuously as conditions in the marketplace shift. Optimizing a campaign well is a collection of decisions. It means working across every control an advertiser has at once: the keywords and products they target, the bids they set, the budgets they allocate, and where their ads appear, all aligned with the preferences of the advertiser. These choices are connected, since a change to targeting changes the right bid, and a change in bids changes how budget should be spent. You will build agents that make these decisions together rather than one lever at a time, and that adapt across many different campaign types and advertiser goals, from growing sales on established products to reaching new customers and launching new ones. Working backwards from the needs of millions of advertisers, you will solve ambiguous problems, invent new methods, and deliver them into a live product that manages real campaigns. You will stay deeply hands\-on with the hardest technical problems, collaborate with product and engineering partners on approach, and help raise the quality of the team's science. Key job responsibilities * Build agentic systems that automatically optimize campaigns on an advertiser's behalf, working holistically across every control they have (targeting, bids, budgets, and placements) rather than one lever at a time, and generalizing across many campaign types and advertiser goals, from scaling a proven product to reaching new customers and launching something new. * Encode the dynamics of the auction and marketplace into how the agent reasons, balancing advertiser return, shopper experience, and marketplace health. * Turn raw signal into intelligence by defining and curating the datasets that train and evaluate these agents, from campaign and marketplace data to auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search\-term performance. * Push the frontier of agent design, building the core of the agent itself: planning, tool use (for example, auction simulation, ML models, and optimization routines), and long\-horizon reasoning across decisions that interact, and writing the production\-quality, critical\-path code that carries it from prototype to launch. * Set the bar for trust by developing the evaluation and safety methods that make it trustworthy to let an agent act on live campaigns and real budgets. * Grow with a team that grows the field: contribute to our scientific agenda, learn alongside strong scientists and engineers, and share your work with the broader community. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. This team within Sponsored Products and Brands is focused on guiding and supporting millions of advertisers to meet their advertising needs of creating and managing ad campaigns. At this scale, the complexity of diverse advertiser goals, campaign types, and market dynamics creates both a massive technical challenge and a transformative opportunity: even small improvements in guidance systems can have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon's retail ecosystem. Our vision is to build a highly personalized, context\-aware agentic advertiser guidance system that leverages LLMs together with tools such as auction simulations, ML models, and optimization algorithms. This agentic framework will operate across both chat and non\-chat experiences in the ad console, scaling to natural language queries as well as autonomously managing campaigns based on deep understanding of the advertiser. To execute this vision, we collaborate closely with stakeholders across Ad Console, Sales, and Marketing to identify opportunities, from high\-level product guidance down to granular keyword recommendations, and deliver them through a tailored, personalized experience. Our work is grounded in state\-of\-the\-art agent architectures, tool integration, reasoning frameworks, and model customization approaches (including tuning, MCP, and preference optimization), ensuring our systems are both scalable and adaptive.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of building models for business application experience * PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development * Experience building high\-velocity ad products * Experience designing and deploying LLM\-based agents in production. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Colo Physical Security Engineer [Architect], Data Center Engineering, Colocation Regional Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Application deadline: Oct 3, 2026 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You will collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. At AWS you will experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Colo Physical Security Engineers \[Architects] at AWS work with our Colocation Vendor partners to design safe, secure, resilient, cost\-effective Data Center (DC) facilities. As a Colo Physical Security Engineer \[Architect], you will lead security designs for Colocation DCs throughout our Americas Region and impact AWS global colo data center security standards. You will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers, and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will provide technical guidance, have a direct impact on the design of Colo data center facilities, solve large\-scale implementation issues, and be responsible for developing and communicating security design requirements to internal and external project partners. As a Colo Physical Security Engineer \[Architect], you will work directly with other AWS Security Teams, AWS Management, and Colo Vendor partners to collaborate in the real\-world application of Physical Security throughout AWS. jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers \[air\-cooled and water\-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center. Key job responsibilities Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems. Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved. Develop BMS \& EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders. Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers. Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders. Participate in AWS global on\-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in\-service data centers. Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management. Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers. Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team. Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces. Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations. Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts. Frequently visit (locally) assigned in\-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world\-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our world\-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces. In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers. Every year, billions of packages flow through Amazon's global fulfillment network. The physical configuration of that packaging directly dictates our fulfillment velocity, robotic handling efficiency, and cross\-border marketplace compliance. Right now, our team owns one of the absolute largest, highest\-leverage cost\-reduction opportunities across the entire company: re\-architecting upstream seller packaging to unlock Multi\-Billion dollars of annual Cost to Serve (CTS) network savings entitlement. We are looking for a strategic, highly technical Principal PMT to drive our AI\-driven packaging optimization ecosystem. As the product leader of this domain, you will lead a cross\-functional pod of senior software developers, data scientists, and robotics engineers to translate complex, multimodal logistics and physics telemetry into a single, automated, one\-click optimization journey for our global selling partners. Key job responsibilities Own the Architecture \& Vision: Drive the end\-to\-end product strategy, technical roadmap, and PRD/BRD definitions for the Seller\-facing packaging platform. Turn abstract policy and engineering constraints into highly scalable, automated software features. Lead Multi\-Agent AI Integration: Partner with our Science pods to build and scale multimodal agentic systems that evaluates text metadata, 6\-sided canonical imagery, and robotic manipulation video clips to drive SIPP (Ship in Product Packaging) adoption faster. Drive Cross\-Org Alignment: Build cross\-org packaging strategy across Business and Tech with critical partner teams, including Fulfillment Tech \& Robotics (FTR) and SCOTs. Systemic Supply Chain Optimization: Oversee the technical integration of diverse optimization vectors, including the CRISP model for cube reduction, Box\-Packing Recommendations (BPR) inside the inbound workflow, and a universal global labeling panel standard that automatically unlocks multi\-marketplace compliance by default. jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Prime Video, PV Personalization and Discovery
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is a first\-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios\-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add\-on subscriptions such as Apple TV\+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM\+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best\-in\-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end\-to\-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state\-of\-the\-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast\-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill\-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science\-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next\-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video. About the team: Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short\-and long\-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI. Key job responsibilities: In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end\-to\-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi\-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long\-term customer value. You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade\-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide. Key job responsibilities * Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high\-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand. * Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed. * Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues. * Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large\-scale data processing. * Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance. * Use data\-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation. * Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs. * Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high\-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience. * Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues. * Set a best\-in\-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision\-making and proactive risk mitigation. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience * 7\+ years of technical Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules * Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition **PREFERRED jobs.title: Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Optics
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Optics operates the physical security infrastructure that protects the most sensitive computing environments on Earth: AWS data centers, Amazon corporate offices, and Leo ground stations. We manage more than 600K access control devices and 300K cameras. We integrate video management, access control, and intrusion alarming into one platform, and we strengthen it with AI analytics. Our job is to make every physical space Amazon operates continuously understood, proactively protected, and programmatically extensible. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager \- Technical (PM\-T) to own the holistic product strategy for Optics, own its profit and loss (P\&L), and drive the platform toward the future state. You will own the product narrative for the entire Optics platform, comprised of divisions for access control technology, incident response, video surveillance and analytic capabilities. You will define the product strategy that replaces a fragmented customer ecosystem with an automated, extensible platform, and you will sequence the investments that get us there. You will make sure Optics serves its internal customers first while shaping the platform foundations that keep our longer\-term options open. You will partner directly with the Optics organization leader, with directors and VPs across our customer organizations, and with security and infrastructure leaders throughout Amazon. You will operate where product strategy, physical security, and platform architecture meet. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who is comfortable with deep technical ambiguity, fluent in translating customer problems into product requirements, financially literate enough to own a P\&L and defend a cost model, and credible with both principal engineers and VP\-level stakeholders. Key job responsibilities * Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Optics platform * Own the Optics P\&L and the financial narrative * Shape the market offering * Represent the voice of the internal customer * Own the platform strategy that lets customers move at their own pace * Own the resource allocation model between platform and features * Establish the responsibility contract with customers * Write the narratives that align the organization * Define and own the metrics that measure product and business success * Raise the product bar for the organization A day in the life Your days blend deep strategic work, customer discovery, financial modeling, and cross\-organizational partnership. No two look the same, but a representative day includes: Morning \- You block your first hours for the work that needs uninterrupted focus: drafting the product strategy narrative for an upcoming leadership review. Mid\-morning \- You meet with your finance partner to pressure\-test the P\&L and refine the cost\-per\-site model, reconciling the savings that our first\-party hardware and quantifying the opportunity cost of deferring the platform investment another quarter. Afternoon \- You meet with a director from a customer organization and a peer leader from an adjacent Amazon infrastructure team. Late afternoon \- You review the platform's product and business health metrics. Cost per site is trending the right way. You draft the mechanism to track it so the signal reaches the right people to make business decisions, and close the loop with engineering to ensure the target goal is achieved. About the team Amazon Optics develops the software that gives security operators actionable situational awareness in the physical domain. Our vision is simple and ambitious: Anticipate threats. Redefine physical security. Build a safer world. We build simple, scalable systems that automate safety and security, giving security operators the tools to measure and monitor their environment. We are the singular enterprise security product that integrates the three core sectors of physical security into one platform: video management, access control, and intrusion alarming and perimeter protection. We strengthen all three with AI analytics. We eliminate hard dependencies on third\-party and disparate systems, so our customers get a cohesive, flexible solution and never need intricate knowledge of the systems underneath to get value from what we build. We protect the environments that matter most: customer data, cryptographic material, and the people who work alongside them. We do it at a scale no one else operates, and we build the cloud infrastructure it runs on. That combination is our right to win. We solve our own hardest problems first, at a scale that makes the solution durable and the economics compound. Culturally, we are a team that leads with people. We invest in growth, we celebrate wins by name, and we make sure everyone has a voice. We value builders who bring warmth alongside backbone, who can disagree and commit, and who care as much about developing the people around them as about shipping the product. We move fast ce. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, RDPI Global Engineering Hardware Development
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering Hardware team is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer II to join our Hardware Test Engineering team. This team operates in a multi\-disciplinary environment of hardware engineers, controls engineers, and test engineers dedicated to advancing sustainable packaging automation and robotics technologies that fulfill millions of customer orders every day. The Quality Assurance Engineer II is a significant and autonomous contributor who delivers high\-quality test solutions, applying appropriate test methodologies and QA best practices. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to create, execute, and optimize test plans for system\-level functional verification testing (L1\) scenarios throughout the product development process (PDP) and product lifecycle — including scenarios that may involve multiple engineering teams and where test plan requirements may not yet be defined. You will be responsible for designing reusable and reliable test solutions, defining test requirements, mitigating quality risks, mentoring junior QAEs, and driving continuous improvement of test processes and automation. These system\-level processes integrate sensors, actuators, mechanisms, controls, computer, electrical, and human interactions to deliver systems that meet and exceed customer, safety, regulatory, and business requirements. This is done through the execution and optimization of test plans, design of reusable test solutions, documentation of test results, defect management and root cause analysis, automation of data collection and analysis, and presenting results, feedback, and recommendations to cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Key job responsibilities * Create, execute, and optimize comprehensive test plans for difficult system\-level functional verification (L1\) scenarios involving multiple engineering teams and product components — including scenarios where test plan requirements may not yet be defined * Design reusable, reliable, and efficient test solutions (scripts, tools, automation) that minimize hardware resource usage and execution time * Assess the testability of product components and features (instrumentation, modularity, APIs) and identify salient test cases with traceability to use cases * Develop test plans that include non\-functional areas (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability) * Define test requirements, clear blockers, and escalate appropriately; mitigate quality risks proactively * Work to discover defects early and prevent them from occurring; drive analysis of post\-release quality and defect escapes, propose solutions, and implement improvements * Identify root causes of product quality problems and isolate the smallest set of steps to reproduce issues * Write test scripts and automated test cases that provide effective end\-to\-end coverage; ensure automation is reliable, reusable, and considers legacy impact * Optimize test plans, automated solutions, and QA metrics to improve team efficiency, product quality, and launch/time to production * Work with team owners to ensure code, components, and features are tested at the appropriate level (unit, integration/functional, UI), reducing unnecessary test cases that lead to intermittent issues or increased execution time * Actively participate in design discussions, planning, retrospective reviews, bug triage, and prioritization processes * Establish a quality bar in collaboration with your team and project teams; measure quality quantitatively against defined KPIs * Mentor and develop junior QAEs (QATs and QAE Is) — guide them on products, testing approaches, test solutions, and how they are constructed and used * Help recruit and interview for the team * Clearly document work for future generations of testers; maintain and expand lab infrastructure as needed * Travel to Amazon fulfillment centers across North America to execute tests and collect data (75% travel required) * Make trade\-offs: own time available vs. test solution extent across concurrent test program A day in the life As a Quality Assurance Engineer II on the RDPI team, you'll spend your days as an individual contributor solving difficult test challenges in lab environments and at fulfillment centers across North America. You might start your morning optimizing a test plan for a complex packaging system deployment that involves coordination across hardware, controls, and operations engineering teams — defining test requirements that haven't been fully scoped yet. Mid\-morning, you could be designing a reusable automated test solution that reduces manual execution time by 50%, ensuring it's efficient in both hardware resource usage and execution time. In the afternoon, you might lead a design discussion with cross\-functional partners to assess the testability of a new feature, then mentor a QAE I on how to structure their test cases for better coverage. You'll drive post\-release defect escape analysis, propose root cause solutions, and present quality metrics and recommendations to stakeholders. Throughout the day, you're balancing tactical test execution with strategic improvements to the team's test processes, automation, and quality metrics. About the team Our Hardware Test Engineering team operates in a highly collaborative, multi\-disciplinary environment working alongside hardware engineers, software engineers, controls engineers, data scientists, reliability engineers, and operations teams. We focus on rigorous verification and validation of packaging automation systems—from individual components to complete integrated systems—ensuring they meet customer experience, safety, regulatory, and business requirements before deployment. Our work spans the entire product development lifecycle—from early concept validation through continuous improvement of deployed systems across hundreds of fulfillment centers in North America and Europe. Our contributions directly impact Amazon's sustainability goals, operational efficiency, and the customer experience for millions of packages shipped daily.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 4\+ years of quality assurance engineering experience * Experience in automation testing * Experience in manual testing * Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium * Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Security Engineer, Security for Employee and Legal Systems (SEALS)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Security for Employee and Legal Systems (SEALS) team protects Amazon's enterprise HR and Legal applications. Millions of Amazonians use these systems to review their pay, manage their benefits, update their personal information, and handle confidential legal matters. Protecting that data is the core of what SEALS does, and the customers who depend on us are the people who work here. The applications we protect are increasingly built with GenAI, and many of them now embed GenAI features and agentic workflows of their own. That shifts the security work. You will threat model LLM\-backed applications, assess risks such as prompt injection, insecure model output handling, and over\-broad agent permissions, and secure transitive authentication as agents act on behalf of users. You will also use GenAI to scale your own delivery, from automated code review to detection authoring. SEALS delivers ambient security. Builders get security feedback while they write code, at commit time, so risks are caught and fixed during development. As a Security Engineer on SEALS, you will be an embedded partner to your builder teams and own the security outcomes for your domain. Strong candidates bring depth in application security: threat modeling, architecture and design reviews, secure code review, and hands\-on remediation. You will contribute autonomously within the team, deliver risk reduction across the full lifecycle, and mentor peers, while seeking guidance from managers and technical leaders on the hardest tradeoffs. Key job responsibilities Own the security outcomes for your assigned SEALS builder teams and the HR and Legal applications they run. Threat model GenAI and LLM\-backed applications, covering risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, data leakage through model context, and excessive agent authority. Secure agentic workflows, including transitive authentication and scoped authorization as agents act on behalf of users. Author and refine automated detection rules that catch risks at code commit and give builders a fix they can accept immediately. Use GenAI to scale delivery across your domain, including AI\-assisted code review, detection authoring, and triage. Drive paved\-path adoption (Secure CDK Blueprints, automated patching, standardized authorization, transitive authentication for agentic workflows) so preventable issues do not occur. Hunt for risk the tooling missed through adversarial analysis and manual secure code review in Java, Python, and JavaScript, then turn each escape into a new detection. Provide security architecture guidance and lead the security outcomes of design reviews for your team and customers. Prioritize remediation by business impact, and escalate to leadership when a builder wants to accept a launch\-blocking risk. Communicate security outcomes clearly, in writing and verbally, to security and service team leadership. A day in the life You are the security engineer your builder teams want in the room. On a given day you might threat model a new LLM feature for an HR application, write a detection rule that closes a gap a production finding revealed, pair with a builder to fix an authorization flaw while the code is fresh, or review the design of an agentic workflow before it ships. You articulate risk clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, prioritize pragmatically, and guide partners toward secure solutions. You mentor other engineers on the team and raise the bar around you. About the team SEALS sits within Corporate Services Security (CPSS), the Amazon security team aligned with Finance \& Global Business Services, People eXperience \& Technology, Legal, and Global Communications and Community Impact. We engage development teams early so our stakeholders can build and scale securely. Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language experience * 2\+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non\-internship) experience * 2\+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship) experience * Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics), or experience in IT Security * Knowledge of industry\-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 2\+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience * Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP * Experience with AWS products and services * Experience in scripting, programming, or security code reviewing in a common language, such as Python, Java, or C\+\+ * Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Senior Industrial Designer, WWEI- Automation
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to shape how automation products are conceived, built, and experienced by thousands of associates across Amazon's operations network? As an Industrial Designer III, you will lead the design of next\-generation automation and material\-handling products for Amazon's Middle Mile and Sub\-Same Day operations. Your work will span the full product development lifecycle — from identifying operational opportunities and sketching early concepts through prototyping, testing, design validation, and production deployment. Amazon is accelerating its investment in automation, with a growing portfolio of robotic, material\-handling, and low\-cost automation products moving from early concepts into pilots and scaled rollouts. This role gives you the chance to establish industrial design principles and standards, influence products before designs are locked, and ensure that associate experience, ergonomics, usability, and manufacturability are considered from day one alongside engineering performance. Key job responsibilities * Lead the end\-to\-end industrial design of automation and material\-handling products — from concept sketches and digital prototypes through design validation and production\-ready specifications — partnering with hardware, systems, controls, and manufacturing teams. * Define and validate design requirements by clarifying assumptions, understanding system dependencies, and making trade\-offs between scalability, manufacturability, cost, and associate experience. * Apply human factors and ergonomic principles to products such as robotic workcells, material\-handling equipment, carts, containers, and workstations, reducing safety risks and simplifying associate workflows. * Contribute to product vision and roadmap planning by identifying where to focus design efforts for the greatest operational impact, and by aligning design strategy with program goals and deployment timelines. * Mentor other designers, establish and drive adoption of design best practices, and use generative AI tools where appropriate to accelerate ideation and refine design outputs. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing prototype feedback from hardware engineering, then present concept directions to leadership in a design review. After lunch you could be refining a workcell component in CAD to meet ergonomic targets, followed by a working session with operations and safety partners to validate how associates will interact with a new piece of equipment. You will also spend time in operational sites observing real workflows, rapidly prototyping solutions, and seeing your designs perform in the field. About the team Our team of approximately 20 engineers and technical program leaders owns end\-to\-end automation product development for Amazon's Middle Mile and Sub\-Same Day networks. We bring together hardware engineering, industrial design, systems and integration engineering, software and controls, data and simulation, supply chain, and technical program management to solve problems at the complete product and system level. We work closely with Operations, Workplace Health and Safety, Robotics, Operations Technology, and external manufacturing partners. Team members split their time between product development and working directly in operational sites, giving you the chance to observe real challenges, prototype solutions on the ground, and see your designs deployed at scale.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of design \& innovation, research \& development work experience * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent * Experience with design \& innovation and research \& development * Experience in management of engineering design projects * Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of specialty (with progressive responsibility) experience * Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field * Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making * Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high\-speed manufacturing * Experience with design\-in\-safety Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. AFT forms the invisible back half of Amazon that magically turns your click of a button into packages at your door. We build and operate the software, hardware, and processes that run the global network of Fulfillment centers(ie, Amazon warehouses), which move billions of units of inventory and ensures customers get what they want when promised. We're constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating using state of the art software and hardware technologies, while keeping our associates and partners safe. We leverage the latest AWS technologies, big data approaches, and ML to build distributed, highly available systems. Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer in the 'Fulfillment Execution Services' team, you will get the opportunity to develop our next generation of foundational software, which includes orchestrating the work done by workcells(machines, robotics and associates), monitoring their state and influencing how customer orders flow through our buildings. You will have an opportunity to own design and development of distributed systems and contribute to a wide range of projects in a highly collaborative and fast\-paced environment. You will be involved in all the aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing \& delivery of your product. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high\-performance services and architectures require exceptional technical expertise. If you have that type of expertise, you are customer centric and motivated about building systems that can be operated at global scale with minimal human intervention, then we want to talk to you! Key job responsibilities * Design and Build highly scaled and efficient solutions using the latest AWS technologies and infrastructure. * Owning and Maintaining some of the most business critical systems for Amazon that support hundreds of thousands of associates and millions of customer orders per day as they travel through our Fulfillment Centers. * Work with partner teams including Product, Science, Operations and other Tech teams to understand problems, ensure solutions solve those problems and iterate once solutions are live. Use Data. We deep dive, analyze interpret and use data on a daily basis to understand problems and fine tune solutions. * More than just coding. Engineers are multi\-talented at Amazon. You might work on front end, back end, data analysis, internal tools, etc. You are encouraged to explore and invent solutions that best fit the customer problems we solve. * Hire and Develop the Best. Deeply involved in the hiring process as well as onboarding and mentoring less experienced engineers. Also continuously learning and developing your own skills. A day in the life * Contribution to all the aspects of the software development cycle, including scoping, design, development, testing \& delivery of your product. * Optimization. Many of our problems involve consuming large amounts of data and inputs, processing and visualizing the data and making optimization decision based on that data. * AWS. We use any and all AWS technologies including EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, CloudWatch, CloudFormation and many others. * We collaborate as a team to design and build solutions using a variety of languages and technologies on a daily basis. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle\-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment. Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast. The IVS Stream Management team builds and operates the distributed systems that coordinate stream sessions end\-to\-end and keep the underlying fleet healthy under bursty, unpredictable load. As a software engineer on this team, you'll design and build systems that start and manage live streams for millions of viewers worldwide — working on systems that sit behind the customer\-facing APIs and make every live stream possible. Key job responsibilities * Own the technical direction of one or more services in the Stream Management portfolio; write the design docs, socialize them across IVS and adjacent teams, and drive them to implementation. * Work closely with engineers, product managers, and applied scientists to deliver seamless customer experiences. * Ensure backend systems are highly available, scalable, and secure at AWS scale. * Apply backend best practices including testing, performance optimization, observability, and maintainable code. * Collaborate with other AWS service teams to integrate shared services and deliver consistent AWS service experiences. * Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, and on\-call rotations. * Drive operational excellence through automation, metrics, alarms, and runbooks. * Lead post\-incident investigations for high\-severity events in our services; drive the resulting action items to completion. A day in the life You might start the morning by reviewing operational dashboards for anything anomalous in transcode start rates, then jump into a design review for a proposal to extend one of your services to a new region. Mid\-morning you pair with a teammate on a tricky race condition in stream session teardown. In the afternoon you meet with a partner team to align on a protocol change and write a short doc summarizing the tradeoffs of two capacity\-planning approaches. The work spans distributed systems, live video infrastructure, and cross\-team coordination, and no two days look the same. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon, Security is our highest priority. Our team builds products and services to continuously identify, track, and mitigate security risks in third\-party software and open source libraries across AWS. We work with the latest technologies and encourage a lifelong learning model. We are never bored and always have interesting and challenging tasks to solve. We're seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to join our AWS Vulnerability Management team, responsible for building and maintaining critical security services that help protect AWS customers and infrastructure. Our team is at the forefront of cloud security, developing innovative solutions to identify and mitigate security risks before they can be exploited. You'll be handling complex challenges related to scaling vulnerability management across AWS's ever\-growing infrastructure. This role offers the opportunity to: 1\) Build next\-generation vulnerability management systems that operate at cloud scale 2\) Design and implement machine learning\-based vulnerability prediction and prioritization mechanisms 3\) Work directly with AWS service teams to integrate security controls and vulnerability assessments 4\) Collaborate with world\-class security engineers and researchers to stay ahead of emerging threats 5\) Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and maintenance We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations: Arlington , VA USA Key job responsibilities Designing and building services that scale for millions of users and systems. Continually learn different technologies and architectures to ensure we have the correct solutions Java, Python, Big Data, Microservices etc. Solving complex problems with elegant solutions by working across teams and organizations in Amazon. Own your solutions and the entire life\-cycle, from the roadmap to the architecture to implementation and continuous iterative development. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Items and Offers Platform, Identity Performance and Defect Detection
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The PRISM (Product Identity and Semantic Matching) team is responsible for establishing product identity and attributes, lighting up the product detail page, supply chain, and fulfillment use cases across all marketplaces. The portfolio of services and products we own directly impacts both seller and buyer experiences. Being the world's largest product catalog with billions of products and billions of transactions per day, the scale our services support is massive. For years, we've solved product matching at Amazon scale through a sophisticated combination of human\-curated rules and traditional machine learning techniques applied to product data — and now, we're reimagining it all. We are at an inflection point. We are rebuilding its legacy rule\-based and classical ML matching algorithms into a new generation of LLM\-powered AI systems. This is not a research experiment — it is a production rebuild that will redefine how Amazon understands every product on the planet. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will help architect, build, and ship the AI\-native matching platform that replaces decades of accumulated logic with intelligent, language\-aware, generalizable models running at Amazon scale. You will work on genuinely hard, unsolved problems: serving LLM\-based inference over petabyte\-scale product data, meeting sub\-millisecond latency requirements in the critical path of buyer and seller experiences, and engineering systems capable of serving millions of requests per second. You will solve novel computer science problems at the intersection of large language models, retrieval, distributed systems, and large\-scale data processing — problems for which no playbook yet exists. Key job responsibilities We are looking for a customer\-focused and highly motivated software engineer to help build the software systems that will improve the quality of Earth's largest e\-commerce catalog. This role offers you the opportunity to work with collaborative leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on hundreds of millions of Amazon customers and millions of selling partners worldwide. If you are energized by taking generative AI from interesting demo to the production substrate of the world's largest catalog, this role was built for you. About the team The PRISM team advances state\-of\-the\-art GenAI to deeply understand and uniquely identify every product at Amazon scale. We build the canonical product identity and matching system that powers Amazon's universal catalog: eliminating duplicates, preventing abuse, and integrating the world's product data to power agentic shopping and trusted discovery for customers worldwide. We solve foundational challenges including schema\-agnostic multimodal understanding, efficient inference at reduced cost, and rapid innovation through automated experimentation powered by agentic systems. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Sr TPM, Fwd Deployed Engineer , Business Innovation and AI
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team within Business Innovation \& AI (BIA) is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager who builds. FDE embeds directly with teams across Amazon Global Operations Services (GOS), co\-builds with them from day one, and ships working AI\-powered solutions. Engagements range from short builds to multi\-quarter programs. The impact here is internal: you build for the GOS org, not for external customers. We increasingly look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web\-based interfaces with AI agents, so a lot of what you build will be agentic. This is an FDE role first, with a data engineering edge. The core of the job is building AI and agentic solutions embedded with operational teams. On top of that, you own the team’s data and data\-engineering strategy and infrastructure, the pipelines and architecture and data\-quality decisions our AI work depends on. This is a builder role. We’re looking for people who are already shipping AI solutions with the current generation of tooling, not people who are newly exploring AI or have only done some prompt engineering. The engineers who do well here are hands\-on with agentic harnesses like Claude Code, Kiro, and Codex, and are plugged into the AI builder community closely enough to know what changed this month. Key job responsibilities Build AI \& Agentic Solutions, Embedded (the primary work) * Embed with GOS operational teams, co\-build from day one, and ship AI\-powered solutions that change how work gets done * Look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web\-based interfaces with AI agents, and build those agents end to end * Build with the current AI tooling yourself, including agentic harnesses (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex), LLM application frameworks, and RAG, and take prototypes to production Program Delivery * Drive the planning, coordination, and delivery of FDE’s AI programs, managing risk and dependencies without relying on direct authority * Turn ambiguous operational problems into shipped solutions, and own the longer\-horizon programs where the answer takes more than one build cycle Data \& Data\-Engineering Strategy (the DE edge) * Own the team’s data and data\-engineering strategy and infrastructure: the architecture, technology choices, and roadmap our AI work depends on * Make the calls on how operational data becomes AI\-ready, and keep data quality, lineage, and freshness where the team can trust it * Connect source data to what the customer actually needs: find the right source, get the subscription in place, and build the pipeline that keeps it flowing * Make and defend the opinionated architecture calls (lakehouse vs. warehouse, batch vs. streaming, how far to normalize a domain), grounded in each use case Raising the Bar * Define the reusable patterns and standards that raise the bar for the whole team, and mentor engineers on them A day in the life You start the morning embedded with an operations team, working through a manual workflow you’re replacing with an agent. By mid\-morning you’re building against it with current tooling and putting the next iteration in front of them. In the afternoon you switch to the data side, making the call on how a new data domain gets modeled and subscribed into the platform so the agent has what it needs. You close the day reviewing a teammate’s design against the patterns you set, and re\-cutting the roadmap for a program that has two quarters left to run. About the team Business Innovation \& AI (BIA) finds the hardest, highest\-value problems across Amazon Global Operations Services and builds AI\-powered solutions that measurably change how work gets done. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is BIA’s technical execution arm: a small, senior team with high autonomy and a bias for shipping. We embed with operational teams in the GOS org, co\-build from day one, ship working solutions, and hand scalable patterns off to the broader organization. We don’t just automate the existing process; we redesign the work around what AI and agents make possible.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of technical program management experience * Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale * Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms * Experience with SQL and Python scripting * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent * Experience with AWS data services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, or an equivalent cloud data stack) * Experience driving technical programs across multiple teams without direct authority **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience defining and driving an analytics roadmap * 5\+ years of data modeling experience * A track record of shipping bespoke AI and agentic solutions from scratch, and active engagement in AI builder communities * Experience building AI agents that replace manual or UI\-driven workflows * Familiarity with Amazon’s internal data ecosystem (Andes, data subscriptions, and getting access to source data across orgs) * Fluency with the current GenAI tooling landscape (Amazon Bedrock, agent frameworks, LLM\-powered workflows) * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform) * Experience with real\-time or streaming data infrastructure (Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) * Experience mentoring engineers and defining reusable patterns that scale beyond a single team Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
