jobs.title: Sr. Regional Environmental Engineer, AWS Environmental Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental professionals who play a leading role in environmental permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. The work of our Regional Environmental Engineers is critical to enabling AWS's growth in the US and around the world. The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer\-facing enterprises and products. The team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global environmental programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training; ensuring effective engagement by environmental teams on global initiatives, including those that are part of Amazon’s ambitious sustainability goals; providing specialist expertise; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. You will partner with AWS stakeholders to develop regional and site\-specific development strategies enabling the construction and operation of AWS datacenters and infrastructure. You will lead environmental due diligence for site selection and acquisition, develop and execute regional and site\-specific environmental permitting strategies, support environmental compliance during design and construction, and prepare for data center operations. This role requires regular engagement throughout the development lifecycle with multiple AWS stakeholders including Real Estate, Legal, Risk, Water, Design, Public Policy, Construction, and Operational teams, as well as external stakeholders including regulatory agencies, consultants, and contractors. A successful candidate in this role will have a proven track record of delivering multiple, high\-priority projects with tight timelines that require strong communication with partner teams, outside consultants and counsel, and regulatory agencies. The candidate must have a strong understanding of multi\-media United States environmental permitting, remediation, and compliance requirements associated with large\-scale infrastructure including experience with Clean Water Act (CWA) 404 and NPDES permitting. Preference in experience with OH EPA, IDEM, MO EDQ. Key job responsibilities * Assess environmental risks and requirements and develop mitigations and strategies to support data center siting and development strategies and site\-specific project delivery. * Lead technical aspects of environmental due diligence, including Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments, regulatory and permitting evaluations, natural, biological and cultural resource evaluations, and noise assessments. * Deliver environmental permits, approvals, and plans to enable on\-time and compliant construction and operations for new data center locations and expansion of existing sites. * Communicate environmental requirements, risks, and activities to internal and external project partners. * Coordinate with partner teams including Real Estate, Design, Water, Legal, Risk, Power, and others to optimize site designs to consider natural resource or operational constraints. * Develop site development and permitting strategies that are environmentally responsible and sustainable while meeting project timelines. * Lead regulatory agency interactions and negotiations in support of environmental permit acquisition and regional development strategies. * Develop, manage and track metrics to evaluate project success About the team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. \#DCPD\_Delivery**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering * Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent * Experience delivering multi\-media environmental due diligence, permitting, and compliance projects with specific expertise in CWA 404 and NPDES permitting, groundwater protection, wastewater discharge, and natural and cultural resource evaluations * 7\+ years experience conducting environmental due diligence for greenfield and brownfield sites. * At least 3 years of project or task management experience for environmental permitting and/or due diligence projects. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience managing large projects and multifunctional teams * Data center or critical infrastructure due diligence, design, construction, and/or or risk assessment experience strongly preferred. * Experience in multiple states within the US (preferably in MD, VA, PA). * Experience managing and/or supporting community/public interactions. * Experience with Smartsheet or other project management software. * Up to 25% travel. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Amazon Q
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Q is helping redefine how developers and cloud practitioners build, operate, troubleshoot, and optimize on AWS. We are building an intelligent assistant that goes beyond answering questions—combining generative AI with deep AWS context, retrieval, tools, and actions to help customers understand their environments and get work done faster. Building this experience introduces a new class of engineering challenges. How do you ground an LLM's response in relevant, up\-to\-date information from a customer's AWS environment while maintaining strong security boundaries and low latency? How do you orchestrate multi\-step agentic workflows that can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools, and take actions reliably and safely? How do you evaluate AI systems where quality cannot be measured by traditional software testing alone? These are the kinds of problems you will help solve. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help shape the next generation of Amazon Q. You will work at the intersection of generative AI, agentic systems, and large\-scale distributed services to build highly visible, customer\-facing capabilities used across AWS. As a Senior SDE, you will provide technical leadership for complex and ambiguous initiatives. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, applied scientists, UX partners, and teams across AWS to define architecture, make critical technical decisions, and translate advances in foundation models, retrieval, reasoning, and agents into secure, reliable production experiences. This role offers an opportunity to influence both what we build and how we build it—developing new architectures and engineering mechanisms for AI\-powered systems while raising the technical bar across the team. Key job responsibilities As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Q team, you will: Build: Design and deliver major Amazon Q capabilities and the highly available, scalable, secure, and low\-latency distributed systems that power them. Build systems that connect foundation models with customer context, AWS knowledge, retrieval systems, APIs, tools, and actions. Solve: Tackle ambiguous engineering problems unique to production generative AI, including contextual grounding, agent orchestration, tool execution, retrieval, security boundaries, latency, reliability, and mechanisms for evaluating AI quality and effectiveness. Own: Lead projects end to end—from requirements and architecture through implementation, launch, operations, measurement, and continuous improvement—making thoughtful trade\-offs across customer experience, quality, scalability, availability, security, performance, and cost. Lead: Define technical direction for complex initiatives, influence architecture across Amazon Q and partner teams, and simplify systems as they evolve. Drive high engineering standards across design, testing, observability, deployment, and operational excellence. Mentor: Raise the technical bar of the organization through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and hands\-on development. Mentor engineers and help teams navigate complex architectural and implementation decisions. Innovate: Work with applied scientists, product leaders, and engineering teams to bring advances in foundation models, retrieval, reasoning, and agentic AI into production. A day in the life We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: TPM, Fwd Deployed Engineer, Business Innovation and AI
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team within Business Innovation \& AI (BIA) is looking for a Technical Program Manager who builds. FDE embeds directly with teams across Amazon Global Operations Services (GOS), co\-builds with them from day one, and ships working AI\-powered solutions. Engagements range from short builds to multi\-quarter programs. The impact here is internal: you build for the GOS org, not for external customers. We increasingly look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web\-based interfaces with AI agents, so a lot of what you build will be agentic. This is a hands\-on builder role. We’re looking for people who are already shipping AI solutions with the current generation of tooling, not people who are newly exploring AI or have only done some prompt engineering. The engineers who do well here are hands\-on with agentic harnesses like Claude Code, Kiro, and Codex, and are plugged into the AI builder community closely enough to know what changed this month. What Makes This Role Different? Most program roles ask you to coordinate other people’s work from a distance. FDE asks you to sit with the operational team and build the solution yourself. You take prototypes to production and hand scalable patterns back to the broader org. Key job responsibilities Build AI \& Agentic Solutions, Embedded * Embed with GOS operational teams, co\-build from day one, and ship AI\-powered solutions that replace manual workflows * Look for opportunities to replace manual processes and web\-based interfaces with AI agents, and build those agents end to end * Build with the current AI tooling yourself, including agentic harnesses (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex), LLM application frameworks, and RAG, and take prototypes to production Program Delivery * Own the planning, coordination, and delivery of your AI programs, managing scope, risk, and dependencies without relying on direct authority * Keep delivery moving across engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders Raising the Bar * Bring back the tooling and patterns that work, and help the team ship faster * Document and hand off scalable solutions to the broader organization A day in the life You start the morning embedded with an operations team, mapping a manual workflow you’re replacing with an agent. By mid\-morning you’re building, wiring it up with current tooling and putting the next iteration in front of them. In the afternoon you iterate with the customer in the room, then push the working pieces toward production. You close the day sharing a tooling trick with the team that cut your build time in half. About the team Business Innovation \& AI (BIA) finds the hardest, highest\-value problems across Amazon Global Operations Services and builds AI\-powered solutions that measurably change how work gets done. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is BIA’s technical execution arm: a small, senior team with high autonomy and a bias for shipping. We embed with operational teams in the GOS org, co\-build from day one, ship working solutions, and hand scalable patterns off to the broader organization. We don’t just automate the existing process; we redesign the work around what AI and agents make possible.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of technical program management experience * Experience demonstrating software engineering skills in a previous intership, work experience, coding competitions, or publications, or experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C\#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP) and experience with automation and any version control tools * Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders * Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) * Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware * Experience in professional, non\-internship software development, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware * Experience building AI agents that replace manual or UI\-driven workflows * Fluency with the current GenAI tooling landscape (Amazon Bedrock, agent frameworks, LLM\-powered workflows) * Experience in rapid\-prototyping, forward\-deployed, or embedded engineering models * Experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code * Data or analytics experience (SQL, pipelines, connecting source data to a customer need) Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist - Optimization
jobs.description: **Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.** ============================================================================================================================================ At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business. Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world\-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business. To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube **Job Description** =================== As a Sr. Data Scientist in Amcor Core R\&D, you'll lead the development of models and advanced analytics tools, enabling data\-driven decision making across the global Flexibles R\&D organization. This role develops mathematical optimization, machine learning, and AI solutions, and contributes to the data pipelines that feed them — to support cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and product design. This position works closely with cross\-functional teams to integrate enterprise data into the R\&D development process and enable scalable, high\-impact capabilities that drive business results. Serves as a senior technical expert for optimization, AI, and advanced analytics, providing recommendations that help shape the R\&D analytics roadmap and digital transformation initiatives. jobs.title: Gen AI Engineer with Java & Microservices
jobs.description: **Gen AI Engineer with Java \& Microservices** ---------------------------------------------- Atlanta is rapidly emerging as a hub for artificial intelligence and enterprise technology, and we are seeking a talented Gen AI Engineer to join a forward\-thinking team dedicated to building intelligent, scalable solutions. This role is perfect for a software engineer who combines deep expertise in Java and microservices architecture with a passion for large language models, generative AI, and the practical deployment of these cutting\-edge technologies. You will be at the forefront of transforming complex business challenges into innovative, AI\-powered products that drive real impact. As a Gen AI Engineer in Atlanta, you will be responsible for designing and implementing robust, production\-ready AI services that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise systems. Our team values a collaborative, agile culture where engineers are encouraged to experiment, iterate, and own their work from concept to deployment. Your primary focus will be on bridging the gap between theoretical generative models and reliable, high\-performance microservices, ensuring that our AI solutions are not only intelligent but also resilient, secure, and maintainable. This is an opportunity to shape the future of our platform and contribute to Atlanta's vibrant tech community. You will play a key role in the entire lifecycle of AI feature development—from identifying opportunities for generative AI to improving user experience, to designing the APIs and services that make these features accessible. By joining our team, you will help establish best practices for integrating LLMs into microservice\-based architectures, tackling challenges like prompt management, response streaming, cost optimization, and model evaluation. Your work will directly influence how our organization leverages generative capabilities to enhance productivity, automate complex workflows, and deliver personalized user experiences. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade microservices in Java (using frameworks like Spring Boot) that integrate with a variety of large language models and AI/ML platforms. * Architect and implement RESTful APIs and event\-driven communication patterns to expose generative AI capabilities to internal and external clients. * Develop robust prompt engineering strategies, including prompt templating, chaining, and dynamic context management, to optimize model output for specific business use cases. * Implement features such as Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), integrating vector databases to provide grounded, context\-aware responses from proprietary knowledge bases. * Build resilient integration layers to handle model inference, including retry logic, timeouts, rate limiting, and fallback mechanisms to ensure high availability. * Develop services for asynchronous processing and streaming responses, ensuring efficient handling of long\-running inference tasks. * Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and observability solutions (e.g., tracking token usage, latency, and model performance) to ensure the health of AI services. * Collaborate closely with data scientists and ML engineers to convert experimental models into production\-ready code, focusing on system architecture and performance optimization. * Develop and execute unit, integration, and load tests for AI services, ensuring code quality and system reliability under pressure. * Participate in the evaluation of new generative AI models, libraries, and tools, providing technical assessments and recommendations. * Write technical documentation and contribute to the maintenance of our internal AI service frameworks and shared libraries. * Stay current on the rapidly evolving Gen AI landscape, proactively suggesting improvements to our architecture and development practices. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong emphasis on object\-oriented programming and enterprise\-level application development. * Expert proficiency in Java, including advanced concepts like concurrency, functional programming patterns, and robust error handling. * Deep hands\-on experience building and deploying applications using microservices architecture, including service discovery, API gateways, and distributed tracing. * Strong working knowledge of Spring Boot or a similar Java\-based micro\-service framework, including testing and configuration. * Proven experience integrating with third\-party AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models) within a server\-side environment. * Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is highly desirable. * Proficiency with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and practical experience using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) for semantic search. * Working knowledge of observability tools and practices, including logging frameworks, metrics collection, and monitoring dashboards. * Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a proactive and self\-directed work ethic. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and translate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Passion for learning new technologies, particularly in the field of generative AI and machine learning engineering.

jobs.title: Vice President - Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Our Company** We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3\.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world. **Job Description** The VP\-Forward Deployed Engineer operates at the intersection of investment strategy, quantitative analysis and applied artificial intelligence. The position is responsible for partnering closely with portfolio management and investment research teams to identify opportunities, design solutions, and develop, prototype, and deploy LLM\-enabled tools that enhance investment decision\-making and research processes. Combines investment management knowledge with software engine capabilities to translate investment ideas and research needs into scalable technology solutions.**Key Responsibilities** * Serve as a trusted advisor to investment leaders, translating investment strategies, research priorities, and business challenges into innovative AI\-enabled solutions that improve investment outcomes and organizational efficiency. * Drive the design and delivery of proof\-of\-concept and production\-ready AI capabilities, leveraging advanced analytics, machine learning, and LLM technologies to accelerate investment insights and decision\-making. * Partner across Investments, Technology, Data, Risk, and Compliance functions to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, governance, scalability, and regulatory compliance. * Influence the AI and investment technology roadmap by identifying high\-value opportunities, evaluating emerging capabilities, and promoting adoption of innovative solutions across the investment organization. * Lead the transition of successful prototypes into sustainable enterprise capabilities, partnering with engineering and platform teams to scale solutions and realize long\-term business value. **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of combined experience across investment management, quantitative research/strategy, and hands\-on software or AI engineering, with demonstrated success taking investment problems from concept to working solution. * Direct experience working alongside trading desks, portfolio managers, or investment researchers, with desk strategist, quant strat, or research technologist backgrounds strongly preferred. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping LLM enabled/integrated applications: RAG/embeddings, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, API integration. * Strong Python development skills producing production\-quality code. * Expertise with cloud infrastructure and modern software practices (CI/CD, version control, API design). * Fluency in at least one asset class (equities, fixed income, multi\-asset, or macro) at a level where you can challenge and contribute to investment discussions, not just support them. * Track record of delivering secure, auditable AI solutions in a regulated environment, partnering with risk and compliance. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience supporting front\-office investment teams (portfolio managers, analysts, researchers, traders). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration tools (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP) and vector databases. * Experience building internal copilots, research assistants, or document\-intelligence tools. * CFA, FRM, or equivalent investment credential. * Track record of shipping AI or analytics solutions that produced measurable, real\-world outcomes. **Visa Sponsorship** Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H\-1B, F\-1 CPT, F\-1 OPT, TN). **In\-Office Collaboration** We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1\) day per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process. **Base Pay Salary** The estimated base salary for this role is $242,100 \- $332,900 / year. We have a pay\-forperformance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long\-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well\-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances.**Full\-Time/Part\-Time** Full time**Exempt/Non\-Exempt** Exempt**Job Family Group** Data**Line of Business** TECH Technology*Ameriprise Financial is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer - Level 2
jobs.description: **Location:**Austin, TX **Posted:**9/28/2026 **Location Name:**Austin **Wage:**Depends on Experience Annual **Position Type:**Full Time Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive. The Power Systems Engineer is a customer\-facing technical role at the intersection of system\-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R\&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer. Power Systems Engineer works under the guidance of senior team members supporting key customers and/or key programs, while building fluency in power architecture and connector/cable technology. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Technical Requirements:** Engage with customer engineering teams to capture requirements to develop power interconnect solutions. * **Architecture translation:** Translate system\-level power architecture (e.g., 800V bus conversion, sidecar or vertical power delivery, busbar distribution) into connector and cable technology requirements to define product development. * **Customer\-facing solutioning:** Serve as the front\-facing technical point of contact for power architecture discussions, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade\-offs, and roadmap alignment directly to customer engineering teams. * **Cross\-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering and manufacturing site to develop and deliver power interconnect solutions. * **Specification development:** Develop technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design\-in activities. * **Design\-in support:** Support qualification, validation, and design\-in activities for new power interconnect solutions at customer sites. * **Industry Standards:** Track relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler\-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps. * **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development. * Support senior team members in customer engagements. * Build working knowledge of the company's connector and cable product portfolio as applied to power delivery use cases. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * At minimum Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related engineering technical field. * Bachelor’s degree with 3\+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Master’s degree with 1\+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Foundational understanding of connector development and power architecture concepts. * Ability to read and interpret system\-level requirements and specifications. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable participating in customer\-facing meetings alongside senior colleagues. * Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Direct exposure to data center power architecture with strong critical thinking skills. * Familiarity with the connector and cable industry landscape and their power interconnect product lines. * Working knowledge of Open Compute Project (OCP) standards. * Experience/exposure to Creo 3D CAD software. * Exposure to power integrity simulation or analysis tools. * Experience presenting technical content directly to customer engineering and program teams. Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business. Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

jobs.description: Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive. The Senior Power Systems Architect is a customer\-facing technical role at the intersection of system\-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R\&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer. Senior Power Systems Architect works under only general direction, independently determining their approach to customer support. Owning the technical relationship for one or more key customers and/or key programs to drive technical requirements through to documented interconnect specifications and design wins. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Technical Requirements:** Independently own the technical requirements\-gathering relationship with customer engineering teams for power architecture requirements. * **Architecture translation:** Translate system\-level power architecture (e.g., 800V bus conversion, sidecar or vertical power delivery, busbar distribution) into connector and cable technology requirements to define product development. * **Customer\-facing solutioning:** Lead power architecture discussions with customer engineering teams, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade\-offs, and roadmap alignment. * **Cross\-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering, manufacturing, and R\&D to shape roadmap decisions in response to customer power architecture requirements. * **Specification development:** Develop and own technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design\-in activities. * **Design\-in support:** Lead qualification, validation, and design\-in activities for new power interconnect solutions at customer sites. * **Industry Standards:** Track and begin contributing to relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler\-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps. * **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development. * Mentor Associate (Junior) Engineers and review their technical outputs. * Identify architecture shifts (e.g., new bus voltages, new form factors) early enough to influence internal roadmap planning. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor or Master of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related engineering technical field. * Bachelor’s degree with 5–8 years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Master’s degree with 3–6 years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Demonstrated experience translating system\-level power architecture requirements into connector/cable specifications. * Working knowledge of high\-voltage/high\-current interconnect design principles for data center or similar power infrastructure. * Proven history of independently managing a customer technical relationship. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills for direct, unsupervised customer engagement. * Willingness to travel to customer and manufacturing sites as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Direct experience with data center or high\-voltage (e.g., 800V) power architecture and strong critical thinking skills. * Experience with the connector and cable industry landscape and competitive power interconnect product lines. * Knowledge of various safety certification standards including UL and IEC * Working knowledge of Open Compute Project (OCP) standards. (Active participation preferred) * Experience with Creo 3D CAD software. * Exposure to power integrity simulation or analysis tools. * Experience mentoring junior engineers. jobs.title: Principal Project Manager
jobs.description: **About Analog Devices** Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . **Position Summary** ==================== Analog Devices' Software \& Digital Platforms (SDP) group is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager with deep embedded software experience to oversee complex programs for next\-generation MCU, DSP, and SoC products. jobs.title: IT - Application Developer
jobs.description: ArchWell Health is a new, innovative healthcare provider devoted to improving the lives of our senior members. We deliver best\-in\-class care at comfortable, accessible neighborhood clinics where seniors can feel at home and become part of a vibrant, wellness\-focused community. Our members experience greater continuity of care, as well as the comfort of knowing they will be treated with respect by people who genuinely care about them, their families, and their communities. **Job Summary:** ArchWell Health is seeking an Application Developer to create and maintain data and business applications across our suite of services. This position will be primarily responsible for building internal applications and integrating/interfacing with numerous internal and external entities, internal business process creation/improvement and operating the Azure DevOps processes. The ideal candidate will have an in\-depth knowledge of the Azure Cloud environment and be proficient in C\# development. ArchWell uses an Azure stack including Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, PowerShell and other assorted Microsoft/Azure tooling. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Creating and maintaining data interfaces across a number of different protocols (file, database. API). * Creating and maintaining in\-house applications * Creating and maintaining monitoring and alerting workflows to improve system transparency. * Facilitating the ArchWell DevOps workflows * Helping create the proper internal architecture that satisfies the required security policies. * Work across teams both inside and outside of Information Technology to identify and create the appropriate solutions strategies to support ArchWell’s business objectives. * Facilitate the development of our Azure cloud infrastructure relative to Data and Application systems * Participate as a key member of the Engineering team in designing/developing processes of the organization's technical infrastructure and architecture. **Required Skills/Abilities:** * 2\+ years of C\# development in a data\-focused environment * In\-depth knowledge of Azure tooling capabilities * Working knowledge of GIT * Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing from a support standpoint * Working experience in architecting or supporting solutions in Azure * Working experience leveraging Active Directory a key method of enabling and enforcing access control * Curiosity and willingness to learn adjacent Microsoft tooling including PowerBI, PowerApps and SharePoint **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree, focus on CIS/CS preferred but not required * 2\+ years of experience in data\-focused development role * Healthcare experience, especially in a provider group setting preferred but not required. ArchWell Health is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification.

jobs.title: IT - Manager, Application Development (Data Engineering)
jobs.description: Engineering \- Manager, Application Development **Job Summary:** ArchWell Health is an innovative healthcare provider dedicated to improving the lives of senior members through high\-quality, personalized care delivered in welcoming neighborhood clinics. Our mission is to empower healthier lives by combining compassionate care, strong community connections, and data\-driven decision\-making. The Manager, Application Development (Data Engineering) is a key member of the Data Engineering organization within the Information Technology – Engineering department and reports to the Director of Data Engineering. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines managing a team of application engineers with owning technical direction and architecture for the application platforms and integrations that drive ArchWell's data\-driven operations. The Manager remains directly involved in day\-to\-day design, development, and implementation. The Manager will lead a team of three to five direct reports, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and delivery oversight for applications, integrations, and data platforms that support business operations, analytics, and strategic initiatives. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders across clinical, operational, financial, and corporate functions to understand business needs and translate them into scalable application platforms that support data\-driven decision\-making. You will drive the development and optimization of internal application(s), APIs, and integrations that enable trusted reporting, analytics, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in application architecture and development with proven leadership skills and a passion for building high\-performing teams that deliver measurable business value. **Duties/Responsibilities:** Leadership \& Management * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of three to five application and data engineers, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performing engineering culture. * Establish team objectives, prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure the successful delivery of projects and operational commitments. * Conduct regular performance coaching, career development planning, and technical mentorship to support team growth and engagement. * Define, monitor, and report on engineering and operational metrics, including delivery performance, application reliability, data quality, and team effectiveness. * Partner with business and technology leaders across the organization to advance a data\-driven culture, establish key performance indicators (KPIs), and leverage data to inform decision\-making and measure outcomes. Technical Leadership \& Delivery * Provide technical leadership for the design, development, implementation, and support of application platforms, integrations, and APIs. * Contribute hands\-on to application development, data engineering, and solution delivery efforts as needed. * Guide the architecture, design, and optimization of scalable, secure, and maintainable application platforms, including modular/service\-boundary design patterns and future microservice extraction paths. * Own the design and delivery of application\-level integrations, including file\- and API\-based data exchange with external systems, using configuration\-driven ingestion patterns to support flexible, maintainable integration points. * Ensure adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, testing methodologies, and DevOps principles. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement * Partner with Product Management, Project Management, Business Systems Analysts, Data \& Analytics teams, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. * Lead technical design sessions, architecture reviews, code reviews, and solution planning activities. * Collaborate closely with IT, data, clinical, operational, and business teams to ensure applications and data solutions align with organizational objectives and business needs. * Facilitate communication between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring clear alignment on priorities, risks, and deliverables. Data Governance, Security \& Compliance * Ensure applications, integrations, and data platforms comply with HIPAA, CMS, and other applicable healthcare regulations and security requirements. * Promote strong application security practices, including access control, identity management (Entra ID/SSO), audit logging, and data privacy. * Maintain system documentation, architectural diagrams, operational procedures, and technical standards. * Support change management, release management, and version control processes to ensure reliable and well\-governed solution delivery. * Collaborate with security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to implement and , and APIs. * Ability to exercise sound technical and business judgment, perform advanced analysis, and make decisions in complex and evolving environments. * Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, manage competing demands, and deliver results with minimal oversight. * Proven leadership skills with the ability to influence outcomes, drive accountability, and develop high\-performing engineering teams. * Experience with cloud\-based application platforms within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. * Familiarity with Azure application services including Azure Functions, Azure App Services, Entra ID (OAuth2/OIDC), and Entity Framework. * Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD practices, source control management, and infrastructure\-as\-code principles. * Understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance practices, particularly in regulated industries. * Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging technologies and adjacent Microsoft platform capabilities. * Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment where adaptability, ownership, and hands\-on leadership are essential. Education and Experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. * 7\+ years of experience in enterprise software/application development or related technical disciplines. * 3\+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise application platforms, service integrations, or modular/microservice architectures. * 4\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or setting technical direction for engineering teams, preferably within healthcare, healthcare technology, or other highly regulated industries. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modeling sufficient to support application data needs. * Experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, App Services, and identity/SSO integration. * Proficiency in C\#, .NET Core/ASP.NET Core, and modern web frameworks (e.g., Blazor WebAssembly, Angular, or similar SPA technologies). * Experience building and maintaining APIs and enterprise integrations. * Familiarity with healthcare data domains, including claims, clinical, provider, member, and operational data, preferred. * Experience supporting data governance, data quality, security, and compliance initiatives, including HIPAA and CMS requirements, preferred. * Embodies and serves as a role model of ArchWell Health’s Values: * Be compassionate * Strive for excellence * Earn trust * Show respect * Stay resilient * Always do the right thing **About ArchWell Health:** At ArchWell Health, we’re creating a community of caring designed to help our members stay healthy and engaged. By focusing on a strong provider\-patient relationship, routine wellness, and staying active, our members enjoy a higher level of care and better quality of life after the age of 60\. Everything we do is for seniors. We believe seniors should be heard, listened to, and given ample time by their physicians to live well later in life. Our value\-based care model is designed to prevent illnesses while keeping members healthy and happy in every aspect of their life. We deliver best\-in\-class primary care at comfortable, accessible neighborhood centers where older adults can feel at home and become part of a vibrant, wellness\-focused community. We’re passionate about caring for older adults and united by the belief that caring has the power to change everything for our members. ArchWell Health is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification. **Last Updated:** 9/1/2

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: ### **Why AssemblyAI** AssemblyAI builds the best\-in\-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M\+ inference calls monthly, process 1M\+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion\+ end\-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we're looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital\-efficient AI companies on the planet \- with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue\-dense teams within the fastest\-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale \- processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth\-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow\-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We're committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! **About the role:** ------------------- We're looking for AssemblyAI's founding Enterprise Account Executive to own a book of strategic accounts and drive revenue across AssemblyAI's Voice AI infrastructure offerings. This person will generate pipeline in target accounts, develop strong champions, lead model evaluations, and win over enterprise engineering and product leaders. The ideal candidate has a strong background in enterprise infrastructure or API sales, thrives on building pipeline from scratch, and is energized by working with technical buyers on products that win on performance and developer experience. This is a cross\-functional role that requires close partnership with Applied AI, Research, Engineering, Marketing, and Deployment to shape go\-to\-market strategy and deliver an exceptional customer experience from first touch through deployment and beyond. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own a book of enterprise accounts, leading potential customers across the full sales cycle from prospecting through initial production rollout * Generate pipeline through proactive, creative outbound \- including personalized outreach, conferences, exclusive events, and finding warm introductions * Craft outbound communications that deliver real value to prospects \- custom benchmarks, competitive insights, use\-case\-specific demos that earn replies * Develop authentic champions within target accounts who advocate for AssemblyAI internally and help shepherd deals to close * Engage multiple leadership stakeholders in parallel \- CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, VP of AI, and other technical decision\-makers \- to build consensus and de\-risk deals * Position AssemblyAI's value and pricing against alternatives with clear, quantitative and qualitative differentiation * Drive urgency through business value at every touchpoint, keeping deals moving forward with intent * Quarterback complex, multi\-threaded deals \- bringing insights, perspective, and momentum to every customer interaction * Partner closely with Customer and Technology Teams to represent the enterprise voice of the customer and shape go\-to\-market strategy **What You'll Need:** --------------------- * 4\+ years of enterprise infrastructure or API sales experience closing large deals with engineering and product audiences * A track record of building pipeline from scratch \- experience breaking into cold accounts and creating opportunities where none existed * Technical fluency \- comfortable discussing API architectures, model accuracy tradeoffs, and deployment options with engineers and technical decision\-makers * Demonstrated ability to identify and develop champions who advocate internally on your behalf * A high sense of urgency and ownership; you move deals forward and don't let them go stale * Comfort selling in a frictionless, product\-led motion where customers stay because the product wins * Deep understanding of enterprise procurement, legal, and security review processes, with the ability to drive velocity through complex commercial cycles * A willingness to travel to drive impact \- expect to be on the road 50%\+ of each month for customer visits, industry events, and team offsites * Must be located in NY or SF for this role. **Pay Transparency:** AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer. Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range. The range provided applies to candidates located in the **United States**. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process. **Salary range: $300,000 \- $370,000** The expected total compensation for this role is listed above (including base salary and commission). Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer\-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our San Francisco or New York City office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US\-based full time team members. ### **AI to Interview:** If you're selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. ### **GDPR privacy notice:** Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. ### **Keep Exploring AssemblyAI:** Speech\-to\-text \| Streaming speech\-to\-text \| Speech Understanding \| LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube!

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York City **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Sales Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission\-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry\-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data\-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io. **About this Role****:** ------------------------ As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Astronomer, you'll be the first point of contact for prospective customers and a key driver of pipeline for the sales team. You'll identify and qualify high\-potential leads, introduce them to Astro, and set up meaningful conversations for our Account Executives. **Career path to AE!** If you're hungry to build a career in sales and want to work with technology that data teams actually love, we have a career path for you! **Location:** This is a hybrid role requires 4 days in office at our NYC headquarters **What You Get to Do:** ----------------------- * **Prospect \& Outreach** – Research and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn to build a strong, consistent pipeline. * **Qualify Leads** – Assess inbound and outbound leads for fit across needs, budget, and intent to convert them into Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs). * **Partner with Sales \& Marketing** – Work closely with both teams to refine MQL\-to\-SQL conversion strategies and keep high\-quality leads flowing. * **Work Smart with Tools** – Use Salesforce, sales automation platforms, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to track engagement and sharpen your outreach. * **Stay Sharp** – Keep up with industry trends, customer pain points, and Astronomer's evolving value prop so every conversation lands. * **Hit Your Numbers** – Own your pipeline goals — outreach volume, meetings set, and conversion rates — and push beyond them. **What You Bring to the Role:** ------------------------------- * 1\+ years of experience B2B outbound prospecting experience, business development, and/or full cycle sales experience required. (internships included) * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for crafting outreach that actually gets responses. * Resilient and self\-motivated — you don't get rattled by rejection and stay focused on the goal. * Able to break down technical concepts and connect them to what a prospect actually cares about. * Ready to thrive in a fast\-paced, in\-person environment. **Bonus Points If You Have:** ----------------------------- * Experience selling to technical personas like data engineers, analytics leads, or CTOs. * Hands\-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce or HubSpot, sales automation platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator. * Exposure to the data engineering or analytics space — bonus if you've heard of Apache Airflow. *The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from $100,000 \- $115,000 based on leveling and geography, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate; actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.* *\#LI\-OnSite* *\#LI\-Hybrid* At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Roadway Engineer 2
jobs.description: **About Atlas** Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project. **Job Description** The **Roadway Engineer II** supports the planning, design, and delivery of transportation infrastructure projects throughout Georgia, contributing to roadway, drainage, grading, and site development improvements that enhance community mobility and safety. This role performs engineering analyses, prepares design documents, and develops construction plans using industry\-standard software such as MicroStation and OpenRoads under the guidance of senior engineering staff. The Roadway Engineer II collaborates closely with project managers, surveyors, planners, and other engineering disciplines to ensure projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable standards and regulations. Responsibilities include reviewing technical data, preparing reports and calculations, participating in project meetings, and providing engineering support throughout the design and construction process. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical, communication, and problem\-solving skills, along with a commitment to delivering high\-quality engineering solutions for clients and communities. This position is based in **Duluth, Georgia** and offers opportunities for professional growth, technical development, and advancement within a collaborative engineering team. **Core Responsibilities** * Assist with project planning and design by reviewing survey reports, maps, record drawings, plans, and other technical data. * Analyze project information to support the planning, development, and execution of engineering projects. * Prepare preliminary designs for roadway, drainage, site development, and grading components under the direction of senior engineering staff. * Support the development of project layouts and design concepts that meet project requirements and client objectives. * Ensure roadway design and construction activities comply with applicable jurisdictional and regulatory standards. * Utilize CAD software, including MicroStation and OpenRoads, to prepare engineering drawings and design documents. * Communicate project status, concerns, and recommended solutions to managers, team members, clients, and other stakeholders. * Participate in project status meetings, pre\-construction meetings, and technical discussions to provide updates and engineering input. * Collaborate with planners, surveyors, civil engineers, and other multidisciplinary team members to support project delivery. * Contribute to a team\-oriented environment by coordinating effectively across disciplines and maintaining clear communication throughout all project phases. **You’ll thrive here if you have** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (BSCE) or a closely related field. * Candidates with an alternate degree may be considered if they are licensed in Illinois and possess equivalent professional experience. * 2 to 6 years of professional experience in transportation engineering. * Experience in project management, business development, wetland delineations, or other related engineering disciplines preferred. * Additional skills, certifications, or specialized experience may be considered based on project and client needs. * Georgia Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) or Professional Engineer (PE) certification preferred; ability to obtain Georgia licensure within six months is acceptable. * Strong oral communication and technical writing skills required. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word required. * jobs.description: **This is an on\-site desk role in Hollywood, FL: email, quotes, and technical consulting for corporate clients. No hands\-on assembly. Local applicants only.** BIZON, an industry\-leading manufacturer of computers/servers for AI, is looking for a talented Sales Engineer / Technical Sales Specialist to join our growing team. This is a rare opportunity to work every day with the most advanced computing hardware in the world — NVIDIA's latest GPUs, servers, water\-cooled systems — and with clients like Stanford, MIT, Tesla, Samsung, Google, and Amazon. If you're the person who reads spec sheets for fun, can explain a technical trade\-off, and gets satisfaction from a quote where every number is right — this is the role for you. You will own the technical sales process: from a client's first inquiry to the moment an order is confirmed, paid, and handed to the build team. You'll report to the Sales Manager and work closely with our engineering team. **What you'll do** * Handle a high volume of technical email: every day brings new clients, new workloads, and new questions. * Translate client requirements ("we need to fine\-tune a 70B LLM under $50K") into precise, compatible hardware configurations and formal quotes * Manage multi\-round quote revisions with clients via email and phone until the configuration is finalized * Research and learn constantly: clients arrive with workloads, frameworks, and hardware you've never seen — you dig in, figure it out, and come back with a professional recommendation * Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and similar) as a daily part of your workflow — for research, drafting, and checking your work * Own the sales inbox: inquiries, follow\-ups, order confirmations, payment verification, shipping details * Coordinate order specifics with the build team; resolve issues with carriers and suppliers when they come up * Handle corporate purchasing paperwork: POs, net terms, vendor registration forms, spec sheets. **What we require** * **3\+ years of professional experience in a client\-facing technical role** — IT, systems integration, MSP, technical account management, technical pre\-sales, or similar * **Solid understanding of computer hardware:** you know what CPUs, GPUs, RAM, and storage do, how they fit together, and how to read a spec sheet. Experience with servers or GPU computing is a strong plus. * **Strong technical research skills.** This is core to the job. When a client asks about a framework, model, or GPU you've never heard of, you find primary sources, verify the answer, and can defend your recommendation. You are comfortable not knowing something and fast at fixing that. * **Daily, confident use of AI tools is required.** You already use them for research and writing, and you know where they're wrong and how to check. * Must be very comfortable and effective in interacting via email and over the phone. * **Flawless written English.** You'll write dozens of emails a day to procurement departments and senior engineers. Non\-negotiable. * **Precision:** prices, discounts, quantities, shipping addresses — one wrong digit costs real money. You double\-check by habit, not by request. * **Judgment and ownership:** you know what to resolve on your own and what to escalate to your supervisor. * **Ability to explain technical trade\-offs clearly** to both engineers and non\-technical buyers * Sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience with corporate or institutional clients is. * Must be able to pass a background check and drug test. **Compensation and schedule** * $65,000–$90,000/year, based on experience * Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM * On\-site: Hollywood, FL 33020 **About BIZON** BIZON is a US manufacturer of high\-end workstations, GPU servers, and water\-cooled systems for AI research, HPC, and compute. Trusted by 2,000\+ clients across research, government, and enterprise, we back every system with in\-house engineering. **How to apply:** Please submit your RESUME. **Please, no phone calls regarding the job position.** *BIZON is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Employer.* BIZON is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Data Engineer to join our forward\-thinking data team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and architectures that support advanced analytics and business intelligence initiatives. Your expertise will enable the organization to harness the power of big data systems, cloud platforms, and data modeling techniques to drive strategic decision\-making. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights, this opportunity is perfect for you! **Responsibilities** * Develop and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines using tools like Talend, Informatica, and custom scripting in Python or Bash to ensure efficient data flow across systems. * Design and implement robust data models and schemas for data warehouses using dimensional modeling principles to support business intelligence tools such as Looker. * Manage large\-scale big data systems utilizing Hadoop, Apache Hive, Spark, and Azure Data Lake to process vast datasets with speed and precision. * Integrate data from multiple sources including SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle), cloud databases (AWS, Azure), and linked data sources to create comprehensive datasets for analysis. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams using Agile methodologies to develop scalable solutions aligned with business needs while maintaining high standards of data quality and security. * Build and maintain RESTful APIs for seamless data access and integration across applications. * Support model training, analysis activities, and query management tasks to facilitate insightful reporting through business intelligence tools like Looker. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in software development with proficiency in Java, Python, SQL, VBA, Bash (Unix shell), and Shell Scripting for automation and pipeline development. * Strong understanding of big data systems such as Hadoop ecosystem components (HDFS, Hive, Spark) and cloud platforms including AWS (Amazon Web Services), Azure (Azure Data Lake), or similar public cloud environments. * Expertise in data management integration techniques including ETL pipeline development, database design, data warehousing design, and dimensional modeling. * Hands\-on experience with SQL databases like Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud\-based databases; familiarity with query management is essential. * Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Looker or equivalent platforms for visualization and reporting purposes. * Ability to design scalable data architectures supporting analytics initiatives with a focus on data warehousing design and cloud database solutions. * Strong analysis skills with a focus on data modeling, model training processes, and analytics\-driven decision making. * Familiarity with Agile development practices to ensure iterative progress on complex projects involving big data systems. Join us to leverage your expertise in data engineering—transform raw information into powerful insights that shape the future of our organization! Pay: $107,007\.35 \- $128,869\.06 per year Work Location: Remote
