team members, notifying and driving task completion by pending approvers, resolving issues and implementing actions to mitigate risks * Owner of OTD and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for change execution * Support Change Management Principal Engineer towards improving operational KPIs, process enhancement/harmonization and breakthrough objectives * Engage in change process development and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in PALM tool * Lead Technical Change Forum (TCF) meetings in reviewing proposed changes and analyzing impact, engage in Helpchat to provide guidance and answer questions raised by change requesters * Lead/support change management training sessions for stakeholders and customers, develop training materials * Define and lead ideas to simplify, improve and harmonize processes, always with global perspective * Lead/support cross\-functional business initiatives to increase productivity and eliminate escaping defects, engage in the development and testing of AI and automation tools * Actively participates in continuous improvement (Lean) events when required, develop Standard Work, create and maintain quality documents, procedures and work instructions * Drive upfront collaboration with stakeholders for P2V, NCR, NPI, RCA projects **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics or Computer Science * Minimum 10 years' experience as Design Engineer and/or Systems Engineer * Strong organizational, facilitation and leadership skills * Proven record of concurrently managing projects, monitoring progress and quality * Clear thinking, open to innovative ideas and demonstrated experience in the implementation of new tools and processes **Desired Characteristics** * Demonstrated change management experience within Gas Power organization, proficient in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) GTCC tool * Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with Design Engineering, Project Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain and Services Parts teams *This role requires access to U.S. export\-controlled information. jobs.title: Data Governance Engineer, Early Careers
jobs.description: **Job Description** GM does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1\-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc.) This role is located at the GM Global Technical Center in Warren, Michigan. The Enterprise Data Governance Office is seeking an early careers Data Governance Engineer to help expand data literacy, data stewardship growth, governance enablement, and community engagement across General Motors. This entry\-level role combines technical learning with business and process support. The Data Governance Engineer will help make governance concepts, learning resources, onboarding steps, and practical guidance easier to understand, find, and apply across technical and business audiences. Working under the guidance of experienced data governance and data literacy team members, the Data Governance Engineer will support steward onboarding, community growth, training coordination, communications, learning\-path development, documentation, reporting, stakeholder follow\-up, and measurement. This is an opportunity to gain practical experience in enterprise data governance, data literacy, data stewardship, change enablement, and cross\-functional program execution. **The Role** At General Motors, data literacy helps employees understand, question, and responsibly use data and artificial intelligence to make informed decisions. Data stewardship helps ensure that data has clear ownership, useful metadata, appropriate classification, measurable quality, and accountable support across its lifecycle. The Data Governance \& Data Literacy team supports these outcomes through role\-based learning, steward onboarding, data transfer documentation/tracking, hands\-on workshops, enterprise events, communications, community meetings, reusable job aids, reporting, and governance enablement. The Data Governance Engineer will contribute to the operating work that turns these activities into a repeatable capability. The role is well suited for a student who enjoys connecting technology, business needs, and practical processes; communicating with different audiences; organizing work; using metrics to understand participation and adoption; and learning how governed data is used across a large enterprise. **What You’ll Do** * Coordinate data literacy events, workshops, office hours, community meetings, and learning campaigns, including calendars, registrations, materials, attendance, and follow\-up. * Help grow the Data Stewardship community by supporting invitations, agendas, discussion topics, feedback collection, recaps, and approved collaboration channels. * Support Data Steward onboarding, including required learning, Atlan onboarding steps, approved access tracking, cataloging activities, office\-hours participation, and follow\-up actions. * Assist with intake and triage of data governance, data literacy, and data transfer documentation; route policy, privacy, access, data\-quality, and tool\-specific questions to the appropriate subject\-matter expert. * Research and organize content on data governance, metadata, ownership, inbound and outbound data exchange documentation/tracking, stewardship, data quality, responsible data use and analytics. * Create and maintain plain\-language communications and reusable materials, including FAQs, job aids, onboarding checklists, quick\-start guides, presentations, announcements, learning paths, recordings, and documentation. * Under supervision, help verify approved metadata such as ownership, descriptions, and classifications. * Maintain metric definitions, source notes, reporting trackers, and simple dashboard quality checks; prepare status updates, dashboard summaries, community recaps, and presentations. * Coordinate with data stewards, domain representatives, technical teams, communications partners, learning partners, and governance subject\-matter experts while following GM requirements for data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, access, and responsible use of data and artificial intelligence. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Your Skills \& Abilities** * Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Management Information Systems, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field. * Basic understanding of how business processes, information systems, and data support organizational decisions. * Interest in data governance, data literacy, data stewardship, analytics enablement, responsible artificial intelligence, or related areas. * Ability to organize information, manage details, follow established processes,   virtual and in\-person meetings as required by the team. **What Can Give You a Competitive Advantage** * Coursework, project work, or internship experience involving data governance, data stewardship, data quality, business process analysis, learning design, communications, community engagement, or program coordination. * Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets, data visualization, survey tools, reporting, or dashboard development. * Exposure to data catalogs, metadata, ownership, classification, data quality, data privacy, data contracts, or lifecycle concepts. * Exposure to steward onboarding, communities of practice, office hours, enablement programs, or adoption measurement. * Exposure to tools such as Atlan, Immuta, Anomalo, Databricks, Power BI, Confluence, Degreed, Slack, or similar platforms. * Strong documentation, collaboration, analytical, and communication skills with both technical and business audiences. **Compensation** The salary range for this role is from $84,900 \- $130,500\. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. **What you’ll get from us (Benefits):** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. jobs.description: **Job Description** **Hybrid:** This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Austin TX IT Innovation Center 3\-4 days per week (T\-W\-Th) **Who We Are** We are the Brands \& Marketing Software Engineering Team within the Digital Products Engineering (DPE) organization at GM. Our team collaborates closely with marketing leaders from across GM to build easy\-to\-use tooling that powers engaging and innovative customer experiences at scale — including AI\-powered discovery and search experiences — while providing meaningful value to our customers through a seamless customer journey. Our mission is to rapidly and relentlessly ideate, iterate, and launch the next generation of innovative solutions to connect GM with current and future customers, increasingly leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Vertex AI Search to deliver intelligent, personalized digital experiences. Our team comprises industry\-leading software and quality engineers, who utilize a variety of innovative development methodologies and technologies to achieve breakthrough results, drive innovation, and delight customers. **The Role** We are looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Web) who is excited about building high\-impact web products across General Motors and designing intelligent search and discovery capabilities on Google Cloud Platform using Vertex AI Search. You will be responsible for helping lead our engineering efforts across planning, design and architecture, execution, and ramp — with a particular emphasis on: * Building modern web applications that integrate with GCP\-native services * Designing and implementing AI\-powered search experiences leveraging Vertex AI Search * Collaborating with product, marketing, and data/ML partners to experiment, measure, and continuously improve search relevance and customer engagement As a technical leader on the team, you will mentor less experienced engineers, build strong relationships with technical leaders on other teams, and help evolve our engineering culture and best practices. * **What You’ll Do** * Develop competency across our complete web technologies stack (client, framework, and services). * Produce high quality software that is unit tested, reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration and deployment. * Serve as a tech lead, actively mentoring other engineers on the team and helping drive technical decisions and tradeoffs. * Investigate and resolve performance bottlenecks across the full stack, including browser, edge, and cloud services. * Lead efforts to automate testing, quality gates, and delivery pipelines, with a strong focus on reliability and observability. * Work on API, Content Management, edge, and cloud systems that power GM brand and marketing experiences. jobs.description: At Gentex, you’ll help create innovative technologies that improve how people live, travel, and stay connected. Join a company driven by quality products across an evolving range of industries. **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Manufacturing Engineer II is the catalyst for technical problem solving and continuous improvement on the manufacturing line. This role works as part of a team dedicated to implementing and revising processes to maximize efficiency and meet customer expectations. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Monitor production process to improve; product flow, yield, and uptime. * Optimize current equipment and improve process capabilities. * Develop the team to utilize problem solving techniques and methods, and provide leadership in the identification, analysis, and resolution of issues. * Lead continuous improvement efforts within the line support team and manage product and process improvement initiatives on the production line. * Identify and implement process improvements to eliminate variation in the production process caused by equipment and/or product design. * Prioritize projects and issues that are associated with the production line using best business practices. * Leverage technical resources to incorporate line improvements and remove barriers. * Represent the production team by interfacing with other departments to ensure that quality and customer requirements are met. Work with production Group Leaders, Production Support Engineers (PSEs), and team members to resolve quality issues, line rejects/RMA (Return Materials Authorization). * Owns technical responses to 8D/RMA quality concerns and control methods to maintain and improve process capability * Mentor incoming PSEs, focusing on developing technical skills and problem\-solving issues. * Assist in the development of Control Plans, FMEA’s, Process Flow Charts and Assembly Drawings. * Other duties as assigned. **HOW YOU’LL DO IT** * Attention to Detail \- Ensuring information is complete and accurate; following up with others to ensure that agreements and commitments have been fulfilled. * Champion Change \- Understanding the need for change and helps planning for and accommodating it as creatively and positively as possible. * Planning and Aligning \- Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals. * Problem Solving \- Defining a problem, determining the cause, identifying, prioritizing and selecting alternatives for a solution, and implementing a solution. * Optimizing Work Processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement. * Mentoring and Coaching \- Providing timely guidance and feedback (both positive and constructive) to help others recognize strengths and development opportunities. Inviting tough conversations. * Maintaining a high level of honesty, integrity, and confidentiality with respect to company matters. * Complying with all company policies and procedures, safety regulations, company safety policies and safely perform all duties, including but not limited to, promoting a safe workplace. **WHAT TO BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in a technical, scientific, or related field. * 1\+ years of manufacturing experience. * Ability to learn and network the organization. * Proven analytical ability to understand and solve technical issues in a team\-oriented environment. * Inclination and willingness to get involved directly on the production floor. * Flexibility with work schedule to accommodate production and business needs, including occasional travel for vendors and customer visits. **WHAT WILL HELP** * Commitment to create a team\-based culture. * Self\-motivation and ability to work with minimal supervision. * Ability to understand/use SolidWorks, PLC’s and other manufacturing software platforms. **Gentex is an equal opportunity employer** Gentex extends equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees regardless of an individual’s race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), disability, marital status, military service, height, weight, genetic information, or any other reason protected by law. **Assistance** Gentex is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with programming in SQL, PL/SQL or T\-SQL. * 4 years of experience in database administration and relational database development on GCP (technology such Cloud SQL, SQL Server, AlloyDB, Spanner, Oracle, etc.) * 3 years of experience designing and implementing analytical reports and dashboards. * 2 years of experience building automation scripts using Python or Terraform. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience designing and implementing high\-performing database systems specific to semiconductor manufacturing. * Practical experience applying AI/ML technologies, particularly Gemini to boost organizational productivity and advance technical excellence. * Domain knowledge of key semiconductor operations, such as Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Statistical Process Control (SPC), SAP, MRP planning, capacity modeling, demand forecasting, and logistics. **About the job** ----------------- As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will drive strategic direction, technical design, and execution for complex database ecosystems supporting semiconductor manufacturing. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Analytics | US | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. **This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in the US or Canada.** #### **The Opportunity:** At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real\-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI\-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence. The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross\-functional partnership. We’re looking for a Senior Software (Database) Engineer to help build the underlying storage system for our general purpose data platform. The database layer has both OLAP and OTLP capabilities to support classic analytics queries while also serving up freshly stored data. It embraces the separation of compute and storage and is designed to run on multiple cloud providers. This is an early\-stage role on a high\-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production\-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative. #### **What You'll Be Doing:** * Take ownership over and build one or multiple parts of the database: Design, implement, test, and operate ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data formats, storage formats. * Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi\-tenant database service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries. * Power agent\-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and database interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve data quickly. * Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long\-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production. * Operate what you build: Instrument database services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability. * Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area. * Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams. * Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the database solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maint , catalogs and table formats, query engines. * Mastery of a programming language like golang, C\+\+, or Rust * Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users. * Exposure to working in cloud\-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure). * Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior. #### **Bonus Points for:** * Experience building distributed query engines. * Experience building data warehouses and/or data lakes. * Experience building tools for data engineering. **How we work:** We are a remote\-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product. **Compensation \& Rewards:** In the US, the Base compensation range for this role is $154,445 \- $185,334\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. jobs.title: Electrical / IoT & Embedded Hardware Engineer — FrySense
jobs.description: Electrical / IoT \& Embedded Hardware Engineer — FrySense **Location:** Raleigh\-Durham, NC — Hybrid, with regular hands\-on field work **Schedule:** 40 hours/week for the first 3 months; potential 10 hours/week for an additional 3 months **Pay:** $75\.00 to $90\.00 **Project:** FrySense IoT Platform Build It. Install It. Break It. Make It Better. Greasecycle is building **FrySense**, an IoT platform designed for the messy real world of commercial restaurant kitchens. FrySense connects to bulk cooking oil delivery, filtration, and waste oil systems. Sensors and cellular\-connected hardware tell us how much oil is in a tank, when a restaurant filters its fryers, when oil gets transferred, and when something isn't working correctly. We have working prototypes and real systems deployed at restaurants. Now we need an engineer who can help us turn a promising prototype into a reliable product. **This is not a sit\-behind\-a\-desk engineering job.** We want someone who likes building things with their hands, writing firmware, looking at data, and then driving to a restaurant in Raleigh or Durham to figure out why a sensor is giving us a weird reading. You might spend Monday programming an ESP32, Tuesday building a test rig, and Wednesday standing next to a 300\-gallon waste oil tank with a multimeter trying to understand what is actually happening. If that sounds fun, keep reading. The Mission Your job is simple: **Help us get FrySense from MVP to a field\-proven system we can confidently deploy across hundreds—and eventually thousands—of restaurant locations.** For the first **3 months, this is a full\-time, 40\-hour\-per\-week project.** We expect a fast development cycle with significant hands\-on testing and regular visits to deployed FrySense systems throughout the Raleigh\-Durham area. After the initial 3\-month sprint, there may be an opportunity to continue for another **3 months at approximately 10 hours per week** to support field performance, troubleshooting, firmware improvements, and the transition toward scaled production. What You'll Actually DoBuild \& Test Hardware You will evaluate and integrate sensors including: * Ultrasonic / time\-of\-flight liquid\-level sensors * Radar and other level\-sensing technologies * Current sensors / ammeters * Mechanical overflow floats * Relays and smart switches * Cellular IoT hardware You'll build benchtop prototypes, wiring harnesses, tank test systems, and whatever else we need to answer questions quickly. You'll test equipment against the things that actually matter: **hot cooking oil, grease, oil mist, condensation, vibration, electrical noise, restaurant employees, and time.** A beautiful prototype that only works on a workbench doesn't help us. Own Embedded Firmware You'll write, debug, and improve firmware for hardware such as: * Arduino R3/R4 * ESP32 and similar microcontrollers * Blues Wireless cellular hardware / Notehub You'll help solve problems involving power management, grounding, brownouts, sensor noise, connectivity, data transmission, and event detection. You'll maintain clean, documented code in GitHub so another engineer can pick up where you left off. Connect Hardware to the Cloud You'll help move data reliably from the restaurant to our FrySense dashboard. That includes: * Cellular IoT communication * JSON payloads * Webhooks * REST APIs * Event\-triggered reporting * Working with our web developers on backend integration You don't need to be a full\-stack developer. You **do** need to understand how data gets from a sensor bolted to a tank into a database that our software can use. Get Into the Field This part matters. **We specifically want someone willing to regularly visit restaurant locations throughout Raleigh, Durham, and the surrounding Triangle.** You'll install prototypes, inspect existing installations, pull data, talk with our operations team, troubleshoot failures, and compare what the software says with what is physically happening. Something isn't reading correctly? **Go look at it.** Sensor says a tank is 70% full but the tank looks empty? **Go figure out why.** A filtration event isn't showing up in the data? Bring a meter, open the enclosure, watch the system operate, and find the answer. We believe great hardware gets built by engineers who stay close to the equipment and the people actually using it. Who We're Looking For You may have a background in: * Electrical Engineering * Computer Engineering * Embedded Systems * Mechatronics * IoT product development * Or years of hands\-on experience building things that actually work The degree matters less than what you can build. You should be comfortable with several of these: * C/C\+\+ embedded programming * Arduino * ESP32 * Sensors and signal processing * Current sensing * Relays * Wiring and harness fabrication * Electrical schematics * Cellular IoT * Blues Wireless / Notehub or similar platforms * Webhooks and REST APIs * Git / GitHub * Multimeters, oscilloscopes, and basic electrical troubleshooting * Designing toward a custom PCB You'll Probably Love This Role If... You have a garage or workbench full of half\-finished projects. You would rather test an idea today than debate it for two weeks. When hardware fails, your first reaction is curiosity—not frustration. You don't mind getting your hands dirty. You're comfortable working independently without someone handing you a perfectly written specification. You can move between **firmware, wires, sensors, data, and physical equipment** without saying, "That's someone else's job." And when the data doesn't make sense, you're willing to drive 20 minutes to the restaurant and see what is actually happening. This Probably Isn't For You If... You want a fully remote engineering position. You only want to write firmware and hand hardware problems to someone else. You need requirements to be completely defined before starting. You prefer long development cycles and polished specifications over rapid testing. You don't want to crawl behind restaurant equipment, open an electrical enclosure, or troubleshoot a prototype in the field. There is nothing wrong with any of that. It just isn't this project. What Success Looks Like At the end of the initial 3\-month sprint, we want FrySense materially closer to a product we can deploy at scale. That means: **Reliable sensing. Reliable firmware. Reliable communication. Clean documentation. Real\-world validation.** We want to understand what works, what doesn't, and why. Most importantly, we want the next 100 installations to be better because of what we learned from the first ones. Engagement **Months 1–3:** Approximately **40 hours/week** This is the heavy build\-and\-test phase. Expect significant prototyping, firmware development, testing, documentation, and field work around the Raleigh\-Durham area. **Months 4–6:** Optional continuation at approximately **10 hours/week** If it makes sense for both sides, the role can transition into ongoing engineering support focused on field data, troubleshooting, firmware updates, design refinement, and production handoff. About Greasecycle Greasecycle is a Raleigh\-based environmental services company serving restaurants throughout the Southeast. We collect and recycle used cooking oil, service grease traps, and build systems that make restaurant oil management cleaner, safer, and more reliable. FrySense is our next step: connecting the physical equipment we already operate in the field with technology that helps restaurants use less oil, filter more effectively, prevent overflows, and operate more efficiently. We're scrappy. We move quickly. We test ideas in the real world. **If you want to build something you can actually drive across town and see working at a customer location, we'd like to talk to you.** We'd especially like to see **something you've built.** Tell us about one hardware or IoT project where you personally designed, wired, programmed, tested, or troubleshot the system. Even better: tell us about a time something worked perfectly on the bench, failed in the field, and **how you figured out why.** Pay: $70\.00 \- $90\.00 per hour Experience: * Electrical engineering: 2 years (Required) * Embedded software: 2 years (Required) * Mechatronics: 2 years (Required) * Computer Engineering: 2 years (Required) * IoT product development: 2 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Raleigh, NC 27610

We value diverse backgrounds and adding new perspectives. We encourage you to apply if you can make a strong impact in this role at* *www.greatamerica.com/careers**.* Please note, applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa.

The ideal candidate possesses strong troubleshooting abilities, hands\-on experience supporting enterprise firewalls, and working knowledge of modern Microsoft security technologies. This individual should be comfortable operating in a regulated financial services environment and capable of translating technical security issues into practical operational solutions. The position reports to the Security Operations Manager. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Palo Alto Firewall Administration (Primary Responsibility)** * Administer, maintain, and support Palo Alto Networks firewalls across all Bank environments. * Manage firewall policies, security rule requests, NAT configurations, and object administration. * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot site\-to\-site VPN and remote\-access VPN connectivity. * Monitor firewall health, performance, capacity, and availability. * Perform log analysis and traffic review to identify malicious activity, policy violations, and operational concerns. * Implement security policy changes in accordance with change management procedures. * Maintain network segmentation controls supporting secure banking operations. * Configure and support Palo Alto security services including: + Threat Prevention + GlobalProtect * Perform software upgrades, content updates, and security patching activities. * Assist with network architecture reviews and security design recommendations. * Maintain firewall documentation, network diagrams, and configuration standards. * Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity testing related to network security infrastructure. **Microsoft Security Operations (Secondary Responsibility)** * Assist with administration of Microsoft Defender security solutions. * Monitor and investigate alerts generated through Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel. * Support Microsoft Entra ID security controls and identity protection initiatives. * Assist with Conditional Access policy administration and review. * Support implementation and maintenance of Microsoft Secure Score recommendations. * Assist with email security and anti\-phishing technologies within Microsoft 365\. * Participate in vulnerability management and remediation activities. * Assist with implementation of security enhancements across Microsoft cloud services. * Maintain awareness of emerging Microsoft security capabilities and recommend improvements when appropriate. **Security Monitoring and Incident Response** * Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity. * Participate in incident response activities including analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery efforts. * Collect and preserve evidence during security investigations. * Document incidents, findings, corrective actions, and lessons learned. * Assist with threat hunting and security monitoring activities. * Escalate significant security events in accordance with established procedures. * Phishing investigations and security awareness support. **Compliance and Audit Support** * Assist with regulatory examinations and internal/external audits. * Support vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities. * Maintain documentation supporting security controls and operational processes. * Assist with remediation of audit findings and security recommendations. * Follow Bank security policies, standards, and procedures. * Support compliance with applicable regulatory and security requirements. * Support vendor security reviews and third\-party risk assessments. **Qualifications** **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Three to five years of information technology or cybersecurity experience. * Two or more years of hands\-on firewall administration experience. * Experience troubleshooting enterprise networking and security technologies. * Working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory environments. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking concepts. **Required Technical Skills** * security policy management. * Vulnerability management concepts. * Windows administration fundamentals. * Microsoft 365 administration fundamentals. * Security incident investigation and response. **Preferred Qualifications** * Palo Alto PCNSA certification. * Palo Alto PCNSE certification. * CompTIA Security\+ certification. * Experience with Microsoft Defender. * Experience with Microsoft Sentinel. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience with Microsoft Azure. * Experience within a financial services or regulated environment. * PowerShell scripting experience. **Core Competencies** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. * Attention to detail and accuracy. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and business teams. * Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit for extended periods while working on computer systems. * Ability to occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. * Ability to travel occasionally between Bank locations and vendor sites as needed.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Architect, Public Sector
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Solutions Architect **Compensation** ---------------- * $218\.8K – $300\.9K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= Harvey is bringing its AI platform to the U.S. federal government — defense and civilian agencies whose legal, acquisition, and program teams are asking how to adopt AI responsibly. You will be Harvey's first Solutions Architect dedicated to public sector: the technical lead on federal opportunities, the person who designs how Harvey is deployed securely inside government environments, and the one who writes the playbook the rest of the team will follow. You will sit at the intersection of Harvey's platform, agency stakeholders (legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program offices), and our Security \& Trust, Legal Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams. This is an opportunity to help define how AI is adopted across the federal government and to build a flagship public\-sector practice at one of the fastest\-moving companies in applied AI. **What You'll Do** ================== * Lead technical discovery and solution design for federal prospects and customers — defense and civilian — working with legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program stakeholders. * Design, document, and defend secure, compliant architectures for Harvey in government environments, including Harvey's FedRAMP High environment, identity and access patterns, integrations, and data\-handling requirements (CUI, records retention, auditability). * Own the technical thread on a focused portfolio of high\-impact federal accounts, from first conversation through rollout, adoption, and expansion. * Be the field\-facing technical partner to Security \& Trust on agency security reviews — FedRAMP High controls, DoD Impact Levels, ATO and authorization boundaries, NIST 800\-53 — and translate them for program owners and counsel. * Work with Legal Engineers and Customer Success Managers to turn agency workflows and legal or policy use cases into concrete solutions, reusable patterns, and implementation playbooks. * Be the public\-sector technical voice back into Harvey, synthesizing field feedback to inform roadmap, evaluation criteria, deployment options, and government\-specific documentation. * Represent Harvey's technical perspective in public\-sector forums — customer workshops, working groups, and stakeholder briefings — helping agencies understand both the possibilities and the limits of current AI systems. * Build the public\-sector Solutions Architecture playbook — qualification, security review, deployment patterns, and enablement — so the practice can scale beyond one person. **What You Have** ================= * 7\+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Direct experience selling to or supporting U.S. federal customers (Department of Defense and/or civilian agencies) at a SaaS or cloud provider, including navigating agency security reviews and procurement. * Working knowledge of federal compliance frameworks and how they shape deployment — FedRAMP, NIST 800\-53, DoD Impact Levels, ATO processes — and the ability to explain them to CISOs and program managers alike. * Hands\-on depth in SaaS security and identity architecture: SSO/SAML, SCIM, encryption and key management, data residency, audit logging. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical audiences — from program managers and attorneys to CISOs and enterprise architects — and credibility with senior public\-sector stakeholders. * Hands\-on engagement with modern AI systems (LLMs, prompt design, evaluation, deployment patterns) and a desire to help agencies adopt them responsibly. * Comfort operating in an emerging practice area: energized by ambiguity, willing to build new playbooks, motivated by real\-world impact on public services. **Preferred** ------------- * Prior government service or military experience. * Experience with Azure Government or other government cloud environments. * Experience selling through federal systems integrators or contract vehicles. * Background in legal, e\-discovery, or other document\-heavy enterprise workflows. **Compensation** ================ **$218,800 \- $300,900 USD** **Location** ============ Remote within Washington, DC area \- travel jobs.title: Certified Welding Inspector
jobs.description: **About HMT** HMT is the global leader in aboveground storage tank solutions. HMT brings a distinct level of innovation and service to the tank industry through a unique approach of partnering with customers to optimize tank operations. Knowing that every customer’s need is different, we use our decades of experience to customize solutions that help tank operations become more efficient, more productive, and more profitable. **About the Role:** The **Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)** plays a critical role in ensuring the quality and safety of welded structures and components across various industries within the United States. This position involves conducting thorough inspections and evaluations of welding processes, materials, and finished welds to verify compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications. The CWI collaborates closely with engineers, fabricators, and project managers to identify potential defects and recommend corrective actions, thereby preventing structural failures and ensuring long\-term durability. By maintaining detailed inspection records and reports, the CWI supports quality assurance programs and regulatory compliance efforts. Ultimately, this role contributes significantly to the integrity and reliability of infrastructure, machinery, and equipment that rely on welded assemblies. **Skills:** The Certified Welding Inspector utilizes a comprehensive understanding of welding techniques and standards to conduct precise inspections that ensure structural integrity and safety. Analytical skills are essential for interpreting complex engineering drawings and identifying deviations from specifications. Effective communication skills enable the CWI to clearly document findings and collaborate with engineers, fabricators, and project managers to resolve issues. Proficiency in non\-destructive testing methods allows the inspector to detect hidden defects without damaging components. Additionally, staying updated with evolving industry standards and technologies ensures that the CWI applies the most current best practices in daily inspection activities. **Responsibilities:** * Perform visual and non\-destructive testing (NDT) inspections on welds to assess quality and adherence to industry standards such as AWS, ASME, and API. * Review welding procedures, welder qualifications, and material certifications to ensure compliance with project requirements and codes. * Document inspection results, prepare detailed reports, and communicate findings to project stakeholders, recommending corrective measures when necessary. * Collaborate with fabrication teams to monitor welding activities, provide technical guidance, and ensure adherence to safety and quality protocols. * Stay current with industry developments, standards, and best practices to continuously improve inspection techniques and maintain certification. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Valid Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification from the American Welding Society (AWS). * Minimum of 3 years of experience in welding inspection or a related field. * Strong knowledge of welding processes, metallurgy, and applicable codes and standards (e.g., AWS D1\.1, ASME Section IX). * Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, welding procedure specifications (WPS), and inspection reports. * Ability to perform non\-destructive testing methods such as visual inspection, magnetic particle testing, and ultrasonic testing. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Additional certifications such as Senior Certified Welding Inspector (SCWI) or NDT certifications (e.g., Level II or III in UT, MT, PT). * Experience working in diverse industries such as oil and gas, construction, manufacturing, or aerospace. * Familiarity with digital inspection tools and software for reporting and data management. * Strong communication and leadership skills to effectively coordinate with multidisciplinary teams. * Knowledge of safety regulations and environmental standards related to welding operations. HMT is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We will not tolerate discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military or veteran status, mental or physical disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual expression, or any other unlawful reason. All qualified applicants are encouraged to submit applications for employment. Employment with HMT is At\-Will.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description: ***The Company*** Halo Industries has invented a revolutionary technology to replace a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based technology eliminates waste, improves material cost and performance, and drives advancements in high\-growth markets like automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo is well\-funded and poised for rapid growth, engaging strategic customers and preparing for volume manufacturing. ***The Opportunity*** As a Technical Writer, you will author, maintain, and standardize a wide range of technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), detailed work instructions, Quality records, and comprehensive training materials. This role bridges the knowledge gap between engineering, New Product Introduction (NPI), and quality assurance to ensure all procedures are clear, scalable, and compliant. You bring strong technical writing and visualization skills, with the ability to quickly grasp and document complex hardware assemblies, precision systems, and operational workflows. ***Role and Responsibilities*** * Develop and update assembly, alignment, calibration, and test procedures for laser\-based semiconductor tools. * Work closely with engineering, optical, and manufacturing teams to proactively capture accurate process details. * Produce illustrated work instructions and calibration/test guides using CAD drawings and photos. * Create standardized guides, SOPs, and technical onboarding templates for new hires. * Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, SEMI, and laser safety (ANSI Z136\) standards throughout all documentation. * Partner actively with manufacturing operators, engineers, and design engineers to champion Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives, ensuring documentation evolves with constructive feedback. **Requirements** ***Basic Qualifications*** * 3\+ years of technical writing experience in the capital equipment industry. * Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience developing documentation for complex systems across mechanical, optical, electrical, and software engineering disciplines. * Skilled at translating complex technical concepts into clear, universally accessible documentation. * Experience in developing and delivering technical training programs. * Strong attention to detail, version control discipline, and procedural accuracy. * Excellent written communication and visual presentation skills. * Proactive communication style with a proven ability to confidently interface with and interview engineering and NPI Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). * Experience using PLM systems (e.g., Arena) for formal document control. * Proficiency with Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and modern AI productivity tools. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * Working knowledge of optomechanical assemblies, laser alignment, and motion/robotic subsystems. * Proficient and reading and interpreting mechanical, electrical, and optical schematics. * Basic understanding of CAD viewing tools (SolidWorks) for extracting illustrations. * Working knowledge of SEMI and EHS documentation standards. * Experience documenting compliance for ISO 9001, SEMI, and ANSI Z136 laser safety standards. * Embraces a Continuous Improvement (CI) mindset, regularly auditing existing documentation for clarity, accuracy, and process efficiency. * High technical agility, with a track record of rapidly mastering and retaining knowledge of complex, proprietary hardware workflows. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Free Food \& Snacks * Stock Option Plan * Annual Bonus Plan eligible * Base Salary Range: $110K \- $125K *Additional Information* We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description: **Halvik Corp** delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500\+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting\-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special! **Position Overview** The Senior Full Stack Developer will design and build end to end applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular to deliver scalable and modern digital solutions. They will develop RESTful microservices and intuitive front\-end interfaces that support seamless user experiences. This role involves deploying and optimizing applications on AWS Cloud, ensuring high availability, security, and performance. The developer will leverage AI powered tools to enhance productivity, automate workflows, and improve code quality. A key responsibility is modernizing legacy systems, including refactoring monolithic applications into cloud native architectures. The role includes contributing to architectural decisions and providing technical guidance to team members. applications using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and Angular to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high performance solutions. * Build responsive, accessible, and user friendly UI components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Integrate backend services with front end applications, ensuring seamless data flow and consistent user experiences. * Deploy, manage, and optimize applications on AWS Cloud using services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM. * Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline to automate alternatives. * Write unit, integration, and end to end tests using JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Karma, or similar frameworks. * Conduct performance tuning for both backend and frontend components, authorization, input validation, and data protection. * Ensure compliance with organizational, industry, and regulatory standards when designing and deploying applications. * Use AWS security tools and best practices to safeguard cloud hosted applications. * Maintain clear, concise technical documentation for APIs, system architecture, deployment processes, and codebases. * Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI tools to enhance development efficiency and system capabilities. * Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and technical innovation across All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description: **About Handshake** =================== Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions. In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. **Why join Handshake now:** * Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel * Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions * Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders * Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue **The Role** ------------ Reporting to the Director, Account Management \- Enterprise, you'll partner with our Enterprise Client Success Management partners to ensure our employer partners see value in the Handshake product in order to retain and grow a key segment of our business. We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our Employer Sales Team \- working with top employers across the nation to drive their early talent recruiting strategy. You will serve as the primary owner of a set book of existing employer partners, working closely with them to ensure they achieve their goals, build relationships with executives, and drive customer retention and expansion from onboarding through renewal. This high\-impact role combines equal parts sales, relationship management and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate has a proven record managing relationships at scale while driving renewals and expansions in a *Saas* technology company. * Effectively renew, upsell and cross\-sell an assigned book of business of existing premium employer partners with an emphasis on growth * Learn your book of business inside and out to effectively position Handshake’s value proposition, always linking it back to key business issues of the customer * Develop and cultivate deep relationships with senior executives at the Director, SVP, VP, and C\-suite levels at our partners * Develop new and creative ways to engage senior executives throughout the customer lifecycle and demonstrate Handshake’s value * Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake * Manage and present data and value\-driven Quarterly Business Reviews * Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials * Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers * Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers * Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech *Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.* *Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.* **You Have** ------------ * At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role * Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning * A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies * Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team * Experience using usage, data and results to demonstrate value and justify expansion * An impeccable communicator with polished and professional sales presentation skills * Experience operating in a high\-growth business environment like Handshake **We Offer** ------------ Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life. ***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.*** **Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company **Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching **Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching **Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend **Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development **Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office **Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days **Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers. Compensation Range: $179\.2K \- $224K

jobs.title: Civil Foreman
jobs.description: Construction Foreman – Civil, Grading \& Utilities **Harbor Civil \& Marine** Position Summary Harbor Civil \& Marine is seeking an experienced **Construction Foreman** to lead field crews on civil construction, grading, stormwater, water utility, drainage, and related infrastructure projects. The Construction Foreman is responsible for the safe, efficient, and successful daily operation of assigned projects. Working closely with the Project Manager and Superintendent, this position will coordinate crews, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and daily construction activities to ensure work is completed safely, accurately, on schedule, and in accordance with project plans and specifications. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader with strong experience in **grading, underground utilities, storm drainage, site work, and heavy equipment operation**. Candidates must be comfortable reading civil plans, establishing and checking grades, directing crews, and taking ownership of field production. Duties \& Responsibilities * Direct, supervise, and motivate field crews to complete work safely, efficiently, and productively. * Plan and coordinate daily construction activities, including manpower, equipment, materials, and subcontractor operations. * Perform and supervise the installation of **storm drainage and water systems**, including pipe, fittings, valves, structures, manholes, and related components. * Establish, shoot, and verify grades and elevations to ensure construction conforms to approved plans and specifications. * Perform and supervise site grading, excavation, trenching, backfilling, compaction, and final grading operations. * Read and interpret civil construction plans, profiles, details, specifications, and project documents. * Lay out work and provide clear direction to operators, laborers, pipe crews, and assigned helpers. * Operate excavators, skid steers, loaders, compactors, and other construction equipment as necessary. * Identify field conflicts and communicate potential problems, changes, or delays to the Project Manager or Superintendent. * Inspect completed work for quality and verify that installations meet project requirements. * Maintain accurate jobsite documentation, including daily reports, employee time, quantities, delivery tickets, photographs, and As\-Built information. * Coordinate material deliveries and ensure necessary tools, equipment, and materials are available to maintain production. * Maintain an organized, professional, and safe jobsite. * Ensure crews follow company safety policies, OSHA requirements, erosion and sediment control requirements, and project\-specific safety procedures. * Conduct or participate in daily safety meetings and job hazard assessments as required. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, subcontractors, inspectors, engineers, clients, and project management. * Provide leadership and training to crew members while promoting accountability, teamwork, and professional development. * Work independently on routine projects with limited supervision and take ownership of assigned work. * Perform additional field and construction duties as required to successfully complete assigned projects. Minimum Qualifications * Minimum **4 years of experience in civil construction, grading, and underground utility installation**, preferably in a Foreman or lead position. * Demonstrated experience installing **stormwater, drainage, and water piping systems**. * Strong knowledge of excavation, trenching, grading, backfilling, compaction, and site construction. * Ability to read and understand **civil drawings, grading plans, profiles, details, and specifications**. * Ability to establish, shoot, calculate, and verify grades and elevations. * Experience operating heavy construction equipment. * Experience with hand tools, power tools, pipe installation, and pipe\-fitting operations. * Ability to maintain jobsite documentation, including daily reports, time sheets, quantities, photographs, and As\-Built drawings. * Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to coordinate multiple field activities while maintaining productivity and quality. * Valid driver's license with a driving record that meets company requirements. * High School Diploma or GED required. * Technical school, construction\-related training, or an equivalent combination of education and field experience is preferred. Physical \& Work Requirements * Ability to work outdoors in varying weather and jobsite conditions. * Ability to lift, carry, and move tools, materials, and equipment weighing up to 40 pounds. * Ability to safely work around excavations, trenches, slopes, water, heavy equipment, and active construction operations. * Ability to climb ladders and access construction areas as required. * Ability to work extended hours, early mornings, occasional weekends, or alternative schedules when required by project conditions. * Ability to travel to project locations as required. * Ability to successfully complete required safety training and customer or project\-specific access requirements. Preferred Qualifications * OSHA construction safety training. * Competent Person training for excavation and trench safety. * Erosion and sediment control experience. * Experience with GPS, laser levels, transits, or other construction layout and grade\-control equipment. * Experience with construction management software such as **Procore** or similar field reporting platforms. * Experience working with inspectors, engineers, municipalities, HOAs, and private project owners. * Experience leading crews on stormwater management, dam, drainage, utility, or other civil infrastructure projects. What We Are Looking For Harbor Civil \& Marine is looking for a **working Foreman—not simply a supervisor**. The successful candidate will be comfortable leading from the field, operating equipment when necessary, checking grades, solving construction challenges, maintaining production, and helping the crew get the job done correctly. We value individuals who take pride in their work, hold themselves and their crews accountable, communicate effectively, and understand that **safety, quality, and productivity go hand in hand**. This position offers an opportunity to join an established Virginia construction company performing specialized **civil, stormwater, dam, dredging, marine, and water\-related infrastructure projects**. Pay: $34\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Benefits: * Profit sharing * Referral program * Retirement plan Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer V
jobs.description: **What You'll Be Doing** ======================== **Job Scope:** Generally be responsible for performing all front end phase electrical load studies, ETAP modeling, specification reviews for switchgears and transformers, etc. using theoretical knowledge and practical design methods. This work will be performed under general supervision. **Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:** * Familiarity with and utilizing department design and drafting standards. * Familiarity with project scope, specifications and design criteria upon assignment to a project task team. * Recognize and communicate scope and design changes promptly. * On\-site assistance during startup. * Producing estimate level preliminary designs and material take\-offs suitable for the level of the estimate being performed on a project. * Producing detail design calculations and sketches for materials of construction associated with the project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by others and efficient use by drafters/designers for preparing drawings and as a deliverable when required. * Producing designs with efficient use of construction materials with an overall emphasis on ease of construction and completed product meeting the expectations of the client. * Checking calculations made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, conformance to codes, specifications, design criteria and conformance to good engineering practice. * Assisting the drafting group in resolving routine layout and detailing problems. It is your responsibility to furnish sufficient sketches and details necessary for completion of engineering drawings. * Consulting with design leaders from other disciplines to ensure the smooth flow of vital information necessary for the scheduled completion of the project. * Advising the senior engineer concerning design or scope changes, which have been identified. * Assisting other engineers in developing and assembling scopes, drawings and specifications into a “package”, enabling electrical/instrumentation purchase inquiries to be issued for procurement of materials or subcontract pricing. * Reviewing and checking vendor drawings and other discipline drawings for electrical/instrumentation input. * Developing construction specifications. * Reviewing fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for conformance to engineering drawings and specifications. * Performing fieldwork necessary to gather field data, check tie\-ins and provide construction support. * Provide technical guidance to less experienced drafting and engineering personnel in the department. * Knowledge of the discipline specific methods, practices and techniques required to engineer, design and construct process and manufacturing projects. * Applying advanced engineering techniques and analysis to complex designs. * Produce installation details, motor control center single lines, electric room layouts, motor control elementaries, connection diagrams, cable schedules, control panel layouts and grounding, lighting, power and instrumentation plans under general supervision. * Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the simplest, most efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand. * Developing small work sharing packages for interoffice execution support. This position offers a highly competitive compensation package, including paid time off, health insurance benefits, and matching retirement contributions. **Ideal Background** ==================== **Education:** Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university is required. **Registration:** Professional Engineering registration is highly preferred. **Experience:** This position requires 3\+ years of relevant industrial experience in electrical and instrumentation engineering. **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Knowledge and application of the current version of the National Electrical Code (NEC). * Familiarity with specifications and installation details of construction bulk materials and equipment. * Ability to perform lighting level calculations. * Ability to size wire, conduit and overcurrent protection for both lighting and power applications. * Ability to perform voltage drop calculations. * Ability to route conduit and cable tray. * Ability to calculate tray and conduit fill. * Ability to determine motor control center loading. * Ability to create accurate electrical installation documents from the information found on vendor equipment drawings. * Ability to determine load center unit substation loading. * (Instrumentation) Ability to size control valves using appropriate software. * (Instrumentation) Ability to develop specifications and data sheets for instrumentation, analyzers, control systems and actuated valves. * (Instrumentation) Familiarity with standards that apply to instrumentation and controls (ISA). * Ability to develop equipment specifications for equipment such as motor control centers, variable frequency drivers, induction and synchronous motors, load center unit substations. * Knowledge and understanding of schedule constraints and information requirements for the production of all electrical deliverables. * Ability to develop a construction cost estimate, a detailed engineering schedule and a man\-hour budget for a small project or an area for a larger project. * Ability to determine construction material quantities. * Knowledge and application of company engineering design and CAD drafting standards. * Working knowledge of CAD software, either AutoCAD, Microstation or both. * Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. * Good presentation skills. * Virtual team skills and cross divisional relationships are developed and able to provide interoffice execution support with general supervision. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time. **Hargrove Culture** ==================== We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company\-wide level. We know that each person on our team contributes to the success of our company by pairing expertise and passion to meet and exceed the needs of the clients we serve across the globe. Our safety culture protects and promotes the well\-being of every person who works with us and every person touched by our work. As a 100% Teammate owned company, we proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package including, paid holidays, personal paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and other benefits to eligible Teammates. **Equal Opportunity Employment Statement** ========================================== Hargrove is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sexual identity, marital or family status), disability, military service or obligations, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Hargrove is a drug\-free workplace. The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.
