jobs.title: AI Engineer – Trust & Explainability (AI Platform)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ US Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Research \& Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $104,148 – $177,600 MeridianLink runs a comprehensive background check, credit check, and drug test as part of our offer process. I**t is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the salary range.** The actual salary will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law including geographical location. Meridianlink offers: * Insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision, life, and disability) * Flexible paid time off * Paid holidays * 401(k) plan with company match * Remote work All compensation and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying plans or programs, as applicable and as may be amended, terminated, or superseded from time to time. \#LI\-REMOTE **AI Engineer – Trust \& Explainability (AI Platform)** **Job Summary** The AI Platform team is building the shared runtime that every AI agent at MeridianLink will run on as part of the MeridianLink One platform: model gateway, orchestration, memory, and observability, delivered as reusable services so product teams build agents once and run them safely for hundreds of credit union and lender customers. This role builds the trust and explainability layer of that runtime: the tracing, evaluation, and explanation capabilities that let engineers understand exactly what a multi\-agent workflow did and why, and that let product teams show end customers the right level of explanation to trust an agent's output. This role has a strong dotted\-line relationship to MeridianLink's Security Operations team, so the platform's trust guarantees and Security's threat models are built from the same picture. **About the Opportunity** This is a deeply technical, hands\-on engineering role and an integral part of the platform itself. You will write the code that traces agent actions across a multi\-agent workflow, adopt and extend leading open\-source explainability and observability frameworks, and build the primitives product teams use to surface explanations to lenders, credit unions, and their borrowers. You should have real hands\-on experience with LLM\-based systems and a strong pull toward the problems of trust, tracing, and evaluation. You do not need to be an expert in all of it. This is a place to build that expertise while the platform is being built, working alongside a Staff engineer team lead and architects who will invest in your growth. ***What it means to be an L2 AI Engineer at MeridianLink*** L2 AI Engineers handle a broad range of work independently, from bug fixes to feature development. They have developed a specialization and are deepening it. They write code that other engineers trust, ask good questions, and are starting to help the engineers around them. L2 AI Engineers at MeridianLink are active, daily users of AI\-assisted development tools. ***Technical Execution \& Delivery*** * Completes assigned features and bug fixes independently, with limited need for day\-to\-day guidance * Designs components within a well\-defined scope; escalates questions on complex system design rather than guessing * Participates in code review and provides constructive feedback * Surfaces blockers proactively rather than waiting for check\-ins ***Craft \& Professionalism*** * Writes tests that cover the functionality they ship * Monitors and responds to issues with their own work * Documents decisions and implementation details that others will need later ***Agent Tracing \& Explainability*** * Understands how to instrument an agent so a single conversation can be followed from the first user message through every model call, tool call, retrieval, agent handoff, and decision to the final response * Builds the correlation that ties actions across multiple agents in one workflow into a single readable trace * Turns raw trace data into an explanation a human can follow: what the agent did, what it relied on, and why it chose that path ***Customer\-Facing Trust \& Explanation*** * Understands that the explanation an engineer needs and the explanation a borrower or loan officer needs are different, and builds for both * Works with product engineers on what an agent should disclose at the product surface: what it did, what data it used, how confident it was, and what a human should verify * Applies judgment about the right level of explanation for a regulated lending and account\-opening context ***Trust \& Explainability Frameworks*** * Familiar with the open\-source landscape for LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation, and can evaluate a framework against the platform's needs * Integrates and extends existing frameworks rather than rebuilding them, and builds what does not exist yet * Keeps the platform's instrumentation aligned to emerging standards so traces stay portable across to ner with product engineers on the Document Request Agent and the MLM agents to land those primitives in real products * Iterate on the explanation format based on feedback from product teams and customer\-facing staff ***Trust \& Explainability Frameworks*** * Evaluate and integrate open\-source observability, tracing, and evaluation frameworks into the platform runtime * Extend those frameworks where our agent workloads need more than they offer, and contribute fixes and extensions back upstream where it makes sense * Build the gaps: the pieces of trust and explainability tooling the ecosystem does not provide yet ***Evaluation Tooling*** * Build and maintain components of the platform's evaluation framework: golden dataset management, test runners, scoring pipelines, and regression reporting * Build the tooling that helps teams create and version golden datasets from de\-identified real traffic and synthetic cases * Run model and prompt comparisons for the platform's shared components and report what changed ***Safety \& Isolation Testing*** * Build red\-team and adversarial test suites covering prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, tool misuse, and data exfiltration, and run them in the platform's release process * Build the automated test suite that proves agents on the shared runtime cannot cross tenant boundaries through memory, retrieval, tool calls, or model context * Share red\-team findings and new attack patterns with Security Operations and pull their threat models into the platform's tests ***Collaboration \& Growing Others*** * Participate in design discussions and code reviews; give and receive feedback constructively * Support onboarding of L1 AI Engineer teammates; share context and help them get unblocked * Contribute to documentation that reduces tribal knowledge on the team **Qualifications** **Required Experience** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, delivering features independently in a production environment * Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design fundamentals * Proficiency with standard development tooling: Git, Docker, automated testing, and modern scripting languages * Active daily use of AI\-assisted development tools * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience * Hands\-on experience building software that integrates large language models (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, or similar), in production or in substantial personal or open\-source projects * Proficiency in Python with production experience; TypeScript a plus * Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following, with real interest in growing into the others: LLM observability and tracing, LLM evaluation and testing, agent frameworks and multi\-agent orchestration, or application security testing * Experience with distributed tracing or observability tooling in a production system * Strong automated testing instincts, including an interest in how to test systems that do not return the same answer twice * Experience running workloads on Azure or AWS, including the basics of identity and access management, networking, and secrets management **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with OpenTelemetry, including the GenAI semantic conventions, or OpenLLMetry * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools (Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, Braintrust, promptfoo, DeepEval, or equivalent) * Contributions to open\-source AI observability, evaluation, or agent framework projects * Experience with cloud\-managed model services such as AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI * Experience building or operating multi\-tenant SaaS systems where tenant isolation was a hard requirement * Prior experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry where explainability shaped technical decisions * Experience building developer\-facing debugging or visualization tools Compensation Range: $104,148 \- $177,600 Apply for this Job

jobs.title: Principal Data and AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **General Information** **Location** Cary, North Carolina Alternative Location(s) * Posting Location: New York, New York Working Schedule Full\-Time Work Arrangement Hybrid Travel Required 10% Relocation Assistance Available No Grade 13T Posted Date 28\-Sep\-2026 Job ID 20769 ### **Description and Requirements** **The Team You Will Join** At MetLife, data isn’t just a tool – it is a catalyst for growth. As part of our Data \& Analytics organization, you’ll unlock trusted insights that drive bold decisions, power personalized customer experiences, and deliver lasting business impact. We’re building the future of data – one that’s governed responsibly, engineered for scalability, and designed for growth. When you join us, you’re not just supporting the business – you’re empowering it. Let’s transform insight into impact and data into action, together. **The Opportunity** The Data \& AI Product Engineer is a hands\-on technologist who sets the technical direction for how MetLife builds and consumes data and AI capabilities. The role defines what the enterprise needs, architects the target state from a blank page, and drives it through to production. It spans data science, data engineering and data strategy. This is a forward\-deployed role, not a portfolio or project management role. It requires the ability to take an ambiguous, high\-stakes problem spanning multiple systems, owners, and constraints and reduce it to a defensible architecture and a sequenced delivery plan, then build against it hands\-on. It also requires the credibility to bring that recommendation directly to executive leadership and change the decision on what MetLife should build, what it should not, and how data and AI capabilities integrate with the broader IT landscape. **Key Responsibilities** * Work with domain stakeholders to identify capability needs, assess feasibility early, and translate problems into implementable requirements. * Help shape the technical direction for MetLife's data and AI landscape, defining the target state, the build\-versus\-buy position, and the sequence of investments required to get there, and keeping that direction current as the platform and vendor market shifts. * Take on the large and ambiguous cross\-cutting initiatives, such as semantic layer enablement and preparing enterprise data for frontier AI models, and bring structure to them: frame the problem, establish the decision criteria, resolve competing technical positions on evidence, and carry the work from concept through enterprise adoption. * Architect solutions from a blank page: target\-state architectures, data flow and integration diagrams, and component models precise enough to build from directly. * Design and deliver hands\-on solutions across data science and data engineering. * Review design and code from concept through production and own the production\-readiness decision. * Guide enterprise initiatives toward the right capability, ensuring teams build on approved platforms and existing solutions rather than duplicating them, and steering misaligned approaches early. * Serve as the trusted technical voice for data and AI with senior executive stakeholders, including the CDO, CIO, and their leadership teams. Frame trade\-offs and recommendations so non\-technical executives can decide with confidence, and secure the alignment and investment required to move a direction forward. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science/AI, and data strategy, including 3\+ years leading the technical direction of a platform, product, or capability. * Proven track record delivering and operating production\-grade data or AI solutions. * Experience designing data and AI architectures, evaluating and building platforms/vendors, and making build vs. buy decisions. * Strong hands\-on skills in Python and SQL, with experience reviewing production code and validating models. * Experience with machine learning and generative AI, including RAG and agent\-based architectures. * Deep understanding of modern data platforms, data pipelines, APIs, integrations, and cloud\-based data architectures. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Advanced degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * **Regulated\-environment platform experience:** insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, including platform security (access controls, PII handling, encryption, audit logging), infrastructure\-as\-code, and cloud cost management. * **MLOps and model governance:** experiment tracking, CI/CD for models, inference patterns, drift monitoring, explainability (SHAP or equivalent), and model\-risk readiness. * **Semantic layer and AI\-ready data:** semantic layer design and metric governance, data contracts, catalog and lineage, making enterprise data consuma xed organization without formal authority; builds durable credibility with senior executives, becoming the person leadership consults before committing to a data or AI direction; operates without a defined brief, deciding what the organization should work on and not only how to build it; raises the technical bar for peers through review, mentoring, and the architecture patterns they set. \#LI\-WRAPJOBAGS Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role **requiring a minimum of 3 days per week** in office. *The expected salary range* *for this position is $164,600* *\- $213,100**. This role may also be eligible for annual short\-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.* **Benefits We Offer** Our U.S. benefits address holistic well\-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no\-cost short\- and long\-term disability. We also provide company\-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please **click here****.** **About MetLife** Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value. Our purpose is simple \- to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values \- Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead \- we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s \#AllTogetherPossible. Join us! *MetLife is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made without regards to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status (although applicants and employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States), uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law (“protected characteristics”).* *If you need an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at accommodations@metlife.com. This information will be held in confidence and used only to determine an appropriate accommodation for the application process.* *MetLife maintains a drug\-free workplace.* *This posting is for a current vacancy and is anticipated to remain open for at least 90 days from the listed posting date.*

jobs.title: Oil and Gas Pipeline Engineer - Mi-Tech Services, Inc.
jobs.description: As a full\-service engineering, design, and construction services firm, Mi\-Tech delivers comprehensive, in\-house support for utility, infrastructure and heavy civil projects from planning and design through execution. Our multidisciplinary team provides practical, innovative solutions that emphasize cost efficiency, constructability, and long\-term value. Founded in 1985, Mi\-Tech has built a reputation for excellence in engineering, design, environmental, laboratory, technical, and field support across the many industries we serve. As a proud member of the Michels Family of Companies, Mi\-Tech collaborates across our internationally respected roster of construction craft and professionals to deliver integrated, end\-to\-end solutions that meet the highest standards of quality and performance. An Oil and Gas Pipeline Engineer is responsible for the design, analysis, and integrity of piping systems that support oil, gas, and water conveyance and transportation operations. This role develops efficient piping layouts, performs hydraulic and stress analyses, reviews P\&IDs and isometric drawings, and ensures all systems meet ASME, API, ASTM, and water‑industry standards. The engineer supports fabrication, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for issues such as flow, pressure, vibration, and corrosion, ensuring full compliance with project requirements and HSE regulations. Why Mi\-Tech Services Inc.? * We are committed to hiring the best people and giving them the best equipment. * We deliver innovative infrastructure solutions that improve energy distribution, expand connectivity, and create lasting value for the communities around us. * Our steady, strategic growth revolves around a commitment to quality. If it's worth doing, it's worth doing right. * We are family owned and operated. We work to see each other succeed, not to increase stock market valuation. * We invest an average of $5,000 per employee in training each year. We want each of our teams to learn and grow. * We believe everyone is responsible for promoting safety, regardless of job title. We are our brothers' and sisters' keepers. * We are a part of the Michels Family of Companies – one of North America's largest, most diversified energy and infrastructure construction companies. Why you? * You like to surround yourself with dedicated, genuine, value\-driven people. * You are up to new challenges and opportunities. You like to learn and try new things. * You like to know your efforts are noticed and appreciated. * You believe that individual commitment to a group effort is key to success. * You want your work to make a tangible difference in people's lives. What it takes: * Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering field * 5\+ years of relevant engineering experience * Experience with oil and gas and/or water piping design, facility engineering, or pipeline projects * Ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometric drawings, and construction drawings * Professional Engineering (PE) license * Proficient user of Microsoft Office Suite * Experience with AutoCAD, CADWorx, or similar design software desired * Experience with CAESAR II strongly preferred * Knowledge of ASME B31\.3, applicable API codes, and water pipeline design standards * Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to accommodate occasional travel for meetings, site visits, and short\-term construction assignments * Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record AA/EOE/M/W/Vet/Disability https://www.michels.us/website\-user\-privacy\-policy/

jobs.title: Network Technician
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- The Network Technician is responsible for supporting the physical\-layer network infrastructure within hyperscale AI and accelerated computing data center environments. This role focuses on deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of structured cabling systems, fiber plant infrastructure, optics, network hardware, out\-of\-band (OOB) management networks, and console connectivity systems. The Network Technician serves as the primary onsite resource for physical network operations, ensuring the reliability and integrity of the network infrastructure supporting mission\-critical computing environments. The role works closely with customer network engineering teams, data center operations personnel, OEM partners, and deployment teams to support network expansion, break\-fix activities, and operational readiness. This position requires strong technical discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to execute customer\-directed activities within highly controlled operational environments. How You Will Make an Impact Fiber Plant Operations * Install, route, label, and maintain fiber optic infrastructure supporting production and non\-production environments. * Support MPO/MTP trunk deployments, patching, and remediation activities. * Perform fiber testing, certification, and validation using approved testing methodologies and equipment. * Troubleshoot physical\-layer connectivity issues and support fault isolation efforts. * Verify compliance with bend radius, cable routing, and fiber management standards. * Support contamination prevention programs, fiber inspection, and connector cleaning procedures. Structured Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure * Install, route, terminate, label, and document structured copper and fiber cabling systems. * Support deployment and expansion activities for new racks, pods, and network infrastructure. * Validate cabling installations against customer standards, floor plans, and port maps. * Conduct physical audits and quality inspections of deployed network infrastructure. * Maintain cable management systems and infrastructure documentation. Network Hardware Support * Install, replace, and validate network hardware components, including: * Optics and transceivers * Network switches * Console servers * OOB management devices * Patch panels and associated infrastructure * Support directed hardware replacement and maintenance activities. * Assist customer network engineers with troubleshooting and restoration efforts. * Participate in hardware acceptance testing and operational readiness activities. OOB \& Console Infrastructure * Support Out\-of\-Band (OOB) management networks and console connectivity infrastructure. * Install and maintain console cabling and access systems. * Verify console connectivity and operational readiness. * Assist with troubleshooting console access and management network issues. * Support customer\-directed changes within OOB environments. Network Deployment \& Expansion * Support deployment of network infrastructure associated with new site launches, hall expansions, and capacity growth initiatives. * Execute physical\-layer tasks associated with network turn\-up activities. * Participate in deployment readiness reviews and acceptance tes twork infrastructure best practices. * Support onboarding and training activities for operational personnel. * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on network reliability and deployment quality. * Demonstrate professionalism and customer\-focused communication skills. Minimum Qualifications * High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience supporting structured cabling, network deployment, or data center infrastructure environments. * Experience installing and troubleshooting fiber optic and copper cabling systems. * Familiarity with optics, transceivers, and physical\-layer networking concepts. * Ability to read deployment documentation, rack elevations, floor plans, and network diagrams. * Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI, HPC, or enterprise data center environments. * Experience with MPO/MTP infrastructure, fiber certification, and network testing methodologies. * Familiarity with leaf\-spine network architectures and large\-scale data center deployments. * Experience supporting OOB management networks and console infrastructure. * Knowledge of structured cabling standards and industry best practices. * Experience working within 24x7 mission\-critical operational environments. * Vendor certifications such as BICSI, FOA, Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or equivalent are preferred. * Experience supporting commissioning, deployment, and expansion activities. Physical Requirements * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods within active data center environments. * Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Ability to work in confined spaces, overhead cable pathways, and rack environments. * Ability to distinguish cable labeling, connector types, and color\-coded infrastructure. * Ability to safely use ladders and perform elevated work activities when required. Work Environment This position operates within a mission\-critical data center environment supporting advanced AI and accelerated computing infrastructure. Work includes fiber plant operations, structured cabling deployment, optics replacement, network infrastructure support, OOB connectivity management, and deployment activities supporting highly available computing environments. The Network Technician plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and scalability of the physical network infrastructure that enables customer production operations. **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: $43\.74 \- $49\.43 USD Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: Mirage is an AI\-native video platform that intelligently orchestrates production and editing through natural language. Our models leverage contextual awareness to execute the same creative decisions a professional editor would — dramatically improving productivity for experienced teams, while making video creation accessible to anyone. * Grubhub subscription * Health \& Wellness Perks * Multiple team offsites per year with team events every month * Generous PTO policy Captions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. *Please note benefits apply to full time employees only.* Compensation Range: $175K \- $300K

automation using languages and tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Azure CLI. * Strong understanding of network security principles, encryption protocols, identity management, authentication, authorization, and Zero Trust security principles. * Familiarity with implementing and managing security policies and controls in Azure environments to enforce organizational policies and compliance standards. * Experience with cloud security posture management and vulnerability management tools such as Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or similar platforms. * Ability to investigate security findings and translate them into actionable remediation steps, including infrastructure\-as\-code changes where appropriate. * Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or similar. * Excellent problem\-solving As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato's AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner. jobs.title: Part-time Faculty Workforce Development Continuing Education (WDCE) AWS AI
jobs.description: *Montgomery College accepts applications for Adjunct/Part\-time Faculty on a continuous basis. Applications may be reviewed periodically based on the student enrollment needs. The listing of a course in the schedule of classes as “TBA” does not constitute an assignment. The hiring decision for part\-time faculty involves an academic judgment and shall be determined at Management’s sole discretion.* **Job Description** ------------------- Montgomery College Workforce Development \& Continuing Education (WDCE) is currently accepting applications for a part\-time faculty opening to teach an AWS Certified AI Practitioner course. We are seeking an enthusiastic, dedicated teacher who demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, a strong commitment to our students, and the ability to motivate and educate in an engaging manner. **\*\*\*Montgomery College accepts applications for Adjunct/Part\-time Faculty on a** **continuous basis****. Applications may be reviewed periodically based on student enrollment needs.** \*\*\* * The listing of a course in the schedule of classes as “TBA” does not constitute an assignment. * The hiring decision for part\-time faculty involves an academic judgment and shall be determined at Management’s sole discretion. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Deliver hands\-on, skills\-based instruction aligned with the AWS Certified AI Practitioner certification exam, course objectives, and current industry standards. * Teach adult students on foundational concepts and practical applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning within the AWS ecosystem, including generative AI, foundation models, responsible AI, and common AWS AI services. * Prepare students to understand and apply AWS technologies and services relevant to AI solutions, with an emphasis on real\-world business and workplace applications. * Incorporate hands\-on activities, demonstrations, labs, and real\-world scenarios to help students develop practical AI skills and prepare for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner examination. * Support adult learners with diverse technical experience by presenting complex AI concepts clearly, accessibly, and practically. * Stay current with developments in AWS AI services, generative AI technologies, and industry practices to ensure course content remains relevant and up to date. * Facilitate courses in\-person and/or remotely during weekday evenings or Saturdays. * Collaborate with program staff and faculty on curriculum development and updates. * Maintain accurate attendance records and submit administrative tasks promptly. * Provide students with effective support, communication, and timely feedback. **Required Qualifications:** * Current AWS Certified AI Practitioner certification or equivalent expertise in AWS artificial intelligence and generative AI technologies. * Professional experience working with AWS cloud services, with demonstrated knowledge of AWS AI and machine learning services. * Hands\-on experience with generative AI, including foundation models, large language models (LLMs), and AI applications. * Practical experience using generative AI tools and platforms, preferably including Amazon Bedrock and other AWS services. * Strong communication skills and a passion for teaching adult learners. * Able to teach in person. * Dependable, punctual, and committed to student success. * Successful candidates will have a demonstrated commitment to promoting belonging, inclusion, and multicultural competence in an educational and work environment and must be willing to contribute to the College’s strategic plan of inclusion. * Faculty members are expected to have access to a personal computer with virus protection that can connect to the internet outside of the work location (i.e., office, classroom, college campus)\*. Montgomery College (MC) provides an MC e\-mail account and access to the learning platform, password\-protected faculty sections of the website, college listservs, and other faculty communications tools. \**If you do not have access to a personal computer, please notify the department chair at the time of the interview. Subject to available funds, the college may be able to provide temporary access to resources.* * Must be eligible to work in the United States without a sponsor. **Preferred** **Qualifications:** * AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, or another relevant AWS certification. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q, AWS Lambda, and related AWS AI services. * Experience teaching or training adult learners in higher education, workforce development, professional development, or corporate training. * A bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, information technology, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related field. * Experience delivering instruction in hybrid, in\-person, and online modalities. * Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (e.g., Blackboard). For degrees earned outside of the U.S., a copy of your education equivalency, conducted by a nationally recognized evaluation service, must be included in your application. Employees must live in Maryland or a state where the College has payroll reciprocity (DC, VA, PA, WV, DE, MA). As a condition of employment, the following are required at the time of hire: * Successful completion of a background check and degree verification (if applicable). *If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact Human Resources and Strategic Talent Management at 240\-567\-5353 or* *HRSTM@montgomerycollege.edu**. We require at least two weeks advance notice to enable us to provide the requested accommodation.* *Montgomery College is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting and fostering diversity among its student body, faculty, and staff.* *Montgomery College is a tobacco\-free and smoke\-free workplace.* **Closing Date** ---------------- Thursday, December 24, 2026

jobs.title: Associate, Data & Technology
jobs.description: **Company Profile:** Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment, and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide, including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries. In Technology, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. **What you’ll do in the role:** Morgan Stanley Services Group Inc. is seeking an Associate, Data \& Technology in Seattle, Washington. to build, deploy, and support trade software systems, analytical tools, and scalable trading engine infrastructure. Partner with trading, sales, operations, and senior management to understand key system issues in the trade lifecycle and propose technical solutions. Gather and analyze large sets of data through various systems and implement complex mathematical calculations. Utilize statistical and machine learning tools to analyze market data and identify trading and operational efficiency opportunities. Propose changes in trading systems based on data analysis and simulation results. Utilize quantitative skills, programming skills, and experience implementing mathematical models in SQL, Java, bash, and Python. Telecommuting permitted up to 2 days per week. **What you’ll bring to the role:** Requires a Master’s in Technical Entrepreneurship \& Management, or a related field of study. Requires two (2\) years of experience in the position offered or two (2\) years as an Associate, Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or a related occupation. Requires two (2\) years of experience with the following skills: * Writing and interpreting queries using SQL and Python; * Supporting a 24x7 technical production environment using robust incident response protocols for financial data integrity and compliance; * Implementing DevOps practices and tools, including Octopus, JIRA, and Confluence; * Developing scripts, automation, and continuous improvement solutions using bash, Terraform, GitHub and Docker; * Orchestrating and managing data pipelines leveraging Apache NiFi and Apache Airflow; * Working with cloud platforms and services, including Snowflake and AWS with S3, IAM, Athena, SNS, and EC2; * Administering and supporting Linux and UNIX based operating systems; * Ensuring security and access controls for sensitive financial information across distributed environments; * Conducting regular audits and maintaining documentation to meet financial regulatory standards. **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:** At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser. Salary range for the position: $115,000 \- $140,000 /Yr. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive compensation award. The successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the relevant business unit’s incentive compensation plan, which also may include a discretionary bonus component. Morgan Stanley offers a full spectrum of benefits, including Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Day Care Savings Account, Life Insurance, Disability and Other Insurance Plans, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave consistent with state and local law, Parental Leave and 20 Vacation Days annually), 10 Paid Holidays, 401(k), and Short/Long Term Disability, in addition to other special perks reserved for our employees. Please visit mybenefits.morganstanley.com to learn more about our benefit offerings. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. For more information, please visit : https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

jobs.title: Systems Analyst / Programmer
jobs.description: Purpose, Scope \& Dimension of Job: The role of the Application Systems Analyst is to design, develop, secure, administer and support college\-wide computer application systems as needed within the Information Technology Services department and the College. Primary responsibilities of the position include business application support, systems analysis and design and programming. The analyst performs application development, maintenance, administration of security, information reporting, customer analysis and other duties related to program analysis and development. The Systems Analyst needs to be able to meet with customers on their project needs and have the ability to translate and apply those needs to information technology systems. This position will work with a variety of software and maintain them to produce a reliable, accurate, and dependable information system for all functions of day\-to\-day operations. This position functions to support the College’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and various other enterprise software applications, including their administration, configuration, troubleshooting, documentation, and training, along with various integrations with external systems. Supervisory Responsibility: This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities, but will often act as a group leader in order to oversee, steer, and expedite the completion of a project. Minimum Requirements * Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Business Information Systems or related, or four or more years of professional work experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including interconnectivity with external systems in lieu of degree. * Demonstrated interest in professional development and learning new skills, program languages and processes. * Demonstrated history of adaptation to new technology. * Excellent written and verbal communications skills. Strong communication and people skills and the ability to work with users at all levels, with an emphasis on customer service. * Experience working independently or without significant direction on a daily basis. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain highly productive. * Ability to design, configure, and maintain systems that adhere to industry standards, prioritizing SaaS\-native configurations, workflow automation, and sustainable lifecycle management. * Technical Toolkit \& Environment: The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong foundation in systems administration, with an aptitude or interest in expanding their skills into the following technical areas: + Software Development: C\# / .Net Framework / .Net Core, Envision (Colleague Studio), Visual Studio. + Data, API \& Integration: SQL, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), REST/SOAP/WSDL APIs, Electronic File Transfer (SFTP, S3, SSH). + Scripting \& Automation: PowerShell, Batch, Shell, Javascript. + DevOps \& Infrastructure: Version Control (Git, GitHub), Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS). + Project Methodologies: Agile/Scrum. + Artificial Intelligence (AI) \& Automation: - AI Literacy: Ability to leverage Generative AI (LLMs) to enhance productivity, streamline code generation, automate documentation, and improve communication. - Responsible AI Governance: Understanding of data privacy and compliance standards (e.g., FERPA, HIPAA) when utilizing AI models; ability to implement and monitor safeguards against data leakage. - AI Integration: Interest in exploring how AI\-driven features, APIs, and agents can be integrated into enterprise workflows to improve operational efficiency. Additional Desirable Qualifications * Academic Experience: Prior experience working in a Higher Education IT environment. * ERP \& SaaS Depth: Experience with full\-lifecycle ERP administration, including cloud migrations or complex vendor\-managed system implementations. * Advanced Cloud Proficiency: Experience with cloud\-native architectures (Azure/AWS) beyond basic usage, such as managing cloud identity, resource governance, or serverless functions. * Strategic Analysis: Demonstrated ability to translate complex business problems into technical roadmaps that align with organizational goals. Physical Requirements/Working Conditions The employee must be able to work at a desk for long periods of time and operate a computer workstation and telephone. Due to the heavy customer service aspect of this position, it is necessary to communicate effectively both in person and over the telephone with a large variety of people each day. The employee, on occasion, must be able to lift and carry, at the minimum, a 10 pound item. Work Schedule 52 Weeks, 40\-hours per week, Monday through Friday. May be required to work a variable schedule/varying hours to meet operational needs. Work hours will be determined by the Associate Vice President – Information Technology (AVP\-ITS). Additional Information * First consideration given to internal candidates. * Degree must be conferred by either offer date or close of posting. * Visa sponsorship is not available. * The College is unable to assist with travel and/or relocation expenses. * Selected candidates must submit to a drug test and criminal background check. * The College reserves the right to cancel the search at any time. Application Deadline Internal Deadline to apply 9/24/26 Additional Application Deadline Information The College reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a sufficient applicant pool has been identified. jobs.description: **About MyRacePass** MyRacePass (MRP) is a motorsports startup focused on grassroots racing. We provide countless solutions to help Promoters, Drivers, Fans, and Businesses engage and succeed in motorsports. Between providing an online ticketing platform, to sending real time data to thousands of fans, MyRacePass has race night covered. **MyRacePass Engineering** We are a small team focused on solving our customer needs in a secure, scalable and reliable fashion. jobs.title: Field Service Technician II
jobs.description: **Title:** Field Service Technician II. **Location:** Roanoke, VA. **Intro for the business:** At NCR Atleos, our Field Services organization is on the front line of keeping commerce running for some of the world’s largest retailers and financial institutions. Our technicians are trusted partners to our customers, delivering reliable, high\-quality service that keeps essential self\-service technology operating around the clock. We are looking for Field Service Technicians who are technically curious, mechanically inclined, and customer focused. Whether you already have field service experience or bring transferable technical skills, NCR Atleos provides the training, tools, and support needed to build a long\-term career in a high\-impact, customer\-facing role. **Position Summary:** Are you a Field Technician, Field Engineer, or Service Technician—or interested in starting a career in this field? Are you tech savvy with strong mechanical aptitude and transferrable skills? Do you want to work with some of the largest retailers and banks in the industry? If so, NCR Atleos is interested in speaking with you! NCR Atleos’s Field Services Team creates value for our customers by delivering solutions that build long term relationships. Acting as a first line response to our customers, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with the focus being finding the right solution. You will organize, triage customer issues, and even handle some problems before they start. No matter the situation, your formal training (provided through NCR Atleos) will allow you to provide customers what they need when they need it. Our virtual and hands on classroom training enables fast learning and fosters an environment where you can stretch yourself and make an impact. NCR Atleos is committed to growing the capabilities of our people. We are building a learning community where you can work with diverse individuals, explore new ways of thinking, and expand your capabilities. Our service operations have dedicated teachers, mentors and coaches who work across territories to share their knowledge to enhance each other’s growth. NCR Atleos is dedicated to building a diverse community, one where employees feel a sense of belonging and teamwork, are valued for their contributions and the perspectives they bring. This role truly keeps commerce running across the globe and is an ambassador for the NCR Atleos Brand. **Salary Range:** $45,000\.00 – $58,000\.00\. The posted salary range represents the full pay range for this role across North America. Starting compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience, (geographic) location, and business needs. **Key Areas of Responsibility:*** Perform customer installations, maintenance, and service calls promptly and effectively. * Service and repair electromechanical equipment, including ATMs and self\-checkout systems, within an assigned territory. * Perform scheduled maintenance, corrective repairs, and system overhauls. * Diagnose and resolve issues involving hardware, software, networking, and system configurations. * Manage network faults, system access, security settings, and remote connectivity. * Organize and triage customer issues, addressing problems proactively when possible. * Communicate with customers in an open, helpful, and professional manner focused on resolution. * Participate in virtual and hands\-on training programs provided by NCR Atleos. * Comply with NCR Atleos policies, including Shared Values, Code of Conduct, health and safety standards, accurate timekeeping, and fleet and safe driving requirements. * Perform other related duties consistent with qualifications and business needs. * May be reassigned to adjacent service territories during standard shifts to meet operational needs; managers will strive to communicate in advance whenever possible to minimize schedule disruptions. * May elect to participate in overnight travel assignments to support broader service coverage; all travel follows established company policy and reimbursement guidelines. **Basic Qualifications:*** One (1\) or more years of related experience. * Local candidate to the specific geographic area. * Authorized to work in the United States. * At least 19 years of age. * Valid drivers license and driving record that meets NCR Atleos fleet requirements. * PC skills, basic electronic skills, and operating system familiarity. * Ability to perform essential job functions without reasonable accommodation, including: + Prolonged travel with several hours of driving per day. + Rotating and weekend shifts. + Carrying and lifting tools, parts, and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. without assistance. + Bending, squatting, walking, standing, sitting, reaching, and repetitive hand movements manipulating objects of various sizes. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Familiarity with large servers, mainframe computers, and imaging software. * A\+ Certification, CompTIA, or Network\+ (N\+) Certification.

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer, NVLink Fusion
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to develop low\-level software for NVIDIA NVLink Fusion, a high\-bandwidth, low\-latency interconnect platform for next\-generation accelerated computing systems. You will design and implement kernel\-mode drivers and embedded firmware, working across the product lifecycle—from architecture and pre\-silicon development through silicon bring\-up, productization, production, and partner deployment. You will collaborate closely with GPU and system architects, ASIC designers, firmware and driver teams, validation engineers, and external technology partners to deliver reliable, high\-performance interconnect solutions. **What you'll be doing:** * Design, implement, and maintain next\-generation NVLink Fusion features across one or more low\-level software layers, including kernel\-mode drivers and embedded firmware or microcode. * Drive features across the product lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design, implementation, pre\-silicon verification, silicon bring\-up, validation, productization, and production support. * Develop unit, integration, and system\-level tests, diagnostics, and automation across pre\-silicon and post\-silicon environments. * Debug complex hardware, firmware, kernel, and system\-level issues across the hardware/software boundary. * Collaborate with internal engineering teams and external technology partners to integrate, validate, and debug NVLink Fusion platforms. * Develop low\-level production software primarily in C and C\+\+ * Lead and participate in design and code reviews, build technical consensus across teams, and improve software quality, maintainability, and release readiness. **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience) * 5\+ years of relevant software, firmware, or systems development experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise designing, implementing, and debugging low\-level software. * Strong programming skills in C and/or C\+\+, along with proficiency in Python or a comparable scripting language. * Experience in one or more of the following areas: operating\-system kernels, device drivers, embedded firmware, microcode, high\-speed interconnects, networking, or low\-level system software. * Strong understanding of computer architecture and hardware/software interaction, including memory\-mapped I/O, interrupts, DMA, concurrency, memory ordering, and device I/O. * Experience debugging complex systems using logs, traces, debuggers, hardware diagnostics, simulation, or emulation. * Experience with software engineering practices including technical design, peer review, testing, release management, and production maintenance. * Experience collaborating with hardware development teams during pre\-silicon development, silicon bring\-up, or platform validation. * Strong communication, collaboration, and analytical problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently and in a team environment. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience using Rust for systems, kernel, firmware, or embedded software development. * Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, embedded RTOS environments, or microcontroller firmware, including performance, security, or reliability considerations. * Familiarity with NVLink, PCIe, CXL, InfiniBand, Ethernet, cache\-coherent interconnects, or other high\-speed I/O technologies. * Experience with pre\-silicon simulation, emulation, FPGA prototyping, silicon bring\-up, or cross\-company platform integration. * Experience applying AI\-assisted or agentic tools to software development, verification, debugging, or root\-cause analysis, with sound judgment around validation, security, and appropriate use. tools. * Experience with data management, specifically validating and auditing data and reports from multiple systems. * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud jobs.title: Lead Integrations Engineer
jobs.description: About OneApp: At OneApp, we are building technology to expand access to housing. Our platform helps renters find and secure housing while enabling property owners to make better, lower\-risk decisions. We are a mission\-driven team focused on ownership, clarity, and execution. Our culture is built around four core values: Humbly Confident, Tenacious, Hungry, and Compassionate. Job Overview: As Lead Engineer on our Integrations team, you will own the technical direction for how OneApp connects with external property management platforms and delivers data across our ecosystem. You will set the integration patterns the team builds against, lead a small team of engineers, and work alongside a specialist AI engineer on automation and data collection workflows. This is a hands\-on technical lead role. You write code, you review code, and you are accountable for what the pod ships. Your primary focus will be integration architecture and delivery. The secondary focus is data pipeline design, external API surface, and team technical leadership. This role is a hybrid schedule, with some in\-office time at our Portland, OR location. Key Responsibilities: Integration Architecture \& Delivery * Design and implement the integration patterns that connect OneApp with third\-party property management systems — establishing reusable architecture so each new integration builds on proven foundations rather than starting from scratch * Own the full integration lifecycle — API access, data ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream systems — with a focus on reliability, data quality, and maintainability * Build and maintain the external\-facing Partner Data API — including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and the developer experience for partners consuming it * Treat data quality as an engineering discipline — data that enters incorrectly causes downstream problems; you design the layer to catch and handle issues at the source * Ensure integrations are observable by default — logging, alerting, and monitoring are part of implementation, not an afterthought Agentic AI — Technical Fluency Required * You will work alongside a specialist AI engineer who drives the agentic AI implementation. You need to be technically fluent enough to provide architectural direction, make good decisions about where automation belongs in the integration stack, and hold the engineering standard — even if you are not writing the agent code day to day. * Understand agentic AI architectures well enough to make sound decisions about where agents belong and where they do not * Provide technical oversight of AI\-powered workflows — automated data collection, enrichment pipelines, and intelligent data retrieval * Evaluate AI frameworks and tooling in the context of production reliability and observability, not just capability * Hold the engineering standard: AI\-powered workflows should be observable, testable, and as reliable as any other production system Technical Team Leadership * Set and enforce technical standards for the pod — code quality, API design, data contracts, and integration patterns * Lead architecture discussions and represent the integration team's perspective in cross\-team technical conversations * Create an environment where the engineers around you can do their best work — clear direction, substantive code reviews, and space for ownership * Unblock the team proactively — if a third\-party API is unclear or a dependency is missing, you chase it down * Document integration patterns and architectural decisions so the team's knowledge is shared and durable Qualifications: Experience: * 5\+ years of software engineering experience in production environments, with at least some experience leading technical work or mentoring engineers * Strong, hands\-on proficiency in TypeScript * Experience building and maintaining production integrations with third\-party APIs — authentication, pagination, rate limiting, error handling, and the operational reality of external dependencies * Experience designing data pipelines and transformation layers — you know what it means to move data reliably from an external source through your system to a consumer * Solid understanding of RESTful API design, both building and consuming APIs in production * Solid MySQL fundamentals — schema design, query performance, and data integrity * AWS experience — EC2, RDS, S3, and API Gateway * Familiarity with AI or agentic AI frameworks — you do not need to be an AI engineer, but you need to evaluate what is being built, make architectural decisions, and hold the standard Preferred:* Experience with property management system integrations * Experience with LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or equivalent AI orchestration and observability tooling * Background in proptech, fintech, or a domain where data integrity and partner trust are business\-critical * Experience with event\-driven architectures or message queuing Working Style: * Pattern\-oriented: you see the repeating shape in a problem and build the solution that scales, not the one\-off that closes the ticket * Ownership\-minded: when something in the integration layer breaks, you move fast to fix it and to prevent it from happening again * Technically fluent across disciplines: you can work alongside an AI specialist, a DevOps engineer, and backend developers without anyone needing to slow down for you * Clear communicator: integration work touches multiple teams and partners; you communicate what you are building, what you need, and what is blocked proactively * Raises the team’s floor: the engineers around you are better because of your code reviews, your standards, and the way you approach problems Compensation \& Benefits: * This is a full\-time position * International and domestic travel is required * Salary: $140,000\-$160,000 * Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO

As pricing becomes an increasingly important part of business decision making, the organization requires stronger analytical capabilities to improve visibility, support prioritization, and enable more consistent execution across regions and business lines. The Senior Manager, Global Pricing Analytics, will work closely with commercial, finance, pricing, and technology teams to build analytical capabilities, establish meaningful performance insights, and support data\-driven decision making. pricing, commercial, and technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable pricing capabilities and operational execution. **Commercial Insights \& Opportunity Management** * Convert expansion actions. * Develop opportunity pipelines that help regions focus resources on the highest\-value pricing actions. * Enable commercial teams to make faster and more informed pricing decisions. **Commercial Enablement \& Adoption** * Partner with Pricing, DT, Finance, and commercial teams to enhance pricing capabilities, workflows, and business decision support * Equip regional pricing teams with dashboards, opportunity reports, segmentation tools, and analytical recommendations. * Establish the analytical foundation supporting future pricing decision\-support capabilities. jobs.title: Tech Lead, Customer Support
jobs.description: Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non\-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity\-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least\-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T\-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S\&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026\. In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1\.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R\&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third\-party applications. With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long\-term growth and IPO readiness. **Team:** Global Services \& Delivery **Location:** \[Remote / Hybrid \- NYC, NY/Dallas, TX/Philadelphia, PA **About the Role:** Obsidian Security protects organizations against threats across their SaaS and identity environments. We're looking for a hands\-on technical leader to run customer support and lead a team of five support engineers. You will be Obsidian's technical lead for complex customer support issues: helping engineers investigate difficult cases, taking ownership of critical escalations, and working with Product and Engineering to drive them to resolution. You will also manage the team day\-to\-day, coaching engineers, setting priorities, maintaining coverage, and building a consistently strong customer experience. As we introduce automation and agentic AI into support, you will help the team adopt new ways of working and use what you learn from customer issues to improve those systems. This role is suited to someone who enjoys both solving hard technical problems and developing the people who solve them. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Lead, coach, and develop a team of five support engineers, including performance management, career growth, and hiring as the team evolves. * Own the support team's daily operation: case prioritization, workload, coverage, escalation paths, quality standards, and customer communication. * Serve as the technical lead for complex and high\-priority escalations. Investigate issues alongside the team, form clear technical assessments, and coordinate resolution with Product and Engineering. * Build deep expertise in Obsidian's platform and the SaaS, identity, API, and security environments our customers rely on. * Raise the team's technical capability through case reviews, troubleshooting guidance, documentation, and coaching. * Represent support in critical customer situations, providing clear updates, setting expectations, and maintaining ownership through resolution. * Identify recurring issues and work with Product and Engineering on product fixes, better diagnostics, and improvements to the support experience. * Partner with the team building our agentic AI systems to introduce new capabilities into support, train engineers, and provide feedback from real customer cases. * Track support quality, resolution time, SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and the impact of automation; use those measures to improve how the team operates. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Significant hands\-on experience supporting a complex B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, or infrastructure product. * Strong technical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate ambiguous issues, work across APIs and integrations, interpret logs and product behavior, and engage Engineering effectively. * Experience leading a small technical team, either as a people manager or as a technical lead with meaningful coaching and operational responsibility. * Sound judgment during customer escalations, with the ability to balance technical investigation, urgency, and clear communication. * A track record of developing engineers and improving team practices while staying close to the technical work. * Comfort using support metrics to identify problems and improve quality and efficiency. * Interest in applying automation and AI to support workflows, with a practical understanding of where human judgment remains essential. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with SaaS security, identity, OAuth, SAML, or enterprise application integrations. * Experience leading support for security incidents or other time\-sensitive customer issues. * Experience introducing automation, AI, or self\-service capabilities into a support team. **Employee Benefits:** Our competitive benefits packages are designed to support our employees' well\-being, both at work and at home. Our US based employees enjoy: * Competitive compensation with equity and 401k * Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage * Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off * 12 weeks of new parent or family leave * Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here.

software. **What you’ll be doing** * Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering Directors, and Principal Architects to translate strategic business objectives into technical roadmaps. * engineering bar across the entire pillar. * Raise the technical bar through rigorous code standards, comprehensive automated testing, and modernized CI/CD pipelines, while championing engineering best practices and architectural standards. * Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation and foster a culture of knowledge sharing within the team and the broader organization. * Work within an environment that leverages AI\-native engineering practices, utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery. * Spearhead technical innovation, identifying emerging industry trends (such as advanced device security or AI\-native development paradigms) and prototyping solutions to keep Okta ahead of the curve. **Minimum Requirements** * 7\+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and building macOS (or iOS) features using Swift. * Deep expertise with macOS (or iOS) software environments, including design and performance optimization, security considerations. * Proven expertise in advanced debugging and performance optimization using Xcode, LLDB, and Instruments to resolve complex memory issues and concurrency bugs. * Experience in fast\-paced agile environments, with a strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence technical direction. * Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle. * Cross\-Platform context with strong conceptual understanding of macOS (or iOS) security features. **Nice\-to\-haves** * Security Domain Expertise such as Cryptography, endpoint security concepts (e.g., Secure Enclave, Device Management/MDM protocols, and endpoint detection). * Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (e.g., FIDO, OIDC/OAuth, or similar modern authentication frameworks). * Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security\+. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. \#7211\_3564654 The annual base salary range for this position for candidates located in the San Francisco Bay area is between: $194,000—$267,000 USD Below is the annual base To learn more about our Total Rewards program please visit: https://rewards.okta.com/us. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 7,000 pre\-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business.
