jobs.description: NSB Omega is searching a Mechanical Engineer \- **Static Equipment** for our Client in Quintana, TX. **Assignment Description** **Valid/Current TWIC Required** Position Summary We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer with 3\-10 years of experience to support the reliability, mechanical integrity, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of static equipment assets. This role will focus on pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks, piping systems, air\-cooled heat exchangers, and related fixed equipment, with additional responsibility for supporting pipe stress, piping vibration, and fitness\-for\-service evaluations. The ideal candidate is hands\-on, technically curious, safety\-focused, and comfortable working closely with Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, Reliability, Projects, and external vendors to solve equipment issues and improve asset performance. Primary Responsibilities \- Provide day\-to\-day engineering support for static equipment, including pressure vessels, tanks, shell\-and\-tube heat exchangers, air\-cooled heat exchangers, piping systems, and associated components. \- Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action development for equipment damage, leaks, corrosion, vibration concerns, fatigue issues, thermal movement concerns, and mechanical integrity findings. \- Review inspection reports, equipment condition data, repair recommendations, and non\-destructive examination results to support technically sound repair, replacement, monitoring, or continued\-service decisions. \- Assist with pipe stress, thermal growth, support adequacy, flexibility, and vibration evaluations, including coordination with specialists or external engineering firms when detailed analysis is required. \- Support air\-cooled heat exchanger reliability, including tube condition assessments, plugging/replacement decisions, corrosion monitoring, inspection scope development, fan deck and header issues, and mechanical repair planning. \- Develop and review engineering scopes, repair plans, technical recommendations, Management of Change documentation, and project intake information for static equipment and piping\-related work. \- Participate in field walkdowns, equipment inspections, pre\-startup safety reviews, turnaround planning, discovery work evaluation, and maintenance execution support. \- Apply applicable codes, standards, and recommended practices, including ASME, API, TEMA, and site mechanical integrity procedures, to support safe and reliable equipment operation. \- Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, Reliability, Process Engineering, Projects, contractors, and vendors to resolve equipment issues and drive practical, risk\-informed solutions. \- Support development and improvement of mechanical integrity programs, inspection strategies, equipment records, repair deferral processes, and asset reliability initiatives. Preferred Qualifications \- Experience supporting LNG, cryogenic, petrochemical, or other process plant equipment. \- Exposure to pipe stress analysis, vibration troubleshooting, flexibility analysis, or use of piping analysis tools such as CAESAR II. \- Experience with air\-cooled heat exchanger inspection, tube failure analysis, plugging plans, IRIS/eddy current inspection methods, header repairs, or fan\-related reliability issues. \- Knowledge of damage mechanisms, corrosion under insulation, risk\-based inspection, fitness\-for\-service, remaining life assessments, and mechanical repair planning. \- Familiarity with engineering software or systems such as COMPRESS, PV Elite, HTRI, SAP, APM/Meridium, or similar tools. \- Engineer\-in\-Training certification, Professional Engineer license, API certification, or interest in pursuing relevant technical certifications. Key Competencies \- Practical field engineering judgment and willingness to engage directly with equipment in operating units. \- Strong ownership, organization, and follow\-through on technical actions and equipment issues. \- Ability to balance code compliance, risk, reliability, schedule, and business needs. \- Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document technical recommendations for both engineering and non\-engineering audiences. \- Collaborative mindset with the ability to build trust with Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, and contractor teams. \- Curiosity, continuous learning, and interest in developing deeper expertise in static equipment and mechanical integrity. Work Environment This position will include a combination of office\-based engineering work and field support in an operating facility. The engineer may support routine operations, planned outages, turnarounds, emergent equipment issues, field walkdowns, inspections, and vendor or contractor coordination. Occasional extended hours may be required during turnarounds, startup activities, or high\-priority equipment events. **Qualifications Required** * 3\-10 years of mechanical engineering experience in an industrial, petrochemical, refining, LNG, chemical, power, or similar operating environment. * Working knowledge of static equipment, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, air\-cooled heat exchangers, tanks, piping systems, and mechanical integrity fundamentals. * Familiarity with applicable codes and standards such as ASME Section VIII, ASME B31\.3, API 510, API 570, API 579, API 653, API 660, API 661, and TEMA. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, equipment drawings, inspection reports, isometrics, vendor data books, specifications, and repair documentation. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical risks, communicate recommendations clearly, and support timely field decisions. * Effective communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, operations, maintenance, inspection, and contractor teams. * Commitment to safe work practices, mechanical integrity, regulatory compliance, and reliable plant operation. * Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. **Duration** 1 Year(With Possibility of Extension) **Location** Quintana, TX

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description: **Purpose in Every Position** Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere. **Where Your Work Moves the Needle.** At Pebl, every team member drives our success. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work. **What Makes You a Great Fit** We are seeking a highly technical, deeply analytical, and aggressively innovative Director of Data to lead our data strategy, infrastructure, and AI integration. You will not just be managing a team; you will be the chief storyteller for our data and the evangelist for our "AI Everywhere" initiative. Based out of our Palo Alto office, you will sit at the intersection of R\&D and our core business functions—specifically Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal—ensuring that Pebl’s vast repository of global employment and compliance data is secure, accessible, and actionable. ***In\-office collaboration is required at our Palo Alto office Monday through Wednesday.*** **How You'll Make An Impact:** **1\. Architect the Future (Technical \& Hands\-On Data Engineering)** * Own the vision and execution of Pebl’s modern data infrastructure. * Serve as the ultimate technical authority on data engineering, ensuring highly scalable, performant, and reliable data pipelines. * Champion strict data security, privacy, and governance protocols to protect our global payroll, HR, and compliance data. **2\. Drive Actionable Business Insights (Analytical Powerhouse)** * Transform complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies across all departments. * Partner with Marketing and Sales to optimize our growth funnel, CAC, and conversion rates. * Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Legal to improve billing accuracy, payroll speed, and compliance tracking. **3\. Champion "AI Everywhere" (AI Native Operations)** * Lead the charge to make Pebl a truly AI\-native company. * Bring AI capabilities to our R\&D offerings, such as enhancing our compliance assistant, Alfie. * Engage directly with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to embed AI into their daily workflows, driving massive internal efficiency. **4\. Bridge the Gap (Communication \& Storytelling)** * Act as the ultimate translator between deep technical R\&D work and overarching business objectives. * Master the art of data storytelling to present complex insights to the executive team and the board in a compelling way. **5\. Build and Foster the Team (Leadership)** * **Lead the Charge:** Be a hands\-on, execution\-oriented leader who ensures delivery of strong business results. * **Be the NBA Coach:** Recruit top\-tier talent and assemble a high\-performing team of data engineers, analysts, and AI specialists. * **Be the Gardener:** Foster a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety to cultivate a data\-driven mindset across the entire company. **Let's Connect If You Have:** * **Extensive Technical Background:** 15\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science, or analytics, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. * **Modern Stack Mastery:** Deep, hands\-on expertise orchestrating our specific modern data infrastructure stack: **Snowflake, Fivetran, Atlan, Looker, and Monte Carlo**. * **AI/ML Track Record:** Proven experience deploying LLMs, machine learning models, and AI tools for both production products and internal operational workflows. * **Cross\-Functional Business Acumen:** Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to tie data initiatives directly to top\-line growth and bottom\-line efficiency. * **Exceptional Communication:** A track record of weaving data into compelling business narratives for non\-technical stakeholders. * **Work Style:** Ability to work from our Palo Alto office Monday through Wednesday to collaborate directly with the executive and R\&D teams. **Our Commitment to You** At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include: * **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge. * **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families. * **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones. * **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success. Please visit our career page for more information. **Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world. Compensation Range: $229,775 \- $344,663

rapid product launches and market expansion. * Develop event\-driven, asynchronous services using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka and Pulsar. * Improve system scalability, performance, reliability, and observability as platform usage grows globally. * Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, mentorship, and shared engineering standards. **What You jobs.title: Forward Engineer
jobs.description: **About Pentice** ================= Pentice is the operating system behind Cloud9 Windy City: 63 units across 13 Class\-A residential buildings in Chicago, turning long\-term luxury apartments into hotel\-grade short stays and unlocking top\-line revenue for the buildings' owners. We are building toward the autonomous operating system for luxury high\-rises, and expanding city by city across the U.S. **How we work** =============== A small, AI\-native team that builds 4:1 leverage. You work alongside Claude every day; AI is a co\-pilot, not a buzzword. The team is distributed — some in Chicago, most in Latin America. We move fast, decide fast, and cut politics. We don't hire to fill seats. We hire to pull levers that move numbers. Outcomes beat effort beats intentions. **How we pay** ============== Every role we post carries its compensation in figures, in the currency you would be paid in. Base is one part. The rest is a quarterly bonus tied to the one number your seat owns. If you move the number you are paid for it, and if the number does not move the bonus does not pay. You get both halves before you apply. **We run on C.L.O.U.D.9, our culture operating system** ======================================================= * **C · Customer Obsession.** If they're not raving, we missed it. * **L · Leadership Through Ownership.** No passengers, only drivers. * **O · Operational Excellence.** How we do one thing is how we do everything. * **U · Urgency With Intelligence.** Act now, iterate later. * **D · Do the Right Thing.** Character over convenience. * **9 · The 9x Mindset.** 10% better is safe; 9x better is unforgettable. Three of those decide who lasts here, so read them as warnings rather than slogans. **Leadership Through Ownership.** You will be handed a number and very little scaffolding. Nobody will sequence your week for you. If you need a manager to tell you what matters this Tuesday, you will be unhappy here inside a month. **Urgency With Intelligence.** We ship, measure, then fix. A good decision today beats a perfect one in three weeks. If you need complete information before you move, this pace will feel reckless to you. **Do the Right Thing.** You will get chances to report a number that flatters you. We check. Someone who softens a bad result once does not get a second chance to. **Forward Engineer** ==================== **The Role** ------------ The Forward Engineer bridges the gap between business challenges and code. You’ll take on ambiguous problems with incomplete information, discern what truly matters, make reasonable assumptions, build solutions using AI, integrate with real systems (Guesty, Stripe, internal APIs), deploy them, and verify the outcomes. The primary indicator of success is how effectively you convert ambiguity into measurable, working results—not lines of code. **What You’ll Own** ------------------- * The automation workflows that meet operations: guest journey steps, message drafting and review flows, pricing and reporting signals, and current engines that run as separate tools. * The agent systems behind those workflows: prompts, tool usage, structured output, evaluation, observability, and cost management. * The necessary integrations, end to end: webhooks in, actions out, idempotent design, reconciliation, and observability. * The first production version of solutions and their measurement: what changed, by how much, and how results are proven. **What Ownership Means Here** ----------------------------- * You get a problem and an outcome, not a ticket. You write the specification, choose what not to build, deploy after one review, and operate your shipped work. * If the requirements are off, you raise it and propose what’s correct. **How We Build** ---------------- * Stack: Node, TypeScript, React. * One repository, three environments, staged/gated deploys with receipts. * AI tools in daily engineering, full engineer responsibility for all shipped code. * Written and concise engineering standards. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Two or more concrete examples of: problem decision shipped solution measured impact (with numbers). * Hands\-on: you build and ship solutions yourself and have operated your own work. * Experience with integrations: external APIs, webhooks, understanding idempotency and reconciliation. * AI as an engineering tool: agents, structured output, evaluation, and a habit of catching incorrect AI output. * Clear written English: can communicate complex ideas to both CEOs and engineers. ### **Especially Relevant (Bonus)** * Background in hospitality or property operations * LLM observability and evaluation * Event\-driven architectures * Experience as a founder or solutions engineer **Level \& Scope** ------------------ * Mid to Senior level * Reports to the founding engineer * Works daily with the CEO on key workflows **Compensation** ---------------- * **Base: $60,000–$96,000 USD/year** (mid\-level: $60,000–$78,000; senior: $78,000–$96,000\) * In\-band moves based on production integrations, AI evaluation, business\-facing experience * Quarterly performance reviews post\-trial * Equity after 9–12 months * 15 PTO days \+ U.S. holidays * Fully remote, quarterly team gatherings * Colombia contracting available **Your First 90 Days (Sample Project)** --------------------------------------- * Own the end\-to\-end pre\-arrival flow: from building house rules to guest check\-in (with quiz and follow\-up messages), measured by reduction in parking/check\-in inquiries to the front desk. * You author the specification, ship the solution behind one review, and bring measurable results. **Interview Process** --------------------- * **Screening:** Discussion of one ambiguous business problem you owned, start to finish (20 min \+ short technical touch). * **Forward Engineering Challenge:** Build with AI, then defend and adapt live (4h take\-home, 90 min live). * **System Design with AI:** Business scenario with added constraints (60–90 min). * **CEO Conversation.** *No Loom, no read. Top candidates hear back in 48 hours. Final round is a paid deployment trial with our CEO.* **Why Pentice** =============== If you want to own a number, move fast, and build with AI instead of around it, this is the place. Small team, real leverage, high standards, and the people who build the systems get to run them as we scale city by city. If you want a comfortable seat where effort counts more than outcomes, we are not it. **Equal opportunity** ===================== Pentice and its operating entities do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Compensation Range: $60K \- $96K

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** We are building automated asset identification and serialization into our equipment — vision systems that read, decode, and verify identifiers on media and drives as they move through the destruction process, and that produce the auditable records our clients rely on for chain\-of\-custody compliance. This role owns that capability. You will develop and productionize computer vision and machine learning pipelines for label and barcode recognition, integrate them with machine controls and back\-office systems, and serve as the internal technical owner for external engineering vendors contributing to these programs. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You will write production code, and you will also be the person who defines scope for outside contractors, reviews what they deliver, and decides whether it is good enough to ship. **Key Responsibilities** **Computer Vision \& Machine Learning** * Develop, train, and deploy object detection and recognition models for barcode, 2D code, and text identification on industrial asset labels. * Implement rotation\-tolerant detection using oriented bounding box or equivalent approaches; labels arrive at arbitrary orientations, skew, and standoff distances, and the pipeline must handle it without operator intervention. * Solve identifier disambiguation: asset labels routinely carry multiple codes — part numbers, model codes, lot codes, vendor identifiers — with no universal marking standard. Build the detection, classification, and confidence\-scoring logic that determines which code is the correct serial identifier, and define the fallback path when confidence is insufficient. * Integrate OCR for identifiers that are printed as human\-readable text with no machine\-readable code present. * Build and maintain the data pipeline behind the models: capture, annotation standards, augmentation, synthetic data generation, versioned datasets, and reproducible training runs. * Define and track model evaluation criteria — precision, recall, mAP, per\-class failure analysis — and drive measurable improvement release over release. **Embedded \& Systems Integration** * Deploy inference to edge compute on production equipment; optimize for latency and throughput within the constraints of the hardware (quantization, ONNX/TensorRT, batching). * Specify and integrate machine vision hardware: industrial cameras, optics, lighting, triggering, and mounting geometry. * Interface vision output with machine control systems (PLC/HMI, serial, Modbus, Ethernet/IP) to gate machine behavior on identification results. * Design and build RESTful APIs and services that move serialization data from the machine into back\-office and ERP systems, producing the records that support certificates of destruction and audit trails. * Own reliability in the field: logging, telemetry, error handling, remote diagnostics, and update mechanisms for deployed systems. **Vendor \& Program Ownership** * Serve as internal technical owner for external engineering vendors and offshore contractors working on vision, firmware, and robotics programs. * Write technical scopes of work, define acceptance criteria and milestone gates, and evaluate deliverables against them. * Review vendor code and architecture; identify where outsourced work is accruing technical debt and correct course. * Run technical cadence with distributed vendor teams across time zones and maintain the internal documentation that keeps knowledge in\-house. * Support adjacent automation programs, including vision\-guided robotic material handling. **Required Qualifications** * 4\+ years developing production software in embedded, machine vision, or applied ML roles. * Strong Python; working proficiency in C or C\+\+. * Practical computer vision experience with OpenCV and modern detection architectures (YOLO family or equivalent), including training and fine\-tuning your own models rather than only consuming pre\-trained ones. * Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, including dataset construction, training, evaluation, and deployment. * Barcode and 2D code decoding experience (Code 128, Code 39, Data Matrix, QR) using libraries such as ZBar, ZXing, or libdmtx — including the cases where they fail. * Experience deploying models to edge or embedded compute (NVIDIA Jetson or similar). * RESTful API design and integration; JSON, authentication, error handling. * Git, code review, and CI practices. * Ability to work onsite in Miramar, FL and directly with equipment on the production floor. **Preferred Qualifications** * OCR experience (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, TrOCR) applied to low\-quality industrial imagery. * Oriented / rotated object detection specifically (OBB heads, DOTA\-style datasets, or equivalent production experience). * Industrial camera integration — GigE Vision, USB3 Vision — and practical lens and lighting selection. * PLC/controls integration experience in a manufacturing environment. * Firmware experience on ARM/STM32 and RTOS environments. * Vision\-guided robotics: hand\-eye calibration, pick\-and\-place, 3D or depth sensing. * ERP or MES integration experience (NetSuite a plus). * Experience managing or technically overseeing external development contractors. * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) 6% Match * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

Our EPD Recruiting team builds the teams that build Plaid. We partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, and Security to deliver thoughtful, candidate\-first recruiting experiences that raise the bar for how we scale. We are responsible for delivering world\-class technical talent through pragmatic, data\-informed, and principle\-aligned recruiting practices. We believe the hardest hires are won upstream, in the research and the reach\-out, long before a loop is ever scheduled. Our goal is to help Plaid grow intentionally by hiring exceptional people who share our values and drive our mission to unlock financial freedom for everyone. We are hiring a Senior Technical Sourcer to build the pipelines behind Plaid's most difficult technical searches. You will own the top of the funnel across software engineering, infrastructure, data science, AI/ML, and security, from market research and pipeline strategy to qualified candidates entering the interview process. jobs.title: Information Technology Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About Qualstar** Qualstar Credit Union is a growing, well\-established, and financially strong not\-for\-profit organization dedicated to improving our members' financial lives. We are 60,000 members strong, headquartered in Bothell, WA, with 120 employees. We have a long\-standing commitment to valuing our staff at every level, reflected in our strong employee satisfaction scores and people\-focused culture. Qualstar has made significant investments in our technology infrastructure, including our data centers, WAN/LAN environment, and information security. We are now looking to strengthen our IT team with someone who brings both the technical skills and service mindset needed to support and maintain our network. **About the Role** As our IT Network Engineer, you'll be responsible for developing, maintaining, advancing Qualstar's network infrastructure while ensuring it supports the organization's business goals and technology needs. You'll work with the organization to understand business and technology needs, recommend strategic solutions, and ensure our network environment is secure, reliable, and aligned with our goals. This is a key role that works closely with the IT team to ensure seamless integration of networking solutions with Qualstar's other systems and technologies. You'll also have the opportunity to evaluate emerging networking technologies, participate in feasibility studies, and help lead the development and implementation of solutions that support Qualstar's continued growth. You'll also serve as a resource and technical mentor to other members of the IT team, sharing knowledge and helping strengthen the team's overall capabilities. Because we're a highly regulated financial institution, you'll be expected to work within established policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and professional standards. Just as importantly, you'll bring a strong service mindset to everything you do, while consistently demonstrating Qualstar's core values. **Key Technologies** * Symitar / Episys core banking system • VMware ESXi • Citrix VDI • Next\-generation firewalls • WAN technologies including MPLS, SD\-WAN, and IPSec VPN • VoIP / phone system technologies • Web\-facing and mobile application delivery • Microsoft technology stack • Multi\-site WAN environments • Data center technologies **Our Ideal Candidate** We're looking for a technical, strategic, and service\-minded professional who enjoys both solving problems today and thinking about how technology can better support the organization tomorrow. You'll be a great fit if you: * Can configure a switch in the morning and help shape a strategic network technology plan in the afternoon. * Have broad knowledge base across the full technology stack, from hardware \& telephony to next\-gen firewalls. * Enjoy taking ownership and being accountable for an entire network technology ecosystem. * Have specific and recent hands\-on expertise in most of our key technologies. * Enjoy collaborating with others and can explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Why Join Qualstar?** You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working in an organization that values both its members and its employees: * **Stable \& Growing:** Join a well\-capitalized, financially strong organization with a long history in the community. * **Big Enough to Grow, Small Enough to Connect:** With approximately 120 employees, you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact while building meaningful relationships across the organization. * **People\-Focused Culture:** Our employee satisfaction scores consistently reflect a highly engaged and satisfied workforce. * **Work\-Life Balance:** Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, and 10 paid federal holidays, with flexibility for occasional remote work available after establishing yourself in the role. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including life insurance, long\-term disability, and AD\&D insurance. * **Retirement Benefits:** Generous 401(k) benefits, including employer matching. * **Additional Perks:** Employees receive a 1% rate discount on approved consumer loans and a 0\.5% discount on mortgage loans, Free parking, and an Employee Assistance Program. * **Bothell Headquarters:** Our headquarters technology directly supports our people, our members, and our mission, we'd love to hear from you! *Qualstar Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Analyst, Front-End (Pre-Service) Revenue Cycle
jobs.description: R1 is the leading provider of technology\-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration. As a **Senior Analytics Analyst** , you will own the reporting and analysis behind R1's front\-end revenue cycle \- pre\-registration, pre\-authorization, and insurance verification. This is one of the harder analytics problems in the business: the data doesn't sit in one database, so you'll pull it together from systems, engineers, and the people who run the programs themselves. The numbers you produce go to health system stakeholders and clients as contractual KPIs, which means accuracy here has direct financial consequences. You'll join a team of three analysts, taking over a well\-established and genuinely complex book of work. **What you'll do** * Build and deliver recurring and ad\-hoc reporting on pre\-service performance for internal leaders and client stakeholders * Source data that lives across multiple systems and owners, partnering directly with engineers and pre\-service program teams to get what isn't in a database * Write intermediate\-to\-advanced SQL \- CTEs, window functions, unions, and the right join for the job \- against Databricks and related platforms * Develop Power BI dashboards and DAX measures that make front\-end KPIs clear to non\-technical audiences * Automate recurring reporting and manual workflows using Power Automate and Excel * Analyze complex datasets to surface trends, patterns, and anomalies, then translate them into concise summaries leadership can act on * Validate data transfers and reporting outputs, since these metrics carry contractual obligations Take full ownership of a defined reporting portfolio and the stakeholder relationships that come with it * **What we're looking for** * Intermediate or better SQL, with fluency in CTEs, row\-number/window functions, unions, and join logic * Hands\-on Databricks experience * Advanced Excel \- XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and the speed that comes from really knowing the tool * Power BI, including comfort building with DAX * Power Automate * Experience working in analytics with complex datasets, ideally in healthcare, finance, or operations * Strong communication skills \- much of this data is obtained by asking the right people the right questions Preferred: Snowflake, Python, and experience applying AI to real analytics work (Databricks especially) * **This role might be right for you if…** * You'd rather chase down a fragmented data source than wait for someone to hand you a clean table * You like being trusted to run your own work and make your own calls * You want your reporting to matter \- these KPIs are tied to contractual commitments, not just a dashboard someone glances at * You're curious about applying AI in day\-to\-day analytics You enjoy a collaborative team where people genuinely help each other out * **Your first 30 and 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Learning and access. jobs.title: Lead Back End Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human\-centred creativity, and AI\-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact\-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our \#LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience \#LifeatRealChem. Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life\-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing. Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self\-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future. We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Back End to drive the services and data model that power the platform. You will lead back\-end architecture and hands\-on delivery, hire and grow a team of back\-end and data engineers, and direct how the platform's data scales, stays reliable, and connects to the systems around it. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence. #### **What You'll Do:** * Lead the platform's application data model in Aurora and DynamoDB, and the access\-pattern decisions behind it, as the product scales. * Drive the integration contract with our data warehouse — what flows each way, on what cadence — and keep the warehouse out of the platform's request path. * Define API contracts together with the front end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system. * Direct the reliability, performance, and cost of back\-end services, partnering with DevOps on the platform\-level non\-functional requirements that take both teams' input. * Partner with data science to productionize the models and recommendation features built on top of the platform's data. * Hire and lead a team of back\-end and data engineers, setting a high bar for code quality and CI\-enforced testing. * Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use. * Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort. **This position is a perfect fit for you if:** * You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. * You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. * You are highly organized self\-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. #### **What You Should Have:** * 8\+ years in back\-end or full\-stack engineering, including 2\+ years leading a team. * Experience leading a data model and access patterns for a B2B or enterprise product at meaningful scale, ideally across both a relational and a NoSQL store. * Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch. * Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI\-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced. * Experience partnering with data science or ML teams to get models into production. * Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary. * Comfort with ambiguity and a fast\-moving, still\-small engineering org. * Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems). **Pay Range:** $175,000\-$200,000 This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on . We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning. Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com. At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. jobs.title: Lead Front End Architect/Engineer
jobs.description: At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human\-centred creativity, and AI\-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact\-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our \#LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience \#LifeatRealChem. Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life\-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing. Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self\-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future. We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Front End to lead the architecture and hands\-on delivery of the interfaces our customers use to build and manage HCP journeys. You will lead front\-end engineering, hire and grow the team behind it, and partner closely with the back end lead and product designer so the platform's interface, data model, and design system evolve together. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence. ### **What You'll Do:** * Lead front\-end architecture and hands\-on delivery for the platform's user\-facing product, from early prototypes through production. * Lead the journey\-builder canvas — a direct\-manipulation, graph\-based interface — as it scales to more complex journeys and larger data volumes. * Define API contracts together with the back end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system. * Drive the code side of the design system and the design\-to\-code workflow, in partnership with the product designer, who leads the design system itself. * Direct how AI\-driven guardrails and model behavior are rendered and made trustworthy in the product. * Hire and lead a front\-end engineering team as it grows, setting a high bar for code quality and CI\-enforced testing. * Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use. * Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort. **This position is a perfect fit for you if:** * You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. * You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. * You are highly organized self\-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. ### **What You Should Have:** * 8\+ years in front\-end or full\-stack engineering, including 2\+ years leading a team. * Experience leading front\-end architecture for a B2B or enterprise product, ideally one with a complex, data\-dense, or direct\-manipulation UI (a canvas, graph editor, or similar). * Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch. * Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI\-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced. * Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary. * Ability to turn ambiguous product problems into a sequenced, shippable technical plan. * Comfort with ambiguity and a fast\-moving, still\-small engineering org. * Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems). **Pay Range:** $175,000\-$200,000 This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. jobs.description: Jacksonville, Florida 32201 Posted September 28th, 2026 ##### **Job Type: Full Time** ##### **Job Category: IT** #### **Job Description** **Job Title:** Salesforce Developer with python **Location**: Dallas, TX / Jacksonville, FL(Onsite) Fulltime **Job Description** Salesforce Developer with python Must Have Technical/Functional Skills 1\. Technical Profile Summary The Senior Salesforce Developer will design, develop, and optimize scalable enterprise architectures across core Salesforce clouds and decoupled middleware/data ecosystems. This role bridges programmatic Salesforce engineering (Apex, LWC) with modern programmatic backend capabilities (Python), leading API\-first integrations, data pipeline engineering, automation frameworks, and maintainable enterprise software design patterns. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 2\. Core Salesforce Platform \& Programmatic Development (Mandatory) * Apex Engineering \& Architecture: o Advanced object\-oriented programming (OOP) using enterprise design patterns (Trigger Handler frameworks, Service Layer pattern, Domain/Selector layer, Unit of Work pattern). o Asynchronous processing mastery: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex with chaining, Schedulable jobs, and Continuation patterns for long\-running callouts. o Rigorous transaction management and governor limit mitigation strategies (SOQL/SOSL query optimization, heap size tuning, and bulkified CPU execution profiling). o Comprehensive automated testing using Apex Mocks, stub APIs, and enterprise\-grade test isolation fixtures achieving resilient code coverage. * Modern Frontend (Lightning Web Components \& UX): o Modern JavaScript (ES6\+) and Lightning Web Components (LWC) reactive programming, lifecycle hooks, wire adapters, and @api/@track state architecture. o Component orchestration via Lightning Message Service (LMS), custom events, and publish\-subscribe paradigms across decoupled UI boundaries. o Experience handling complex data tables, real\-time client validation, custom modal interactions, and Lightning Design System (SLDS) styling standards. o Legacy maintenance and refactoring capabilities: aura component modernization and Visualforce deprecation roadmaps. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 3\. Enterprise Integration \& Middleware Architecture (Mandatory) * API Development \& Protocols: o Designing and consuming custom RESTful and SOAP web services (Apex REST APIs, external REST endpoints, JSON/XML parsing). o Deep understanding of Salesforce native integration APIs: Composite API, Bulk API 2\.0, Streaming API, and GraphQL API. o Event\-Driven Architectures (EDA) using Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and Pub/Sub APIs for real\-time decoupled event streaming. * Security \& Authentication: o OAuth 2\.0 flows (JWT Bearer Token flow, Web Server flow, Authorization Code, Client Credentials) and mutual TLS (mTLS). o Named Credentials, External Credentials, Connected Apps configuration, and certificate\-based mutual authentication. * Hybrid Middleware \& Microservices: o Integrating Salesforce with enterprise middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, AWS EventBridge, Azure Service Bus). o Idempotency handling, exponential backoff, error retry queues, and dead\-letter queue (DLQ) architectures. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 4\. Python Development \& Data Ecosystem (Mandatory) * Python Capabilities \& Tooling: o Advanced proficiency in Python 3\.x (functional programming, object\-oriented design, type hinting, concurrency with asyncio, multithreading, or multiprocessing). o Direct experience with Salesforce programmatic interaction libraries such as simple\-salesforce, beatbox, and official REST/Bulk API wrappers. o Microservice / API development using frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or AWS Lambda serverless functions. * Data Engineering \& Automation Pipelines: o Designing Python\-driven ETL/ELT pipelines for high\-volume data synchronization between Salesforce and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or Databricks). o Data manipulation and cleansing using libraries such as pandas, polars, and numpy for data sanitation, mass deduplication, and complex transformations. o Automated operational scripts for bulk data extract, compliance validation, and platform telemetry aggregation. * AI \& Agentic Systems (Preferred / Emerging): o Interfacing Python\-based AI agents, LLMs, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with Salesforce data models (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Bedrock APIs, Salesforce Agentforce integration). Roles \& Responsibilities * Develop, implement and maintain Salesforce customizations, applications, extensions and integrations. * Develop complex workflows using flows and omni studio will be preferred * Develop LWC components * Participate in the planning/analysis of business requirements for system changes and enhancements. * Collaborate inter\-departmentally to identify business needs and translate them into technical solutions. * Create testing and implementation plans, including user training and documentation. * Remain current with Salesforce technologies and best practices. * Experience with Apex, Visualforce and the Lightning Component Framework. * Advanced knowledge of Salesforce permissions, roles, reports, dashboards, etc. * Experience with APIs and integrations. * Experience working on an Agile development team * Experience with software development outside of the Salesforce ecosystem. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. ##### **Required Skills** Data / Python Engineer Python / DevOps Engineer

jobs.title: Factory Test Technical Specialist II

Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. If you enjoy working on a multi\-disciplinary team with a broad mandate and want to put hands on hardware, then this is the team for you. **About the Role:** * Design, build, and operate pressurized cryogenic/pneumatic/hydraulic systems to support cutting\-edge rocket testing. * Develop and manage advanced data control systems for real\-time monitoring and analysis. * Provide expert guidance to engineers on testing best practices, system capabilities, and operational limitations. * Proactively identify and mitigate hazards to ensure a safe and efficient testing environment. * Create, maintain, and refine test plans and procedures to drive consistent and reliable testing outcomes. * Troubleshoot and resolve reliability issues, improving hardware performance and test effeciency **About You:** * High School Diploma or GED. * 4\+ years of relevant technical experience, including (but not limited to): + Experience working with pressureized flight components + Operating hazardous equipment with multiple sources of energy + Building Complex Fluid\-Mechanical Systems * Proficiency with Basic Office Software (Excel, Word, Outlook, Slack). **Nice to haves but not required:** * Associates Degree or Trade Certifications in pertinent disciplines: e.g., Aviation/Automotive Mechanic. * In\-depth knowledge and experience with test automation, data acquisition, and control systems. * Knowledge of rocket engine components such as pumps, valves, regulators, check valves, as well as electric, pneumatic, and hydraulic valves, actuators, and other fluid system components. **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. This includes anyone on F1/OPT visas.** Junior engineer or New College Grad (NCG) for Application Engineering position with focus on analog and mixed signal products as well as software / firmware development for position in HiRel product group. The primary function will be to work with our Marketing and Applications Engineering team to define, design and release analog and mixed signal products as well as assist our team with software and firmware development for our analog and mixed signal products. You will be part of an engineering team that is also responsible for defining system level reference design boards for our customers. The engineer will work under the guidance and mentoring of a senior Application Engineer. Programming experience with Python, Java, and/or C languages as well as knowledge of Verilog coding with FPGAs desired. This will include the following: * Definition and Design of the Application Demo boards and System Level reference designs with collaboration from Apps and Marketing for satellites power systems. * Schematic design, layout and BOM of the boards (Altium EDA is necessary). The candidate is eventually required to do PCB layouts. * Working with our software development group to design and test the system GUI’s. * Characterization and documentation of reference design electrical performance. * Publication of User Manual/Design Guide and working with the build group to get the board released into production. * Support of FAE or Marketing / Sales to help refine their application needs into deliverable reference designs to showcase solution performance. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **Board Design and Validation of Performance (30\-40% of time)**: Time spent planning and conceptualizing/block level architecture for the reference design. Validate the performance of the reference designs / demo boards. Prepare validation plan and compile validation reports post bench testing/characterization. You will be expected to keep accurate lab notes (software of your choice) and document any test procedures for future reference. On simpler reference designs, you will be required to provide the test house with a test requirement document to enable them to verify the operation of the board before being placed in stock. On more complicated reference designs, you will be required to do the verification of the operation before the boards are put in stock. **Documentation (30% of time):** Generate User’s Guide that provide a clear explanation of the purpose of the reference design and the advantages it brings to the customer. User Guides should also include schematic of board, picture of board, performance of key specs with test conditions and any software information. It is important to document how the boards were tested in the User’s Guide, so the customer can reproduce our results. If required, will be expected to publish customers responses, and possible Articles. FrameMaker is our publishing software for our User Guides thus familiarity with this software is preferred. **Customer Support (20% of time):** You will work with marketing and sales to facilitate the design\-in of our products as well as providing technical assistance to address customer questions and analyze field returns. This will include assisting with software development for our evaluation platforms. You will train Field Application Engineers on products and demonstrations systems to enhance sales channel effectiveness. **Design\-in Activities (10\-20%)** You will work with marketing and sales to facilitate the design\-in of our products and answer customer questions about the reference designs. You will train Field Application Engineers on the operation of the boards to enhance sales channel effectiveness. **Qualifications** **Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Renesas is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position now or in the future. This includes anyone on F1/OPT visas.** * Candidate must possess a minimum bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic/Computer Engineering. * Candidate should be self\-motivated and conscientious. * Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Candidate must have good presentation skills. * Candidate should have a good knowledge of analog / mixed signal design and lab troubleshooting skills. * Candidate must understand and follow industry standards of test for analog /mixed signal IC devices. **Required Skills:** * 0\-3 Years in Applications and/or Systems Engineering role in Analog IC Development or Circuit Design Industry. * Experience in Schematic/Layout design tools for Analog Mixed Signal, Power Management, MCU, FPGA, and DDR Memory in system level applications. * Proficient with electronic bench lab equipment (power supplies, function generators, multi\-meters, oscilloscopes). * Experience in building system level applications involving FPGA/ASIC, MCU, DDR memory interface using Verilog a plus. * Familiar with Microsoft Office (Excel, Power Point). * Experience with using Schematic/Layout EDA software (ie. Altium) is necessary. * Analog Mixed Signal products necessary. * Analog Mixed Signal experience preferred. * Previous experience working on power systems on satellites and understanding the power needs of satellite systems is very desirable. * Past satellite system design a plus. * Experience modeling circuits (IBIS, SPICE, and/or SIMPLIS) is a plus. * Experience writing programming code (ie. Python) to automate lab bench equipment in GBIP/USB communication a plus. * Experience with programming in Java, C, or similar language preferred. * Knowledge of I2C/SPI communication protocols are a plus. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect – Agentic Sales Technology
jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **The Experience** We're looking for a Senior Solution Architect who operates at the intersection of deep business process intuition and hands\-on agentic engineering. This is a senior individual contributor role operating at director level — you will be a hands\-on technical leader who builds, ships, and influences at scale without relying on organizational authority. You will not have direct reports, but your impact will be felt across an architecture organization. You think strategically and execute rapidly, often in the same week. The core mandate of this role is incremental transformation of prospect management — from lead generation and qualification through lead management and opportunity progression. This pipeline was architected for human\-scale workflows, and the business expectation is clear: rapidly layer in new agentic tooling (Salesforce on Salesforce), measure impact, innovate, and iterate. You won't be rebuilding from scratch — you'll be threading intelligent agents into a live, complex system while keeping it moving. That requires as much judgment as it does technical skill. Wherever there is an opportunity to apply agentic AI to transform a business process, your first question on every engagement is always: does this process make sense before we agentify it? You'll bring coherence to a multi\-technology landscape where multiple agentic tools are being implemented simultaneously — ensuring that buyer engagement agents, conversational sales agents, and the underlying CRM and routing infrastructure form a coherent, observable, and scalable whole. This role sits at the intersection of three organizational pillars — Sales Technology, Digital Marketing, and Data Solutions — and operates as a key architectural partner across all three. You will be accountable for E2E outcomes while holding direct responsibility for the architectural and technology components that live in CRM. Strong cross\-pillar collaboration is not optional; it's how this role delivers. This role oscillates between two modes. In fast\-twitch mode, you're supporting small, focused squads — simplifying the process, and getting a working prototype in the hands of users within days, making key architectural decisions that set the squad up for delivering a successful business outcome. You're not waiting for alignment; you're generating it through working software. In slow\-burn mode, you're providing early architectural points of view on complex enterprise systems that don't fit the fast\-twitch pace model — influencing the direction of large, integrated programs where the cost of getting the architecture wrong compounds over time. Strategic thinking and rapid execution are both required; this role demands you bring both, calibrated to the situation. You'll work across initiatives of varying scale and complexity — from focused two\-week sprints to multi\-quarter enterprise programs — and your job is to bring the right architectural posture to each one. Speed of learning and speed of shipping are equally important here — rapid learning is what makes rapid delivery sustainable. Equally important: this role advances how we build. You'll practice and model an AI\-native development lifecycle (AIDLC) — using Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex not as productivity shortcuts but as a fundamentally different way of working. Architecture patterns, best practices, and compliance checks should be baked into the tooling, not left to individual teams to figure out. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing...** Agentic Architecture \& Incremental Transformation * Own the architectural foundation for agentic selling across the full marketing\-to\-sales pipeline — lead generation, lead qualification, lead management, and opportunity progression * Drive an incremental transformation approach: layer agentic tooling into live systems deliberately, instrument for impact, and create tight feedback loops for innovation and iteration * Define and track meaningful architectural success metrics — including agent\-driven pipeline conversion lift, lead qualification rates, routing accuracy, and agent deflection/escalation patterns * Assess and rationalize  d — experience modeling unified customer profiles (Individual, Contact Point, Engagement), building calculated insights and segmentation for agent grounding, and configuring Data Cloud activations that feed downstream agent actions * Knowledge of best practices for MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent\-to\-Agent) development for agent interoperability — including how to expose Salesforce data and actions as MCP tools consumable by external orchestrators * Experience instrumenting agent observability: structured logging of agent reasoning traces, tool call latency, hallucination detection, and feedback loop design for continuous prompt iteration * Experience with buyer engagement or conversational intelligence platforms (e.g., Qualified, Gong, Chorus) and how they integrate with Salesforce as data sources for agent context * Public cloud experience (AWS preferred) — particularly Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, or S3 in the context of hosting agent tools, context stores, or retrieval backends that extend Salesforce agents Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.
