peripherals and backend servers across the site. * Perform printer deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Coordinate with vendors and system integrators for installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and service improvement. * Monitor service performance and identify opportunities to improve availability and cost efficiency. **Meeting Room \& Collaboration Technology** * Partner with AV and collaboration technology vendors to deliver reliable and standardized meeting room solutions. * Perform installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting and lifecycle management of meeting room technology. * Support meeting room technology upgrades, expansions, and new site deployments. **IT Projects \& Service Improvement** * Lead or participate in IT technology deployment and infrastructure projects across manufacturing and office environments. * Support new building, facility, and workspace deployments, including endpoint, mobile, printing, and collaboration technologies. * Coordinate project activities across IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and contractors. * Support technology rollouts while minimizing operational impact to manufacturing and business operations. * Work with external vendors, system integrators, and managed service providers to deliver IT services and projects. * Evaluate technical solutions, service quality, and vendor performance. **Minimum Qualifications/Requirements**: * **Education:** * + Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Experience: * + Minimum 2 years’ experience in IT client services, endpoint computing, desktop engineering, workplace technology, or a related field. * **Technical Skills:** * + Strong hands\-on experience with Windows PC and laptop hardware, operating systems, peripherals, and enterprise applications. + Experience supporting mobile devices and enterprise mobility environments. + Experience with printer deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting. + Experience supporting meeting rooms, video conferencing, or collaboration technologies. + Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues across hardware, software, network, and application layers. * **Interpersonal Skills:** * + Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical users. + Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks, and manage projects in a fast\-paced enterprise environment. * **Physical Requirements:** * + This role requires the ability to work across office, clean\-room, and data center environments, performing tasks that range from standard office duties to specialized operations in controlled spaces, including the ability to occasionally stand, walk, reach, bend, and carry light objects. + Occasionally lift or move up to 40 pounds. + Ability to use a computer, keyboard, mouse and other standard office equipment for prolonged periods of time. + Ability to wear clean\-room suit while standing and/or walking in the FAB as needed. + Ability to complete occasional local travel requirements. **Shift Expectations:*** Standard work hours: Monday through Friday 9am to 6pm * Support TSMC Arizona’s 24/7/365 operations by participating in a rotational on\-call schedule (approximately one full week every two months), requiring 24/7 responsiveness during your designated shift to meet urgent business needs. **Application When you are at your best—physically, mentally, and financially—our company thrives. jobs.description: Texas Windstorm Insurance Association (TWIA) is seeking a motivated technical professional to join our organization as a ‘Software Developer I’ and contribute to building and enhancing modern applications, including proprietary insurance software solutions. In this role, you’ll work across the full development lifecycle—partnering with experienced engineers and business stakeholders to design, develop, and support high\-quality software. This role is ideal for a junior developer who is eager to learn, grow their technical skillset, and take on new challenges. We’re committed to supporting your career development through hands\-on experience, mentorship, and opportunities to expand your expertise in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** THE FOLLOWING ARE THE USUAL, BASIC AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION. HOWEVER, THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT PRECLUDE THE PERFORMANCE OF OTHER DUTIES BY THE INCUMBENT. THESE FUNCTIONS ARE NOT TO BE CONSTRUED AS AN EXHAUSTIVE LIST OF ALL RESPONSIBILITIES, DUTIES, AND SKILLS REQUIRED: * Prepare, design and implement software for moderate to complex custom developed applications or Guidewire products and integrate those applications with other custom or commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) applications. * Participate in creating and maintaining plans to develop custom software, Guidewire products, and integration with other applications. * Estimate level of effort and elapsed time to design, implement, and test software. * Document, implement and unit test code based on approved designs. * Provide periodic status of deliverables, level of effort, and timeframes to completion. * Troubleshoot, as required, problems with software in production. * Provide input into, and help manager develop and then implement own personal training plan. * Formally document designs using established documentation standards. * Plan and implement production rollout of software upgrades to custom developed and Guidewire products. * Collaborate with external consultants and developers on large scale projects. Guide business department personnel in technical and business capability of software applications. * **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Four\-year college degree, preferably in CS, engineering or other technical field, or equivalent experience. * 1\+ years software development experience * Familiarity with formal software development processes and best practices. * Familiarity with software package selection processes. * Hands\-on experience as a software application developer using different application software architectures (e.g. MVC, client server, etc.). * Experience coding with Java, J2EE, GOSU or .NET or other object\-oriented technologies. * Implementation experience in at least one full life\-cycle implementations. * Experience translating business requirements into concise technical design documents. * Knowledge of database constructs and experience with SQL. * Experience writing business rules, interpreting XMLs and making user interface design changes. * Demonstrated ability to design, configure, and test software products. * Clear, effective verbal and written communication skills including the ability to actively listen, problem solve, and communicate effectively with both technical and business users. Demonstrated experience working both as an individual contributor and as part of a team. * **PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Graduate degree in technical discipline. * Familiarity with agile methodology. * Experience with MS SQL Server. * Property and casualty insurance experience. * Guidewire Insurance Suite. Any IT certification. * **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** Applicant should be able to demonstrate proficiency in some of these technologies: * Java * Java EE * Java Web Services (SOAP) and/ or RESTful * Subversion, Git * Design Patterns * Guidewire * .Net/C\# JBoss ESB * **Why work with TWIA?** We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support both your professional success and personal well\-being. A key highlight of our offering is a fully remote work environment, allowing you to contribute from home with no relocation required. In addition to our benefits, TWIA fosters a collaborative and mission\-driven work environment where employees are valued, supported, and encouraged to grow. Our teams work closely across departments, promoting transparency, efficiency, and a shared commitment to serving our policyholders and communities. Employees also enjoy: * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, group life, AD\&D, and dependent life insurance coverage * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) with a generous annual HSA employer contribution * A 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions up to 6%, in addition to a pension plan that begins vesting at 5 years of employment * Active support for professional growth, including ongoing training and professional development opportunities sponsored by TWIA, support to obtain professional certifications, and a tuition reimbursement program * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, paid holidays, and personal days * Flexible scheduling to support work\-life balance

jobs.title: Test Cell Product Strategy Manager
jobs.description: »* **Date:** Sep 28, 2026 **Location:** North Reading, MA, US San Jose, CA, US Agoura Hills, CA, US Irvine, CA, US Tualatin, OR, US **Company:** Teradyne We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next\-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost\-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world! We attract, develop, and retain a high\-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive. **Our Purpose** TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team, one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results. **Opportunity Overview** The Datacenter \& Client Business Unit is Teradyne's fastest\-growing market, supporting the testing of high\-performance compute, AI accelerator, networking, and advanced semiconductor devices that power the world's largest infrastructure deployments. As a Test Cell Product Strategy Manager, you will define and drive the strategy for production test cell solutions that enable our customers' most demanding applications. This highly visible individual contributor role will serve as the bridge between customer requirements, industry trends, and Teradyne's product roadmap. Working across engineering, applications, product management, sales, marketing, operations, and external ecosystem partners, you will help ensure Teradyne maintains leadership in delivering innovative test cell solutions. **Key Responsibilities:** * Lead the multi\-year test cell product strategy for the Datacenter \& Client Business Unit, including thermal, power delivery, signal integrity, docking, manipulation, and interface hardware capabilities. * Translate customer production requirements and semiconductor market trends into product requirements and roadmap priorities. * Partner with engineering and applications teams to ensure test cell solutions are available ahead of customer production ramps through internal development and strategic partnerships. * Drive go\-to\-market activities for test cell product launches, including positioning, field enablement, launch readiness, and adoption tracking. * Monitor competitive landscapes and industry developments to strengthen Teradyne's market differentiation and value proposition. * Develop and maintain technical collateral, presentations, proof points, and sales enablement materials supporting customer engagement and field success. * Represent Teradyne at industry conferences, customer technology reviews, standards organizations, and executive briefings. * Act as the primary business unit contact for field\-driven test cell requirements, evaluating opportunities for scalable productization and operational deployment. * Collaborate with ecosystem partners supplying handlers, probers, manipulators, sockets, probe cards, thermal systems, and related test cell technologies. * Support strategic customer design\-in opportunities and joint development programs alongside sales and business development teams. **All About You** We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. jobs.description: The **Quality Assurance \& Test (QA\&T) Engineer** supports **RECONCRAFT** evaluating and improving existing vessel designs, leading hands\-on testing, evaluation, and system\-level analysis to assess and optimize the vessels' performance, durability, and reliability against operational requirements. This role also functions in a "pit crew" capacity, performing on\-the\-spot maintenance and repairs on vessels during evaluations and field exercises to keep vessels mission capable and evaluation schedules on track. The QA\&T Engineer translates operational requirements into vessel systems requirements, identifies and documents design and system improvement opportunities, and works closely with engineering, program, and production teams to implement and validate design changes. This role spends significant time on the water and in the field, including forward\-deployed evaluation sites and exercises. This is a temporary position with the ability to move to a permanent position. requirements * Collect, analyze, and document test data; compile test reports, findings, and improvement recommendations * Translate operational requirements (mission profile, sea state, payload, endurance, crew tasks) into vessel systems and design requirements * Identify design, system, and component deficiencies; develop and document recommendations to enhance performance, durability, and reliability * Track and maintain a running log of vessel discrepancies, lessons learned, and design improvement opportunities across evaluation events * Support integration and testing of new or modified vessel systems (propulsion, hull, electrical, hydraulics, electronics, outfitting) while considering operational effectiveness and maintainability Pit Crew — Maintenance \& Field Support * Serve as the primary hands\-on maintenance and repair technician supporting vessels during evaluations, trials, and field exercises * Perform preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on vessel systems (mechanical, electrical, propulsion, hydraulic) to keep vessels mission capable * Stage, transport, and maintain tools, spare parts, and support equipment needed to sustain vessel operations away from the home facility * Respond quickly to in\-field equipment failures or damage during exercises, making sound rapid repair and return\-to\-service decisions * Coordinate with program, engineering, and production teams to source parts, escalate issues, and implement fixes or design changes as needed * Maintain maintenance logs, repair records, and equipment status reporting for each evaluation event Systems Engineering \& Design Optimization * Partner with engineering and design teams to recommend vessel system and design modifications that improve performance, durability, reliability, maintainability, etc. * Evaluate proposed design changes for operational suitability and feed field/test results back into the design process * Support development of technical specifications, drawings, and work packages reflecting approved design improvements * Participate in design reviews and provide test\-informed input on system trade\-offs Reporting \& Documentation * Develop and maintain test plans, checklists, data logs, and after\-action reports for each evaluation and exercise * Brief program, engineering, and customer stakeholders on test results, vessel status, and improvement recommendations * Maintain accurate, organized documentation supporting program and contractual requirements Essential Skills and Experience: Education * requirements * Experience developing and executing test plans and documenting test results and findings * Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and specifications * Strong troubleshooting and field\-repair skills; comfortable making rapid, sound maintenance decisions under time and operational pressure * Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable briefing program, engineering, and customer stakeholders * Self\-motivated and able to work independently in forward\-deployed or field environments with limited support * Valid driver's license; ability to obtain a passport if not currently held * Ability to obtain a state Boater's certification/card in appropriate jurisdiction(s) Physical Requirements * Ability to perform physically demanding maintenance and repair tasks in varying weather and sea conditions * Ability to lift and move tools, parts, and equipment; work in confined vessel spaces; stand, kneel, and work for extended periods on and off the water * Ability to travel as needed, including to forward\-deployed sites, for extended evaluation and exercise periods Preferred Knowledge/Experience * Prior experience supporting vessel test and evaluation programs, R\&D, or prototype/first\-of\-class vessels * Marine mechanic, diesel/outboard technician, or similar hands\-on maintenance background * Current USCG jobs.description: **Your Opportunity as the Lead Engineer, Digital Twin Systems, PET** Lead the overall Digital Twin initiative for Pet. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and scaling digital twins of Smucker manufacturing assets, processes, and systems to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, throughput, uptime, cost, and sustainability. This role bridges operations, data, and analytics by translating real‑world manufacturing behavior into virtual models that enable monitoring, simulation, prediction, and optimization. **Location:** Topeka, KS **Work Arrangements:** 100% on\-site Willingness to work extended hours and flow to the work as needed * **In this role you will:** * Lead cross\-functional team including Operations, Cost of Quality technology workstream, Technical Services, and Engineering to design and maintain digital twins representing physical assets, production lines, and end‑to‑end manufacturing processes. * Organization of strategy, execution of plan, and communication to leadership. * Develop in\-house Digital Twin expertise within PET SBA. * Integrate historical and real‑time data (sensor, process, quality, and setpoint data) into digital twin models. * Apply statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to enable: + Predictive maintenance and failure forecasting + Anomaly detection and fault identification + Waste, downtime, and energy optimization * Partner with Operations, Engineering, Quality, R\&D, and OpEx teams to identify high‑value digital twin use cases. * Translate digital twin insights into actionable recommendations, controls, and operating standards. * Support pilot deployment, scale‑up, and replication of successful digital twin use cases across sites. * Optimize process parameters to improve CpK, yield, throughput, and asset reliability. * Identify data quality gaps, sensor drift, missing data, and inconsistencies. * Collaborate with IT/IS and controls teams to improve data pipelines, tagging standards, and contextualization. * Act as a technical and operational translator between plant teams and data/analytics partners. * Support training and change management to embed digital twin insights into daily operations. Contribute to digital manufacturing standards, best practices, and governance frameworks. * **What we are looking for:** Minimum Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, or related field required * Minimum of 5\-years’ experience in manufacturing, process engineering, operations, or industrial analytics. * Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, equipment behavior, and operational KPIs. Ability to communicate complex analytical insights in a clear, actionable way to non‑technical * **The Right Place for You** We are bold, kind, strive to do the right thing, we play to win, and we believe in a strong community that thrives together. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. **Job Description** This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division \- the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants. As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole. We are seeking a highly technical, customer\-focused Product Solutions Architect (PSA) to lead technical pre\-sales and implementation for our suite of API and AI products, with a primary focus on creating agents that solve customer problems with our newly launched and forthcoming Gracenote Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers. You will serve as the technical bridge between our customers and our product/engineering teams, enabling B2B clients to successfully integrate our authoritative metadata into their LLM\-powered discovery experiences, and highlight the value of AI\-first approaches to their business problems. **Key Responsibilities** * **Technical Pre\-Sales \& Consultation:** Partner with Sales to apply Gracenote’s GTM strategy, demonstrate the value of AI solutions to a variety of customer stakeholders (Product, Technology, or Marketing \-oriented profiles). Lead discovery sessions, understand customer use\-cases, AI \-based architecture and identify tangible value propositions for how Gracenote metadata can improve customer’s discovery experience using AI. Elaborate and run proof of concepts. Own and secure customer engagement and adoption through contract signature. * **Develop Agentic Solutions:** Design, build, and maintain a portfolio of focused, single\-purpose AI agents that demonstrate specific technical capabilities of the Gracenote Video MCP Server — translating complex, multi\-step entertainment workflows (such as conversational search, catalog enrichment, and personalized recommendations) into tangible, hands\-on prototypes * **Deploy on Frameworks:** Possess experience deploying these agents on various agentic frameworks, such as those provided by Google or AWS, to prove their efficacy * **Solution Architecture:** Analyze complex, siloed customer environments to recommend optimal integration patterns and map Gracenote tools/resources to customer\-specific AI \-based workflows. Act as "Customer Zero" to familiarize with, test and validate new MCP tools and features before they roll out to clients. * **Implementation Excellence:** Guide developers through the technical adoption process, providing code\-level guidance, documenting integration use cases, and helping customers leverage JSON\-RPC 2\.0 standards for seamless API/server interaction. * **Product Advocacy:** Function as the "voice of the customer" to influence product roadmaps, translating customer requirements into actionable product inquiries (PIs) and technical documentation. * **Strategic Engagement:** Establish standardized SLAs and best practices for implementation, ensuring consistent delivery across Tier 1 and Tier 2 global accounts. **Qualifications*** **Technical Mastery:** Solid grasp of agent creation and agentic deployment frameworks and MCP tooling, specifically how LLMs utilize MCP primitives (Tools, Resources, Prompts), JSON\-RPC 2\.0, and AWS ecosystem with specific, practical experience leveraging AWS Cognito for identity management, user authentication, and secure API access control. * **Agentic AI \& Orchestration:** Experience designing, deploying, or observing multi\-step AI agents using one or more of the following frameworks: Google ADK, AWS Bedrock Agents, LangChain, or LlamaIndex preferred. Deep understanding of tool chaining (MCP), system prompt engineering, function calling across major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT), and step\-level tracing or response evaluation. * **Consultative Expertise:** Proven ability to navigate complex enterprise security (OAuth/OIDC) and data privacy requirements while effectively communicating technical solutions to diverse audiences, from C\-level executives to engineering teams. * **Experience:** Strong experience in Python or TypeScript/Node.js to support PoCs and integration with B2B enterprise APIs. Experience connecting MCP clients and servers to managed enterprise foundation models via AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI / Foundry, etc. Familiarity with large\-scale structured datasets, content discovery architectures, and search \& recommendations engine mechanics. Familiarity with the CTV/Streaming and the entertainment ecosystem is extremely welcome but not required. * **Customer interaction skills:** Proven ability to bridge the gap between complex LLM/MCP architectures and business objectives, leveraging strong consultative leadership and stakeholder management skills to guide discovery, execute Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and effectively communicate technical strategy to audiences ranging from C\-suite executives to engineering teams. * **Travel:** Ability to travel to customer sites globally up to 40% of the time to conduct workshops, discovery sessions, and on\-site technical support. \#LI\-AW1 **Additional Information** **Enabling your best to power a better media future.** **Holistic Rewards:** We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company\-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility. **Compensation Transparency:** The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives**.** Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class. Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our centralized development team, where you'll help design, build, and maintain the internal systems that support our retail operations. In this role, you'll develop both front\-end user experiences and back\-end services for highly integrated web applications that connect our physical stores, point\-of\-sale systems, order management, inventory management, customer\-facing platforms, and other core business systems. You'll collaborate across the full software development lifecycle, building intuitive user interfaces, developing scalable APIs and business logic, integrating with internal systems, and optimizing application performance. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire technology stack while contributing to solutions that have a direct impact on our business. Our team values both collaboration and ownership. You'll have the autonomy to lead your work from design through implementation while partnering with teammates through code reviews, pair programming, and architectural discussions. We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building high\-quality software, solving complex technical challenges, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and teamwork. **Responsibilities** -------------------- You'll contribute to a suite of internal full\-stack web applications built with C\#/.NET Core, SQL, and modern front\-end frameworks that support our retail operations. These applications power our point\-of\-sale system, order and customer management, inventory management, order fulfillment, and other business\-critical services. In this role, you will: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications and services. * Build new features and enhance existing functionality across our retail platforms. * Develop and maintain integrations between internal systems, including our GraphQL API. * Troubleshoot and resolve application and integration issues to improve system performance and reliability. * Collaborate with teammates on technical design, code reviews, and architectural decisions. * Work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software that supports our retail operations. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Work is performed while sitting/standing and interfacing with a personal computer. * Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing. * Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations. * Requires occasional bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching. * Requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 50lbs. **Remote Work Qualifications** ------------------------------ * Access to a reliable and secure high\-speed internet connection. Cable or fiber internet connections (at least 75mbps download/10mbps upload) are preferred, as satellite connections often cannot support the technologies used to perform day\-to\-day tasks. * Access to a home router and modem. * A dedicated home office space that is noise\- and distraction\-free. The space should have strong wireless connection or a wired Ethernet connection (wired connection is preferred, if possible). * A valid, physical address (apartment, suite, etc.). PO Boxes are not supported, as a physical address is required for you to receive your computer equipment. * The desire and ability to work and communicate with other team members via chat, webcam, etc. * Legal residents of one of the following states: (AK, AL, AR, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WI, WV, or WY). H\-1B Visa Sponsorship Not Available, W2 only. **Experience** -------------- * 3\+ years of professional experience developing applications with C\#/.NET Core. * Experience working with SQL databases, including writing and optimizing queries. * Experience with at least one modern front\-end framework (such as React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar). * Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles and software development best practices. * Experience using Git or another version control system. * Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues in a collaborative team environment. **Bonus Skills:** * Experience building or consuming GraphQL APIs. * Experience with Entity Framework. * Experience developing applications with Vue.js. * Experience working with Nuxt.js. **Education** ------------- This role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else. **Desired Traits \& Skills** ---------------------------- **Hungry:** * Passionate about their work. * Goes above and beyond to get the job done. * Looks for opportunities in all aspects of the company. * Process improvement focus. **Humble:** * Easily admits to mistakes. * Acknowledges his/her weaknesses. * Displays a grounded confidence but not arrogance. **Smart:** * Shows empathy. * Attentive listener. * Adjusts his/her own behavior to fit the nature of a conversation. * Understands what others are thinking. **Company Overview** -------------------- Your one\-stop\-shop for restaurant supplies and foodservice equipment. We aim to exceed our customers’ expectations by providing excellent hospitality, quality, and value. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical * Vision * Dental * PTO * Paid Maternity Leave * Paid Parental Leave * Life Insurance * Disability * Dependent Care FSA * 401(k) matching * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Incentives * Company Discounts * AT\&T \& Verizon Discount * Bonus Opportunities * Accident Insurance * Critical Illness Insurance * Adoption Assistance ### **Available at HQ Locations Only** * On\-Site Fitness Centers * Dog\-friendly Offices

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **How to Apply** ---------------- A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position. **Job Summary** --------------- The mission of the University of Michigan Office of the Vice President for Research (OVPR) is to catalyze, support, and safeguard U\-M research. To that end, our team is constantly striving to foster new research, build partnerships, and provide support to our researchers to realize our vision of research to serve the world. OVPR runs on systems that were never designed to talk to each other. Our small IT team supports more than thirty units, and much of what we build closes that gap: pulling identity, human resources, finance, space, and service data into one place, then replacing manual, spreadsheet driven work with software people actually want to use. In this role you will design and build those applications. You will write the code, own the data structures behind it, and integrate against university services through the U\-M API Gateway and central identity systems. You will also sit with the staff whose process you are automating and ask enough questions to understand it before you build anything. And you will use AI as an engineering tool rather than a talking point, because a growing share of what we ship is built with, or powered by, the university's generative AI platforms. This is a small team with a wide surface. You will own work early, you will see it in production quickly, and the people using it are the ones supporting research across the university. **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- **Application Development and Integration** * Design, build, and maintain web applications and internal tools that consolidate data from across the university, including OVPR's Backstage portal and its custom plugins. * Develop and consume APIs, including university services reached through the U\-M API Gateway such as Finance, Department, MCommunity, and TeamDynamix. * Integrate applications with central identity services including Okta OIDC and Shibboleth, and with unit systems of record such as CollectionSpace. * Deploy and support containerized applications on the U\-M Container Service. * Troubleshoot and resolve defects across the full stack, from the interface through to the data layer. **Data Architecture and Management** * Model, build, and query the relational data behind OVPR applications, keeping structures clear enough that a small team can maintain them. * Aggregate data across sources that frequently disagree, including identity claims, human resources records, financial shortcodes, space and equipment data, and group memberships. * Build reporting and dashboards that answer the questions OVPR units ask repeatedly. * Apply appropriate handling for institutional data based on its sensitivity classification. **Process Automation and Applied AI** * Turn documented business processes into working automation, replacing manual and spreadsheet based workflows with supported applications. * Apply the university's generative AI platforms, including the U\-M GPT Toolkit and ITS AI Workflows, to automate multi step work with human review built in. * Evaluate where AI genuinely improves an outcome and where a conventional solution is the better answer. * Identify automation opportunities while working alongside unit staff, and raise them rather than waiting to be asked. **Requirements and Collaboration** * Work directly with OVPR unit staff to understand how a process actually runs, not only how it is documented, and translate that into a technical design. * Partner with ITS and other technical providers on shared services, integrations, and dependencies. * Explain technical tradeoffs clearly to people without a technical background, and bring them along on the decision. * Coordinate with the IT Business Consultant and Associate Director so that consultation, project delivery, and development stay aligned. **Technical Practice and Documentation** * Document applications, data structures, and integrations so that a small team can support them over time. * Contribute to code review, shared standards, and OVPR's version control practice. * Build and maintain applications in line with web accessibility standards and the university's obligations. * Stay current on university services and emerging technology, and bring back what is worth adopting. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------------------- **Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Experience:** A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, information technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certification, and experience that demonstrates the foundational knowledge required for this role. **Application Development Experience:** Two or more years of professional experience laborative development, such as Git and review based workflows. **Communication and Requirements Gathering:** Ability to explain technical work clearly to people who are not technical, and to gather requirements by asking questions that surface what was left unsaid. **Independent Learning:** Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and with limited direction. **Desired Qualifications\*** ---------------------------- **University and Enterprise Systems Experience:** Experience working within a university or another large, decentralized enterprise environment, with a working understanding of how central services, unit level systems, and institutional policy fit together, and why the same information often lives in several systems at once. **Familiarity with University of Michigan Services:** Exposure to U\-M systems and services such as the U\-M API Gateway, Okta and Shibboleth, MCommunity, TeamDynamix, M\-Pathways, or the U\-M Container Service. **Applied Generative AI:** Experience putting generative AI into production, including large language model APIs, retrieval over institutional content, or agentic workflows, together with sound judgment about where AI belongs and where it does not. **Enterprise AI Platforms:** Experience with the U\-M GPT Toolkit, ITS AI Workflows, or comparable enterprise AI platforms and their data handling requirements. **Business Process Analysis:** Experience documenting, analyzing, and improving business processes, and comfort leading that conversation with the people who own the process. **Higher Education or Research Context:** Experience in higher education, research administration, or another environment with meaningful compliance and policy requirements. **Accessibility Awareness:** Working knowledge of web accessibility standards, including WCAG conformance and ADA Title II obligations. **Platform and Infrastructure Breadth:** Experience with WordPress development, containerization, or infrastructure as code. **Institutional Awareness and Influence:** Ability to move work forward across unit boundaries without formal authority, and awareness of how institutional politics shape what is actually possible. **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Background Screening** ------------------------ The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 283639 ### **Working Title** AI Solutions Developer ### **Job Title** Full Stack Developer Intermed ### **Work Location** Ann Arbor Campus Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Hybrid ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** Umor Off Vp Resrch ### **Department** UMOR Office of VP for Research ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 9/28/2026 \- 10/12/2026 ### **Salary** $105,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 ### **Career Interest** Information Technology

jobs.description: **Hospitality and Customer Service Professionals Welcome** **Title:** Property Manager – NYC Co\-ops \& Condominiums **Company:** Total Management NYC, LLC **Location:** Bronx office, with field visits to assigned NYC properties **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Schedule:** Two days at our Bronx office and three field days per week, plus evening meetings and on\-call responsibilities **Annual Base Salary:** $50,000–$65,000, depending on experience and qualifications **About the Opportunity** At Total Management NYC, exceptional property management begins with how we treat people. We are seeking a personable, organized, and proactive professional with a passion for customer service, a hospitality mindset, and a willingness to learn. Prior property management experience is helpful, but not required. We welcome candidates from hospitality, hotel operations, client services, and other backgrounds that involve building relationships, coordinating teams, and taking ownership of the customer experience. You will manage an assigned portfolio of NYC cooperative and condominium communities, supported by our dedicated maintenance, accounting, and administrative teams. Your focus will be building strong client relationships, coordinating services, leading board meetings, and ensuring consistent communication and follow\-through. **Who You Are** You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and follow through on your commitments. You anticipate needs, stay calm when problems arise, and make people feel heard and respected. You are comfortable leading meetings, explaining information, and handling difficult conversations professionally. When you do not know an answer, you take responsibility for finding it and following up. You understand that hospitality shows up in everyday actions: a warm greeting, a timely response, a thoughtful explanation, and an update before someone has to ask. **Training \& Transition** During an initial transition of approximately three months, you will work closely with company leadership to learn your assigned properties, build board relationships, and progressively assume responsibility for meetings. You will begin by attending meetings alongside leadership, then take the lead with guidance. The goal is for you to independently lead routine board meetings and manage day\-to\-day client relationships after the transition, with continued support from our internal teams and leadership for escalated matters. **Schedule \& Availability** * Two days per week at our Bronx office and three field days per week, visiting assigned NYC properties and coordinating with building staff and vendors. * Attendance at evening board meetings, typically between 7:00 p.m. and 9:30 p.m. * 24/7 availability by phone: Remain reachable outside regular business hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to respond to building emergencies and urgent board\-member concerns. * Work with our maintenance team and company leadership to coordinate emergency responses and provide timely updates. * Provide attentive service and consistent follow\-up on routine board inquiries. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Annual base salary of $50,000–$65,000, depending on experience and qualifications. * Health insurance benefits with 50% of the premium covered by the company. * A 401(k) plan. * A monthly travel reimbursement allowance. * A compensation review after six months. * Structured onboarding and direct guidance from company leadership. * Ongoing support from dedicated maintenance, accounting, and administrative teams. **How to Apply** Send your résumé and a brief introduction to HR@totalmanagement.us with the subject line “Property Manager Application.” Tell us why this opportunity interests you and share an example of how you took ownership of a challenging client situation or delivered an exceptional service experience. *Total Management NYC, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.* **Compensation:** $50,000 \- $65,000 yearly **Responsibilities:*** **Build client relationships:** Serve as the primary management contact for assigned boards and develop positive relationships with residents and building staff. * **Lead board meetings:** Prepare agendas and management reports, present financial and operational updates with support from our teams, communicate recommendations, and follow through on board decisions. * **Own the follow\-through:** Coordinate with maintenance, accounting, and administrative teams, keep clients informed, and confirm that each matter is resolved. * **Communicate proactively:** Respond to inquiries, set clear expectations, and provide timely updates about repairs, projects, and outstanding matters. * **Visit your properties:** Conduct regular walkthroughs, identify maintenance and presentation concerns, and coordinate corrective action. * **Coordinate repairs and services:** Work with our maintenance team, building staff, and vendors to arrange work, monitor progress, and confirm completion. * **Oversee building compliance:** With assistance from our maintenance team and qualified outside professionals, maintain a calendar of required inspections, filings, and correction deadlines. Ensure applicable annual elevator and boiler inspections are completed on time, coordinate correction of DOB and other agency violations, and track required filings and documentation through formal resolution. Keep boards informed of deadlines, outstanding issues, and approvals or funding needed. * **Support building staff:** Reinforce expectations for courtesy, responsiveness, work quality, and reliable coverage. * **Coordinate financial matters:** Work with accounting to understand budgets and financial reports, address billing questions, and bring upcoming obligations or spending concerns to the board’s attention. * **Coordinate capital projects:** Work with internal teams, engineers, and contractors on proposals, schedules, approvals, progress updates, and completion. * **Exercise sound judgment:** Handle routine matters independently within established authority and recognize when board approval or guidance from company leadership is needed. * **Use technology effectively:** Use AppFolio, Google Workspace, Zoom, and company\-approved AI tools to organize work, collaborate, prepare communications, and maintain accurate records. * **Manage emergency coordination:** Assess urgent situations, involve the appropriate maintenance personnel and vendors, and keep board members informed through resolution. **Qualifications:*** A demonstrated commitment to thoughtful, attentive customer service. * Experience managing client or guest relationships and taking responsibility for resolving concerns. * Experience leading meetings, presenting information, or coordinating discussions with clients or stakeholders. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong organization and the ability to manage competing priorities, track deadlines, and follow through consistently. * Empathy, professionalism, sound judgment, and discretion. * A willingness to learn building operations, financial reporting, and NYC co\-op and condominium compliance requirements. * **Comfort with Google Workspace and Zoom:** Ability to use Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar, and video meetings for daily communication and collaboration. * **Willingness to use AI tools:** Use company\-approved AI tools to help draft communications, summarize information, and organize work, while checking accuracy and protecting confidential client and company information. * **Ability to learn new systems:** Learn and consistently use AppFolio and other management platforms. Prior AppFolio experience is helpful but not required. Experience in hospitality management, client\-service leadership, property management, staff supervision, or vendor coordination is especially relevant. **About Company** **Our Story** ------------- Total Management NYC was founded with a simple mission: to provide NYC co\-ops and condos with the attentive, professional management they deserve. Since 2014, we've stayed true to that vision. Unlike large, impersonal management companies where your building is just another number, we take a boutique approach. Every building we manage receives personalized attention from a dedicated team who knows your property, your board, and your residents. Our headquarters in the Bronx and satellite office in Manhattan keep us close to the buildings and communities we serve. We understand NYC real estate because we're part of it.

Sees marketing, production, editorial, and growth partners as co\-owners of the web experience. What matters to you, matters to us too. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. *Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.* This position does not offer sponsorship for work permit applications or renewals, either now or in the future. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. **About the Role** We are looking for a **Staff Data Engineer – Data Platform** to help design and build the next generation of the **Vision One Data Platform** . This is a highly technical, hands\-on role focused on creating a modern data foundation that enables Vision One engineering teams to discover, govern, access, transform, and analyze data across the platform. You will work at the intersection of **distributed databases, data engineering, data governance, semantic discovery, and self\-service analytics** . A key part of the role is enabling **dbt as a self\-service data transformation and modeling capability across Vision One OLTP databases** , while building the underlying architecture, governance, and data movement infrastructure required to do this reliably at scale. You will work closely with platform, product, security, and data engineering teams to establish common data standards and infrastructure that can be reused across Vision One. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the **Vision One Data Platform** , including data ingestion, replication, transformation, governance, discovery, and serving capabilities. * Build scalable data pipelines and **change\-data\-capture (CDC)** architectures using technologies such as **Datastream** and similar streaming/replication technologies. * Enable **self\-service dbt** across Vision One OLTP data sources, providing product teams with governed capabilities to transform, model, test, document, and expose their data without requiring the central data platform team to build every pipeline. * Establish patterns for safely extracting and replicating data from **OLTP and distributed SQL databases** into analytical and downstream data systems. * Design architectures around distributed SQL technologies such as **YugabyteDB, CockroachDB** , or similar platforms. * Work with technologies such as **Databricks** and modern analytical processing engines to support large\-scale data processing and analytics. * Build a comprehensive **data catalog and metadata foundation** that enables teams and AI agents to understand what data exists, where it comes from, what it means, and how it can be used. * Develop **semantic data discovery** capabilities that allow engineers, analysts, applications, and AI agents to discover relevant data based on business meaning rather than only database/schema names. * Establish data governance standards covering **ownership, lineage, schemas, quality, access control, retention, and lifecycle management** . * Develop reusable data platform primitives and APIs that product teams can consume as self\-service capabilities. * Build automated mechanisms for **data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, and freshness monitoring** . * Design for evolving product schemas and ensure the platform can accommodate continuous changes without creating excessive duplication or operational overhead. * Partner with security and platform engineering teams to establish appropriate **fine\-grained data access controls** across databases, schemas, tables, and data products. * Help establish the **source\-of\-truth architecture** for Vision One data while minimizing unnecessary data duplication. * Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to other data engineers and product engineering teams. Drive engineering standards around reliability, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. * **What You Bring** **Required:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, distributed systems, backend engineering, or a related field. * Strong experience designing and building **large\-scale data platforms and data pipelines** . * Deep understanding of **OLTP and OLAP architectures** and the tradeoffs between them. * Hands\-on experience with **CDC, data replication, and streaming architectures** . * Strong SQL expertise and experience working with relational databases at scale. * Experience with **distributed SQL databases** , such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner, or similar technologies. * Experience building data transformation workflows using **dbt** or similar data modeling frameworks. * Experience with modern analytical/data platforms such as **Databricks, Spark, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery** , or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data governance concepts including **metadata, lineage, data quality, ownership, access control, and data catalogs** . * Experience designing systems that support  g **fine\-grained authorization** for data platforms. * Experience managing large\-scale telemetry, security, observability, or other high\-volume data. * Experience balancing **data quality, query performance, platform reliability, and infrastructure cost** . **What Success Looks Like** In this role, you will help establish a Data Platform where: * Vision One data can be **discovered through a common semantic layer** , rather than requiring teams to understand every underlying database and schema. * Product teams can use **dbt as a governed self\-service capability** across their OLTP data. * Data lineage, ownership, quality, and access policies are **built into the platform rather than managed manually** . * Data can move reliably from distributed OLTP systems into analytical and downstream systems through standardized CDC and streaming patterns. * Product teams can consume platform capabilities without repeatedly building their own ingestion, transformation, governance, and discovery infrastructure. * The platform provides a **trusted source of truth** while minimizing unnecessary copies of data. * The resulting data foundation can support not only traditional analytics and applications, but also **AI and agentic experiences across Vision One** . **Engineering Leadership** As a Staff Engineer, you will be expected to operate beyond the boundaries of a single team. You will shape architecture, establish technical standards, mentor engineers, drive cross\-team adoption, and solve ambiguous problems that span multiple products and systems. You should be comfortable going deep into implementation details while simultaneously thinking about the long\-term architecture of a **large\-scale, multi\-product security data platform** . **Why Join TrendAI?** --------------------- TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open\-weight, cybersecurity\-focused large language model, but also the industry's first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will help define how a security\-critical product is built — including how AI shapes the development process itself. You will partner with engineering leaders applying AI to that process, working in an environment where the bar on systems thinking, critical review, and security instinct has gone up, not down. **What We Offer You:** You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. \#LI\-JL1 At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. jobs.description: **Full Stack Developer – React \& Node.js** **Location:** Foster City, CA **Work Arrangement:** Onsite – 4 Days per Week, Day 1 Onsite **Employment Type:** Contract Please use the following JD: **Software Engineer — Charging Vendor Integrations** **Team: Charging Infrastructure / Fleet Platform · Level: Mid–Senior** **About the role** Client operates its own charging network and relies on third\-party charging providers (e.g., EVgo) spanning multiple hardware manufacturers and vendor platforms. We're building a single vendor gateway. You'll own that gateway end to end: the protocol clients, the abstraction layer, the onboarding tooling, and the live service contract our fleet systems depend on. This is a backend engineering role at the intersection of messy external APIs, real\-time systems, and EV\-charging domain protocols. **Our stack is Python on the backend and React on the frontend** — you'll live primarily in **Python**, with **React** for the charger onboarding and operations tooling. **What we're looking for** Strong backend engineering experience building and operating production services and API integrations against unreliable or inconsistent external sources. Experience designing canonical data models / abstraction layers over heterogeneous third\-party systems. Comfort with event\-driven or streaming systems feeding real\-time consumers, and the reliability mindset that comes with owning a live service (observability, retries, graceful degradation). Ability to own a service across the stack — stand it up, deploy it, monitor it — without needing hand\-holding on infra. **Skills** **Python** — primary language; production experience building backend services and API clients (async, typing, and a modern framework such as FastAPI/Django/Flask). **React** — for building and maintaining the charger onboarding and operations UI (TypeScript a plus). **API integration** — REST/webhooks, plus comfort querying vendor databases (SQL) where no clean API exists. **Data modeling** — designing canonical schemas and reconciling inconsistent inputs across sources. **Real\-time / event\-driven systems** — message queues or streaming (e.g., Kafka), and the observability tooling to run them. **Cloud \& operations** — deploying and monitoring services in a cloud environment (AWS/GCP), containers, CI/CD. Strong signals (nice to have) Hands\-on experience with OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) — charger\-to\-central\-system communication across manufacturers. Hands\-on experience with OCPI (Open Charge Point Interface) — the roaming/interoperator protocol for integrating third\-party networks (locations, tariffs, session data, real\-time status). Prior work in EV charging, energy, telematics, IoT device fleets, or other domains that involve normalizing data from many hardware vendors. DevOps/SRE fluency (IaC, CI/CD, cloud infra, monitoring) as a complement to strong application engineering. Pay: $75\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Benefits: * Green card sponsorship * Health insurance * Visa sponsorship Work Location: Hybrid remote in Foster City, CA 94404

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Enterprise AI — Technical Fellow Office
jobs.description: Join the Technical Fellow Office to solve hard, ambiguous problems, set the bar for technical judgment, and shape how the broader engineering organization builds — across teams and beyond our immediate department. This is Enterprise AI work: deciding which platforms, workflows, and guardrails let AI systems do real work at scale, getting them adopted by teams that don't report to you, and knowing where the frontier is heading before the organization needs to. If you want to work where cutting\-edge AI meets production\-grade engineering — and influence how an entire division builds — this is that role. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Set technical direction**: Form clear positions on architecture, model strategy, and build\-vs\-buy — and defend them under challenge from senior engineers who see it differently. Run design reviews that change outcomes, not just document them. * **Drive adoption**: Get platforms and tooling used by teams outside your own. Understand why a team resists, and do the work to earn trust rather than mandate it. * **Define quality for AI**: Own how we measure correctness in systems where a wrong answer looks like a right one. Build the evaluation methods and gates that catch degraded agent and model behavior before users do. * **Own AI cost as an engineering discipline**: Routing, caching, model selection, and telemetry that make spend visible and attributable — so cost decisions are made with data, not after the invoice. * **Track the frontier**: Spend real time outward — evaluating emerging models, harnesses, and techniques; maintaining a network of peers; bringing back a point of view on what matters and what doesn't. * **Advise \& de\-risk**: Guide complex technical decisions, surface blind spots and the novel risks of autonomous systems, and help teams adopt AI pragmatically rather than by hype. * **Build where it matters**: Prototype POCs that validate strategic bets, and contribute hands\-on where your involvement changes the result — including inside other teams' codebases. * **Rotate into the business**: Periodically embed with a business function (e.g., Finance, HR) for a scoped period, bringing that team onto our AI stack and telemetry before returning to the core team — a temporary, hands\-on deployment, not a permanent placement. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **10\+ years** of hands\-on engineering in software development, system design, or architecture. * **Applied AI / agentic engineering**: Real experience with modern LLMs and agentic systems — context engineering, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, and evaluation — including the sharp edges: latency, cost, reliability, non\-determinism, safety. * **Production AI systems**: A track record of taking AI\-driven capabilities from prototype to production with proper evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails. * **Adoption you can point to**: Platforms or tooling you built that were taken up by teams outside your own — and what you did when they weren't. * **Influence without authority**: Evidence of forming a technical position and holding it under challenge from senior engineers who disagreed, and of moving decisions you didn't own. * **Distributed systems at scale**: Strong background in scalable, fault\-tolerant services and data\-intensive platforms. * **Comfortable in unfamiliar territory**: Able to embed with a team you've never worked with, learn its context fast, and leave it better than you found it. jobs.title: Network Engineer IV
jobs.description: **Pay Grade/Pay Range:** Minimum: $83,500 \- Midpoint: $112,700 (Salaried E13\) **Department/Organization:** 200706 \- OIT\-HPC Center Services **Normal Work Schedule:** Monday \- Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm **Note to Applicants:** Position is eligible for hybrid work subject to University policy. **Job Summary:** The Network Engineer IV supports the functionality and availability of enterprise\-wide mission critical University networks by performing network engineering and under close supervision. Performs high\-complexity operational network management and maintenance tasks. Participates in network problem identification, analysis, and resolution for high\-complexity problems. Leads and contributes to strategy, planning, and design of the campus and wide\-area networks. Provides guidance, training, and/or supervision to other Network Engineers. **Additional Department Summary:** This is a technology leadership position responsible for engineering and architecture of the UA network, with a focus on the new High Performance Computing Center. This position performs and directs advanced campus network layer 2 \& 3 engineering, design, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, and administration. Responsibilities may include leading strategic planning and implementation of network changes, managing/purchasing switch/router fleet, creating campus network policy, managing the university’s ISP connectivity and WAN/Internet connectivity, supporting integration of educational, administrative, and research applications with campus networks and/or designing networks for new campus building construction depending upon experience. Some on\-call required. **Required Minimum Qualifications:** Master's degree and four (4\) years of network engineering experience; OR bachelor's degree and six (6\) years of network engineering experience; OR associate's degree and eight (8\) years of IT experience to include six (6\) years of network engineering; OR high school diploma or GED and ten (10\) years of IT experience to include six (6\) years of network engineering. **Additional Required Department Minimum Qualifications:** Must have valid U.S. driver's license. Must be at least 19 years of age at time of hire and have an acceptable Motor Vehicle Report that is in compliance with University policies. Applicants under the age of 21 will have some driving restrictions. **Skills and Knowledge:** Senior engineering level skills with CISCO routing and switching (VLAN/VRF), WAN routing (BGP, route leaking) and data center networks. Extensive experience with advanced LAN network concepts, design, management, security, performance, and operations. Extensive experience with Internet services and applications within the IP suite (DHCP, DNS, etc.). Experience with IT procurement. Experience with higher education network consortiums (SOX, Internet2, etc.). **Preferred Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree or higher and eight (8\) years of experience in network engineering. CCNA certification preferred. Experience with new building construction data layer architecture. Experience in software\-defined networks. Nexus gear and Nexus dashboard experience. **Background Investigation Statement:** Prior to hiring, the final candidate(s) must successfully pass a pre\-employment background investigation and information obtained from social media and other internet sources. A prior conviction reported as a result of the background investigation DOES NOT automatically disqualify a candidate from consideration for this position. A candidate with a prior conviction or negative behavioral red flags will receive an individualized review of the prior conviction or negative behavioral red flags before a hiring decision is made. **Equal Employment Opportunity**: The University of Alabama is an Equal Employment/Equal Educational Opportunity Institution. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment or volunteer status without regard to any legally protected basis and will not be discriminated against because of their protected status. Applicants and employees of this institution are protected under Federal law from discrimination on several bases. More information is available in the EEOC’s Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal poster. The University of Alabama affirms its longstanding commitment to institutional neutrality, free speech, and academic freedom.

jobs.title: ASO DIR, Clinical Research
jobs.description: **Job no:** 541536 **Work type:** Staff Full\-Time **Location:** Main Campus (Gainesville, FL) **Categories:** Health Care Administration/Support **Department:**57720000 \- INSTITUTE\-CHILD HEALTH POLICY **Classification Title:** ASO DIR, Clinical Research **Classification Minimum Requirements:** Classification Minimum Requirements are the baseline requirements for Staff Titles and Academic Titles found at the University of Florida. {sTALargeOther1} **Job Description:** The Institute for Child Health Policy (ICHP) at the University of Florida is seeking an Associate Director of Research and Data Operations to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for the Institute's External Quality Review Organization (EQRO) activities and other state\- and federally funded research initiatives. This senior leadership position will direct all aspects of research and data operations, including data acquisition, data management, analytics, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, resource allocation, and reporting. The position also serves as a key operational leader in the management of the Institute's $100 million Medicaid EQRO contract, ensuring successful execution of contractual requirements, oversight of complex deliverables, management of project risks, and coordination across multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. Working in close partnership with Institute leadership, faculty, project teams, state agencies, and external partners, the Associate Director will help shape the Institute's strategic direction, identify opportunities for program growth, strengthen operational excellence, and ensure the successful delivery of a diverse portfolio of high\-impact research and quality improvement initiatives. The Associate Director will lead a multidisciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, and other project staff, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and operational leadership. Serving as a senior liaison between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, the position translate complex data, analytics, and research findings into clear, actionable recommendations that supports policy development, operational decision\-making, and program improvement. **Duties:** **Strategic Leadership** Partners with the Director and other organizational leaders to establish strategic priorities and guide the planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of research operations supporting ICHP and the EQRO’s project portfolio and long\-term goals. Evaluates operational performance and implements strategies to enhance research effectiveness, efficiency, and service delivery. Leads the development, standardization, and continuous improvement of research, data management, operational processes, policies, and procedures that support project execution and contractual compliance. Directs the development and implementation of research strategies, operational frameworks, and project plans that ensure efficient resource utilization and compliance with organizational and contractual obligations. Builds and maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders to advance organizational objectives and identify opportunities for innovation and program growth. **Operations Oversight** Directs operational oversight of multiple concurrent research projects by establishing priorities, allocating resources, monitoring performance, and ensuring the successful execution of research activities. Oversees budgeting, financial planning, and resource allocation to ensure sound stewardship and alignment with strategic priorities. Ensures compliance with university policies, sponsor requirements, HIPAA, data security standards, and applicable federal and state regulations. Coordinates and monitors research projects and operational activities to meet milestones, deliverables, and organizational objectives. Leads cross\-functional teams and collaborates with staff, project leadership, faculty, and external partners to align with stakeholder priorities and organizational goals. Serves as a subject matter expert in research operations and data analysis, providing consultation and strategic guidance to leadership and stakeholders. **Staff Supervision and Development** Provides leadership, supervision, and mentorship to research, data management, and analysis staff, fostering a collaborative, high\-performing, and customer\-focused work environment. Establishes performance goals and metrics for teams and individuals to evaluate progress against assigned responsibilities and organizational objectives. Provides ongoing direction, coaching, and constructive feedback to support performance and professional growth. Promotes continuous learning through internal presentations, industry conferences, workshops, certifications, and other training programs. Delegates work assignments, oversees project contributions from programmers, data managers, and other staff, and ensures deliverables meet established standards for quality, timeliness, and effort. Supports workforce planning, succession planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance evaluations, corrective action, retention, and talent development to ensure the long\-term success of ICHP and the EQRO. **Reporting and Strategic Communication** Translates complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for leadership, stakeholders, project teams, and external partners through presentations, reports, and other communications. Oversees the development, review, and maintenance of technical and operational documentation, ensuring materials are accurate, concise, and tailored to various audiences. Reviews reports and deliverables produced by research and data management staff, providing guidance to improve clarity, quality, consistency, and effectiveness. Facilitates communication between technical and non\-technical stakeholders to ensure shared understanding of project goals, requirements, risks, and outcomes. **Expected Salary:** $156,000\-$166,000 **Required Qualifications:** Master's degree in appropriate area of specialization and four years of appropriate experience; or a bachelor's degree in appropriate areas of specialization and six years of experience. {sTALargeOther1} **Preferred:** Knowledge of the research life cycle. Knowledge of Medicaid and CHIP and External Quality Review policies and protocols. Knowledge of statistics, including linear and non\-linear regression logistic regression, time\-series, survival models, and non\-parametric methods. Various skills in data management and computer programming, especially with SAS, SQL, Stata, and Access. Experience with software review and documentation processes. Attention to detail, particularly with regard to data accuracy and integrity. Experience with HIPAA protected data. Excellent written (in English) and oral communication skill. Ability to prepare documentation for internal project reports, reports to stakeholders and the public, and scientific publications in peer reviewed journals. Ability to work independently and to collaborate with faculty and staff at multiple levels and to effectively manage the work of a research team. **Special Instructions to Applicants:** In order to be considered, you must upload your cover letter, resume/CV, and list of at least three professional references. This is a time\-limited position. Application must be submitted by 11:55 p.m. (ET) of the posting end date. **Health Assessment Required:** No **Advertised:** 28 Sep 2026 Eastern Daylight Time **Applications close:** 05 Oct 2026 Eastern Daylight Time

jobs.description: **Job no:** 541527 **Work type:** Student Ast **Location:** Main Campus (Gainesville, FL) **Categories:** Computer Science, Office/Administrative/Fiscal Support **Department:**29680240 \- MD\-CTSI\-SRVC CNTR\-CTS\-IT **Classification Title:** STU\-AST \- CLERICAL \& ADMIN **Classification Minimum Requirements:** This position is open to all UF students who are eligible to work on campus and will be employed through student STAS and must maintain a minimum 2\.0 grade point average. Registered students are employed on a part\-time basis, up to 20 hours per week. **Preferred Qualifications:** Students are encouraged to apply early in their graduate studies and should have an interest in working in the position for at least two semesters or longer, if their academic schedule allows. **Special Instructions to Applicants:** Interested students should submit a resume and cover letter.
